title.en: How to adapt a novel into a game candidate
title.zh: 如何用 Novel to Game 把小说改编成游戏候选版本

answer.en: Start with a novel you own or are authorized to adapt, then choose a bounded experience in which a player can act and see a consequence—not a compressed retelling of the entire book. A useful first slice preserves the source’s particular pressure while limiting scenes, systems and assets. Novel to Game’s seven skills take an agreed brief through analysis, concept, design and a built candidate. The ferry example below shows how to choose the scope before building; a design document or successful build alone is not a playable-game result. Once a candidate exists, separate a misleading line, a result that violates the approved rules and a new design request before asking for another build. The author-feedback examples below show how to keep the next change small without treating a different story as a bug fix.
answer.zh: 从你拥有或获准改编的小说开始，先选一段玩家能行动、能看到后果的小范围体验，而不是把全书压成梗概。第一份切片要保住原作特有的压力，同时限制场景、系统和素材范围。Novel to Game 的七个 skills 依据确认的简报，从分析、概念与设计推进到构建候选版本。下面的渡口示例先说明如何选范围，再进入制作；只有设计文档，或只有构建成功，都不能算作游戏已经可玩。 拿到候选版本后，先分清是文字让人误解、结果违反已定规则，还是自己想改设计，再要求下一次构建。下方的作者反馈示例说明怎样把修改圈小，而不是把另一种故事当成修错。

en: A novel file, directory or link, plus an explicit rights/asset boundary. Do not treat access to a text as permission to adapt it.
A configured agent host. The installation table distinguishes Claude Code `/novel-to-game`, Codex `$novel-to-game` and Kimi Code `/skill:novel-to-game`; use the matching adapter.
An available engine and target runtime, or a documented plan for obtaining them. Model, media and tool services may require separate configuration or cost approval.
zh: 小说文件、目录或链接，以及明确的改编与素材使用边界。能访问文本不等于已经获准改编。
已配置的 Agent 宿主。安装表区分 Claude Code 的 `/novel-to-game`、Codex 的 `$novel-to-game` 与 Kimi Code 的 `/skill:novel-to-game`，请选择对应适配器。
可用的引擎和目标运行环境，或明确的准备计划。模型、媒体与工具服务可能需要另行配置或费用授权。

en: Install and choose a mode

Use the source README installation row for your host. `quick` recommends defaults and continues; `director` lets you choose the concept; `resume` reads the existing workspace and resumes from the earliest incomplete handoff.
Set the product brief

Ask for `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`: scope, language, experience type, platform, engine, target runtime, tested runtime, input/display requirements, content limits and rights/asset boundaries. Ordinary assumptions can be recorded; material or safety-sensitive decisions require resolution.
Declare the source range before choosing a slice

If you want a whole-novel adaptation, a first-three-chapter preview or a few sampled scenes is not whole-book coverage. The analysis workflow requires full source coverage before concept design unless you explicitly limit the adaptation to a volume or excerpt. State that limit in the brief and record missing or unread material. “No relevant finding in a reviewed chapter” is different from “this chapter was not read.” Selecting a small first build does not by itself authorize skipping the rest of a requested whole-book analysis.
Ground the adaptation

Read the cited evidence and adaptation boundaries in `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md`, then the selected concept and tradeoffs in `concepts/CONCEPT.md`. Keep facts that change player actions, world responses or audiovisual identity, rather than retelling every chapter. Once the concept selects a passage, analysis adds its fact-level reference table. New gameplay exceptions, state design and interface structure belong to the downstream design, not backdated source evidence. If you want an interactive story, state that preference instead of silently accepting a system-led game.
Choose the smallest scope that still carries the promised experience

Name a player role, an immediate objective, available actions, feedback and an outcome. Compare only meaningful open alternatives; do not generate several genres just to fill a menu. For the ferry brief, a summary-only reading page does not test consequential choice, while a whole-town simulation would require new scope and supporting material. A bounded boarding decision can carry this particular promise. Its scene can demonstrate one narrative event, not prove an entire novel supports a repeatable management or combat loop. Slice duration and system count follow the brief and the design risk, not a universal five-minute or three-system rule. See [meaningful choices](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices) for the actual branch design.
Design and build a small candidate

Follow `design/GAME_DESIGN.md`, a risk-matched whitebox where needed, `design/ART_DIRECTION.md` and `build/BUILD_BRIEF.md`. Keep the first candidate small enough to exercise a complete loop rather than expanding its feature list.
Describe the next change in the author’s terms

Point to the exact choice or scene, what you did, what you understood or expected, and what actually appeared. Separate an expression change from an implementation mismatch or a changed rule. The design, art and build owners are distinct; fixing one label does not authorize a new concept. Propose the smallest change that addresses the reading or play problem while naming what must remain.
Verify in the chosen runtime

Run the commands recorded in the build brief and collect launch, render, input, coreLoop, outcome and restart evidence from one complete run. A substitute runtime does not establish target-platform compatibility.
Resume honestly
Read `qa/verification.json`, evidence files and `_progress.md`. Fix the earliest failed handoff and rerun verification; do not convert missing tooling or untested behavior into PASS.
zh: 安装并选择模式
使用源码 README 中对应宿主的安装行。`quick` 推荐默认值并继续；`director` 让你选择概念；`resume` 读取现有工作区，从最早未完成的交接处恢复。
确定产品简报
要求建立 `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`，明确范围、语言、体验类型、平台、引擎、目标运行环境、实际测试环境、输入与显示要求、内容尺度及权利/素材边界。普通假设可以记录；实质分支或安全敏感决策必须解决。
先说清来源范围，再挑制作切片
如果要改编整部小说，前三章预览或几个抽样场景不等于全书覆盖。分析流程要求进入概念设计前完成来源覆盖，除非你明确把改编限定在某卷或片段。把这个限制写进简报，并记录缺失或未读部分。“读过但没有相关发现”，与“根本没有读到这一章”不同。首版只做很小一段，不自动授权跳过已经要求的全书分析。
让改编有原文依据
读 `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md` 的原文证据与改编边界，再看 `concepts/CONCEPT.md` 的选定概念和取舍。保留能改变玩家动作、世界回应或视听身份的事实，不逐章复述全部剧情。概念选定段落后，分析阶段再补该段逐事实表。新增玩法例外、状态设计与界面结构属于下游设计，不能倒写成原作证据。想做互动故事时要明确说出，不要默认接受系统型游戏形式。
选最小范围，但别把承诺的体验一起删掉

点名玩家身份、眼前目标、可用动作、反馈和结果。只比较真正仍开放的取舍，不为凑菜单临时生成几个游戏类型。对下面的渡口简报，只读梗概不能试出选择后果，整座城模拟则需要额外范围与来源材料；一次完整的登船决定就能承载本例承诺。这能展示一个叙事事件，不证明整部小说已经支持可反复运作的经营或战斗循环。切片时长与系统数量服从简报和设计风险，不套通用的“五分钟”或“三个系统”。实际分支设计见[有意义的选择](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices)。
设计并构建小范围候选版本
依次依据 `design/GAME_DESIGN.md`、按需的风险匹配白盒、`design/ART_DIRECTION.md` 与 `build/BUILD_BRIEF.md` 推进。先把范围控制到能验证完整循环，而不是不断增加功能。
把作者反馈变成一次有范围的修改
点名具体选项或场景，说明自己做了什么、怎样理解或期待，以及实际看到了什么。分开改表达、修实现与改规则；设计、美术和构建各有归属，修一个按钮不授权重选概念。提出能解决这次阅读或游玩问题的最小改法，并说明哪些不能动。
在选定环境中验证
运行构建简报记录的命令，用同一次完整运行收集 launch、render、input、coreLoop、outcome 和 restart 证据。替代运行环境通过不代表目标平台兼容。
如实恢复工作
读取 `qa/verification.json`、证据文件和 `_progress.md`，先修复最早失败的交接，再重新验证；工具缺失或行为未测试不能改写成 PASS。

example.en:
Original scope exercise — use the ferry situation from the meaningful-choices guide, not a claimed analysis of an entire novel or a generated game.

Source seed:
The final ferry sounded its boarding whistle. Rain had blurred the stamp on Qiao Ning's ticket. The boatkeeper held it beside the register without tearing it. “The ticket office can issue proof,” he said, “but this boat will be gone by the time you return.”

Keep provenance separate:
- The seed establishes a blurred stamp and the delay attached to replacement proof.
- The example's author additionally fixes that Qiao Ning bought the ticket and wants to cross tonight; the blurred stamp alone cannot secure boarding.
- The author-approved adaptation exception is new design: a purchase witness plus Qiao Ning's consent to a named exception record permits boarding tonight. Finding the witness is possible before departure; replacing the ticket is not. For this design, returning with replacement proof leads to a morning-place offer; declining the named exception leaves Qiao Ning ashore. These outcomes are also author-approved design. Do not attribute the exception or those outcomes to the quoted seed or write them back as original evidence.
- No other chapters were supplied. This exercise is explicitly an excerpt adaptation, not a full-novel adaptation based on sampling.

Three scope proposals for this brief, not three mandatory game concepts:
A. A summary of the journey with a Next button. It may provide a reading experience, but does not fulfill this brief's promise that a player's choice changes the outcome.
B. One complete boarding dispute: choose how to establish purchase, then decide whether to accept the named exception if that route remains available. Show the appropriate departure/stay/morning-place result and allow a fresh start. This is the selected scope for the exercise.
C. The whole town and subsequent journey, with exploration, trade and many passengers. This is additional design work and would need broader source coverage or explicitly approved adaptation additions, plus a revised content budget. It is not presumed bad; it is outside the current promise and supplied evidence.

A creator-readable slice brief — illustrative planning, not an already-created PRODUCT_BRIEF.md:
- Player: Qiao Ning. Goal: leave tonight while deciding which proof and record cost to accept.
- Experience: single-player, narrative-led; Simplified Chinese UI in a desktop browser, keyboard and mouse. Confirm the actual available test environment separately.
- Source scope: only the provided excerpt and separately attributed author facts; the exception is an approved adaptation addition, not a recovered source rule.
- Structure: one dispute, two decision points and three defined results. Do not promise an unmeasured play duration. The linked branch example specifies the conditions; this brief does not replace GAME_DESIGN.
- Preserve: proof type and timing affect available choices; accepting the exception has an acknowledged record; going to the office cannot secretly regain tonight's boat.
- Exclude for this slice: open-world travel, combat, economy, romance meters, subsequent chapters and paid asset generation. Text and placeholders are sufficient for this candidate's chosen finish.
- Stop the episode at its defined result; restarting restores its initial situation. An outcome screen is not evidence that any later journey happened.

Terminal — install the Claude Code adapter:
npx skills add zenstory-ai/novel-to-game -g -y -a claude-code -s '*'

After resolving material decisions, use the configured host for the full workflow. Replace the input with your authorized excerpt and supply author facts/additions separately:
/novel-to-game quick
Adapt only /ABS/my-authorized-excerpt.txt using the selected scope above.
Do not treat the excerpt as a complete novel. Record the source range and keep author additions separate from source quotations. Preserve the narrative-led promise, exclusions and defined results in PRODUCT_BRIEF.md and the design handoffs. Resolve any blocking conflict before advancing rather than silently widening the scope.
Build only this candidate using text and placeholders, without paid asset generation. Record target and actual test runtimes. Report missing tools or untested behavior honestly; do not mark them PASS.

This quick request continues toward a built and tested candidate; it is not a planning-only command. If you want only analysis/concept/design, explicitly request those named skill stages and their handoff files, then stop before building, as shown in the meaningful-choices guide. Neither suggested request was executed for this article.

After a candidate: three hypothetical author comments, not an observed playtest
These invented comments continue the approved ferry design above. No generated game was run for this guide. They show different revision jobs, not three bugs that must exist or a mandatory feedback-file format.

1. “The button says ‘Not now’. I thought I could enter my name later and still catch this boat.”
If this is the witness route's refusal choice, propose the clearer label “Decline the named exception; stay ashore”, matching the linked branch example. This changes what the option communicates, not its effect. Keep the consent choice separate from the witness statement already recorded in that example; declining the exception does not erase the testimony. Locate the authoritative copy in the existing design or implementation, and change only the relevant wording. Keep the action identity, destination and result intact instead of inventing another chance to board.

2. “I went back to the ticket office, but the ending says I leave tonight.”
This conflicts with the approved replacement-proof route, which misses tonight's boat and leads to a morning-place offer. First separate the ending sentence the player sees from the game state the choice actually records. If the state correctly holds a morning reservation but the prose says “tonight”, repair that expression. If the rules also restore tonight's boarding opportunity, repair the relevant condition or transition. The comment alone does not diagnose which layer is wrong. Do not change the approved timing rule merely to make the current ending look consistent.

3. “Now I want Qiao Ning to board tonight even if she refuses the named exception.”
That is a proposed design change, not a clearer label. It changes the agreed relationship between consent and boarding, and removes that refusal branch's existing stay-ashore cost. It is not inherently a bad new story, but it needs a decision about the new tradeoff and outcomes. Revise the affected GAME_DESIGN after approval; revisit PRODUCT_BRIEF or CONCEPT only if the player promise or scope also changes. Keep the adaptation addition separate from SOURCE_BIBLE evidence and leave unrelated art decisions alone. Do not add a hidden punishment to recreate the old cost without approval.

Turn the chosen comment into a small handoff:
“On the witness route's second choice, after the witness statement has been recorded, I read ‘Not now’ as a postponement. Change only that refusal label to ‘Decline the named exception; stay ashore’. Keep the first choice, the prior testimony, the separate consent, all three endings, restart behavior and the text/placeholder finish. Show where the current wording is owned and what would change. Do not alter a rule just to support the old label.”
This is a sample author decision, not an actual implementation edit. For your own candidate, add its real version, scene/choice anchor and input sequence instead of pretending this fictional observation came from your build.

A text-only request before authorizing the next edit:
Read my named existing brief, source bible, concept, design and relevant candidate passage together with the supplied feedback. In this reply, distinguish a wording problem, a mismatch with the approved rule, and a newly requested rule. State the proposed change, its owner, frozen decisions and missing evidence. Do not infer an internal state from an ending sentence alone. Do not modify project files, rerun the entire pipeline or generate paid assets; stop at the proposal until the change is selected.
[Provide real workspace paths, candidate/version and the observed passage or interaction.]

After selection, request the corresponding stage's scoped edit rather than starting a new concept. `resume` reads actual artifacts and the earliest unfinished handoff; it is not a command to reroll approved design. If the candidate already has saves or replay records, identify whether changed node IDs, action effects or state meanings affect them; migrate or explicitly reject incompatible records rather than treating them as new history. Do not add a save/log system to this small slice just to fill in a checklist. State what was actually changed and what remains untested; repairing this comment does not establish that the game is fun or every branch is correct.
example.zh:
原创范围练习——沿用《有意义的选择》里的渡口处境，不是整本小说的实测分析，也不是已生成的游戏。

正文种子：
末班渡船响过催行的汽笛。乔宁船票上的印章被雨水洇开了。
守船人把票压在登记簿旁，没有撕掉。
“售票处能补凭证，”他说，“但等你回来，这班船就走了。”

把来源分开：
- 原文种子给出了印章模糊，以及补凭证会错过本班船。
- 本例作者另行确认：乔宁确实买过票、希望今晚渡河；模糊印章本身不足以让她登船。
- 作者批准的改编例外是新增设计：购票证人作证，加上乔宁同意实名例外登记，即可在本班开船前登船。寻找证人来得及，回售票处补凭证来不及。本设计还约定：补凭证回来后可预约明早的船位；拒绝实名例外则留在岸上。这些结果也属于作者批准的设计。不能把例外与结果归给上面四句原文，也不能倒写成原作证据。
- 没有提供其他章节。本练习明确只改编这个片段，不靠抽样冒充全书改编。

针对这份简报的三种范围提案，不是每次必做的三个游戏概念：
A. 把旅途梗概配上“下一页”。它可以提供阅读体验，但不能兑现本简报“选择改变结果”的承诺。
B. 一次完整的登船争议：选择怎样证明购票；对应路线仍可用时，再决定是否接受实名例外。显示今晚出发、留在岸上或预约明早的相应结果，并能重新开始。本练习选这个范围。
C. 整座城与后续旅途，加入探索、交易和大量乘客。这属于额外设计，需要更广的原作覆盖，或作者明确批准的改编新增设计，并重新约定内容预算；不是一概不好，只是不属于当前承诺和已提供的证据范围。

作者可读的切片简报——说明性规划，不是已经创建的 PRODUCT_BRIEF.md：
- 玩家：乔宁。目标：争取今晚出发，同时选择愿意承担的凭证与留痕成本。
- 体验：单人、叙事主导；简体中文界面，桌面浏览器，键盘与鼠标。实际可用测试环境另行确认。
- 来源范围：只用所给片段，以及注明来自作者的补充事实；例外规则是批准的改编新增，不是恢复出的原著规则。
- 结构：一次争议、两个选择点、三个明确结果。不承诺未经实际体验的游玩分钟数。具体条件见关联的分支示例，这份简报不替代 GAME_DESIGN。
- 保留：凭证类型和时间影响选项；接受例外会留下明确记录；去售票处后不能悄悄又赶上今晚的船。
- 本切片不做：开放世界旅行、战斗、经济系统、恋爱数值、后续章节与付费素材生成。这个候选版本选择文字和占位素材即可。
- 在定义的结果处结束这次事件；重开恢复初态。结果画面不证明后面的旅途已经发生。

终端——安装 Claude Code 适配器：
npx skills add zenstory-ai/novel-to-game -g -y -a claude-code -s '*'

实质选择确定后，再在配置好的宿主里运行完整流程。把输入替换为自己获准使用的片段，作者补充事实和改编新增规则另列：
/novel-to-game quick
只改编 /ABS/my-authorized-excerpt.txt，采用上面选定的范围。
不要把片段当成全书。记录来源范围，把作者新增与原文引述分开。将叙事主导承诺、非目标和明确结果保留到 PRODUCT_BRIEF.md 与设计交接中。存在阻断性冲突时先解决，不悄悄扩范围。
只构建这个文字与占位素材候选版本，不调用付费素材生成。记录目标与实际测试运行环境。如实报告工具缺失或未测试行为，不把它们标为 PASS。

这个 quick 请求会继续到构建与测试候选版本，不是只做规划。若只想要分析、概念和设计，应明确要求对应的具名技能阶段及交接文件，然后在构建前停止，示例见《有意义的选择》指南。本文没有实际执行这两类建议请求。

拿到候选之后：三条假设的作者反馈，不是实测记录
以下虚构反馈沿用上面的已批准渡口设计。本指南没有运行生成游戏；这里展示不同改稿任务，不声称候选必有这三个问题，也不新增必须填写的反馈文件格式。

1.“按钮写着‘暂不登记’，我以为之后还能补填姓名，赶上这班船。”
若它对应证人路线里的拒绝选项，可建议改成关联分支示例中的“拒绝实名例外，留在岸上”。改的是选项说明，不是作用。沿用该例证词已经记录的前提，把乔宁是否同意实名例外单独保留；拒绝不抹掉已有证词。先找到现有设计或实现里文案的权威位置，只改相应表达。动作身份、去向和结果不变，不顺手新增又一次登船机会。

2.“我去了售票处补凭证，结尾却说我今晚出发。”
这与已批准的规则冲突：补凭证会错过本班，回来后可预约明早的船位。先分开玩家看到的结尾文案与这次选择实际写入的游戏状态。若状态已经正确保留明早预约，只是文案写了“今晚”，修表达；若规则也把今晚登船机会重新打开，才修相关条件或转换。单凭这条反馈，还不能断定是哪层出错。不能为迁就当前结尾，反改已经确认的时间规则。

3.“我现在想让乔宁拒绝实名例外也能今晚登船。”
这是新设计提案，不是把按钮写清楚。它改变了实名同意与登船的既定关系，也拿掉了原拒绝分支留岸的代价。新故事不一定不好，但要先决定新的取舍与结果。批准后修改受影响的 GAME_DESIGN；只有玩家承诺或范围也变了，才回看 PRODUCT_BRIEF 或 CONCEPT。新增规则仍与 SOURCE_BIBLE 的原文证据分开，不连带改无关美术；也不能擅加一个隐藏惩罚，把旧代价兜回来。

把选定反馈圈成一份小交接：
“在证人路线的第二个选择处、证词已经记下之后，我把‘暂不登记’理解成了延期。只把这项拒绝标签改成‘拒绝实名例外，留在岸上’。保留第一个选择、已有证词、单独的实名同意、三个结局、重开行为，以及文字和占位素材的完成形态。指出当前文案由哪里持有、将改什么；不为支持旧标签而改规则。”
这是示意性的作者决定，不是已经修改的实现。处理自己的候选时，应补真实版本、场景或选项锚点及输入顺序，不把这条虚构反馈当作自己运行后的观察。

授权下一轮编辑前，可先发一个纯文字请求：
读取我点名的已有简报、原著圣经、概念、设计与候选相关段落，结合所给反馈，在本次回复里分清措辞问题、违反已批准规则的情况，以及新提出的规则。列出建议改法、归属、冻结项与缺失证据。不只凭结尾一句话猜内部状态。不修改项目文件，不重跑全链，也不生成付费素材；停在提案，等选定修改。
[提供真实工作区路径、候选或版本，以及实际看到的段落或操作。]

选定后，请对应阶段执行有范围的修改，不重新开一轮概念。`resume` 读取实际产物、从最早未完成的交接继续，不是重抽已批准设计的命令。候选原本已有存档或回放记录时，才说明节点标识、动作效果或状态含义的变动是否影响它们；需要时迁移或明确拒绝旧记录，不能当成新历史悄悄解释。不要为填清单给这个小切片新造存档、日志系统。说明实际改了什么、哪些仍未测试；修好这条反馈，不证明游戏已经有趣或所有分支都正确。

en: A source-range declaration and a deliberately bounded experience: what the slice preserves, what it excludes and what source or author decision would be needed to expand it. A small first build is not evidence of full-novel coverage.
Scope: `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`; source evidence: `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md`; selected concept: `concepts/CONCEPT.md`.
Design: `design/GAME_DESIGN.md` and `design/ART_DIRECTION.md`; build instructions: `build/BUILD_BRIEF.md`; candidate: `build/app/`.
Runtime record: `qa/verification.json` plus its referenced evidence; progress and next handoff: `_progress.md`.
Before expanding branches, use the [meaningful-choice example](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices) to turn one scene into actions, lasting state and distinct endings.
zh: 一份明确的来源范围与体验取舍：切片保留什么、不做什么，扩展还需要哪些来源或作者决定。首版做得小，不等于全书已经分析完。
范围：`PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`；原文证据：`analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md`；选定概念：`concepts/CONCEPT.md`。
设计：`design/GAME_DESIGN.md` 与 `design/ART_DIRECTION.md`；构建说明：`build/BUILD_BRIEF.md`；候选产物：`build/app/`。
运行记录：`qa/verification.json` 及其引用的证据；进度与下一交接：`_progress.md`。
扩展分支前，可参照[有后果的选择示例](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices)，把一个场景拆成行动、持久状态与不同结局。

en: The QA record uses `NOT_RUN`, `FAIL` or `PASS`. The six required checks are launch, render, input, coreLoop, outcome and restart; collect their evidence in one complete run rather than stitching unrelated partial successes together.
A PASS is limited to the recorded runtime, build and checked behavior. It does not certify fun, balance, commercial readiness or rights clearance.
Missing tools, provider access or an untested target remain explicit limitations. A validator fixture checks the record format; it is not evidence that your adaptation runs.
zh: QA 记录使用 `NOT_RUN`、`FAIL` 或 `PASS`。六项必检为 launch、render、input、coreLoop、outcome、restart；证据应来自同一次完整运行，不能拼接彼此无关的局部成功。
PASS 仅覆盖所记录的运行环境、构建与已检查行为，不认证趣味性、平衡性、商业发布准备程度或权利已清理。
工具、服务权限不足或目标环境未测试必须保留为明确限制。验证器样例只检查记录契约，不证明你的改编能够运行。

title.en: Export a video recap to JianYing / CapCut and keep editing
title.zh: 视频解说导出剪映 / CapCut 后，怎样继续精剪？

answer.en: To shorten a recap, move commentary away from an important line or correct captions, export the existing `timeline.json` as an editable draft rather than treating the finished MP4 as your only source. The normal recap timeline keeps source sound with the video clips, narration and optional music on audio tracks, and displayed captions as text. The standalone exporter does not rerun ASR, visual understanding or TTS, or render the whole recap MP4. Keep the media bundle with the draft and open it in your actual editor version; the exported files alone do not prove compatibility. The rehearsal example below shows two editorial choices, including what else must change when you move a voiceover.
answer.zh: 想缩短解说、把旁白让开关键原话，或修正字幕时，应把已有 `timeline.json` 导出成可编辑草稿，不要只拿最终 MP4 当全部素材。常规解说时间轴把原声保留在视频片段上，旁白与可选配乐放在音轨上，显示字幕则是文本。独立导出器不重跑 ASR、视觉理解或 TTS，也不重新渲染整部解说 MP4。媒体包要与草稿一起保留，并在你实际使用的编辑器版本中打开；导出文件本身不证明兼容。下方的排练示例比较两种精剪选择，也说明移动旁白时还需要一起处理什么。

en: A local checkout or installed skill directory containing `skills/video-assemble/scripts/export_jianying.py`, Python, ffprobe, and a completed `timeline.json` with accessible media references. Replace the `/ABS/` placeholders below. If no recap timeline exists yet, start with the [video-to-narration workflow](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration); a finished MP4 alone does not reconstruct its separate voice and caption tracks.

If starting before assembly, prepare the source video and `work_dir/tts_meta.json`. Local assembly needs ffmpeg; burned subtitles need its libass/subtitles filter. MiMo supplies remote ASR/VLM/default TTS; optional Fish Audio replaces TTS only.
A JianYing or CapCut desktop installation in which you can test the exported folder. Export is an optional sidecar; it is not required to render a recap MP4.

Decide the revision scope: the thought to keep, the source line or action that must remain audible/visible, and whether you are retaining the existing voice recording or requesting a new one. If a timeline explicitly requests reverse playback without a prepared reversed file, export can invoke local ffmpeg to create and bundle that material; this is not a no-media-processing guarantee.
zh: 本地仓库或已安装的 skill 目录中有 `skills/video-assemble/scripts/export_jianying.py`，已准备 Python、ffprobe、生成完毕的 `timeline.json`，且媒体引用可访问。替换下方 `/ABS/` 占位路径。尚无解说时间轴时，先从[视频解说完整流程](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration)开始；只有成片 MP4，不会自动重建分开的旁白和字幕轨道。
若尚未合成，先准备源视频与 `work_dir/tts_meta.json`。本地合成需要 ffmpeg；烧录字幕需要 libass/subtitles filter。MiMo 提供远程 ASR/VLM/默认 TTS；可选 Fish Audio 只替换 TTS。
能用于实际测试草稿的剪映或 CapCut 桌面安装。草稿是可选附加导出，不是渲染解说 MP4 的必要步骤。
先决定修改范围：要留下的意思、必须听见的原话或看见的动作，以及保留现有配音还是另外申请新配音。若时间轴明确要求倒放却没有已备好的倒放文件，导出可以调用本地 ffmpeg 生成并打包该素材；因此不是“绝不处理媒体”的承诺。

en: Choose export-only or assembly

With a completed `timeline.json`, use the standalone command below. It is the path for exporting the existing edit without rerunning assembly. If assembly has not happened yet, its separate `assemble.py` flow can also export a draft with `--export-jianying --jianying-out /ABS/drafts`, but it still performs its normal assembly work.
Preserve the right source

In cut mode, pass `--source-video /ABS/original.mp4` to the `assemble.py` command that creates `timeline.json`; this preserves real original-video intervals in the timeline. The standalone exporter then consumes that completed timeline and does not accept `--source-video`.
Export the existing edit, not a flattened substitute

Run the standalone command with the real timeline and read its returned `draft_dir` and warnings. It reads the timeline and referenced media, without calling MiMo/Fish or rendering the whole recap again. Do not substitute `result.mp4` for a missing original clip merely because the pictures look similar: that file can already contain the mixed voiceover and burned captions.
Keep the bundle together

Media bundling is on by default. Copy the whole output folder, including `Resources/local/`. Use standalone `--no-bundle-media` only if the editor can continue accessing the external media paths. Read warnings: missing media is not reported as successfully bundled.
Open in your target editor

Use your installed editor’s supported local-draft opening or import flow. Keep the returned draft directory intact and confirm its media, subtitles and audio tracks resolve; menus and draft locations vary by editor release.
Identify what each editable element actually contains

In the normal exported recap, video clips carry their original audio and volume keyframes; the exporter does not promise a separate clean dialogue stem. Narration and optional BGM are separate audio segments, and recap captions are text segments. A caption correction changes displayed text, not the words in its WAV. Hard captions already inside the source image cannot be removed by deleting an exported text segment.
Move the explanation, not the evidence

Decide what the viewer needs to hear or see before shortening. The worked rehearsal preserves a failed entrance, the instruction, a visible cue and the next entrance. Move commentary after that result, or omit it for an original-audio-led cut. Do not remove the cue to gain two seconds and then claim that the remaining cut still shows how the response followed it. For the earlier sound-planning decision, see [original audio and narration](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/original-audio-and-narration).
Keep voice, captions and volume changes consistent

When moving a recorded voiceover, move its corresponding caption cues and inspect original-audio and music keyframes at both the old and new positions. The exporter writes those positions; it does not actively re-duck the editor timeline afterward. If you change what is said, provide an approved replacement recording and retime it rather than only changing a caption or cutting off the old recording.
Choose which edit owns the final delivery

Keep the untouched export as a starting point and use the target editor’s supported copy/version flow for a finishing version. This exporter reads `timeline.json`; it does not read your edited desktop project back into that timeline, SRT, WAV or previously rendered MP4. Export the chosen finished version from the editor, or deliberately carry the decisions back to the pipeline inputs before a later render. Re-exporting the old timeline is not a way to recover the editor changes.
zh: 区分仅导出与重新合成
已有完整 `timeline.json` 时，用下方独立命令导出当前剪辑，不重跑合成。尚未合成时，另一条 `assemble.py` 流程也能通过 `--export-jianying --jianying-out /ABS/drafts` 附带导出草稿，但仍会执行正常合成工作。
保留正确源视频
cut 模式下，在生成 `timeline.json` 的 `assemble.py` 命令中传入 `--source-video /ABS/original.mp4`，让时间轴保留真实原片区间。之后独立导出器只读取这份已完成的时间轴，不接受 `--source-video` 参数。
导出已有剪辑，不用压平的成片冒充原素材
对真实时间轴运行独立命令，读取返回的 `draft_dir` 与警告。这条路径读取时间轴及引用媒体，不调用 MiMo/Fish，也不重新渲染整部解说。原素材缺失时，不要因为画面相似就改用 `result.mp4`：里面可能已经混入旁白并烧录字幕。
完整保留媒体包
默认开启媒体打包。移动时复制整个输出目录，包括 `Resources/local/`。只有编辑器仍能访问外部媒体路径时才使用独立导出器的 `--no-bundle-media`。注意读取警告：缺失媒体不会被记为已成功打包。
在目标编辑器中打开
使用已安装版本支持的本地草稿打开或导入方式，保持返回的草稿目录完整，并检查媒体、字幕和音轨是否可用；不同版本的菜单与草稿位置可能不同。
看清可编辑元素里到底是什么
常规导出的解说里，视频片段带着原声与音量关键帧，导出器不承诺另外拆出干净的人声轨。旁白、可选 BGM 是独立音频段，解说字幕是文本段。改字幕只改显示文字，不会改 WAV 里说的话；原画面已有的硬字幕也不能靠删除导出的文本段消失。
移动解释，不剪掉它所依赖的证据
先确定观众必须听见或看见什么，再缩短。排练示例保留一次没合上的起拍、原话、可见手势和下一次起拍；可以把解说移到结果后，也可以去掉解说做原声主导的短版。不要为了省两秒剪掉手势，却仍声称成片展示了回应如何跟随它。更前面的声音分工问题，见[原声与旁白指南](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/original-audio-and-narration)。
让配音、字幕与音量变化一起对齐
移动已有旁白时，一起移动它对应的字幕提示，并检查旧位置、新位置的原声音量和配乐关键帧。导出器写出这些位置后，不会在编辑器里持续自动重算压低原声的窗口。真要改说话内容，应准备作者接受的新录音并重排时长，而不是只改字幕或切掉旧录音的尾字。
确定哪一版负责最终交付
把未修改的导出留作起点，用目标编辑器支持的复制/版本方式建立精剪版。这个导出器读取 `timeline.json`，不会把桌面工程里的修改反向回写到该时间轴、SRT、WAV 或之前的 MP4。最终选择在编辑器中导出成片，或先把修改决定明确带回流程输入再另行渲染；重导出旧时间轴不会恢复编辑器里的修改。

example.en:
From an existing timeline (replace every /ABS path):
python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-assemble/scripts/export_jianying.py \
  /ABS/work/timeline.json \
  --out-dir /ABS/drafts \
  --name rehearsal_base

Read the returned draft_dir and any warnings.
Keep the entire draft folder and its Resources/local/ media together.

ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXERCISE — The Second Count-In
These are invented footage descriptions and edit placements, not real video, an exported
project or a measured TTS result. All times below are illustrative. English dialogue is
a meaning translation of the Chinese, not a timed English dub. Reuse real media only
when it actually contains these beats; do not invent missing shots to match this plan.

Viewer question: what changes between the two entrances?
The supplied fictional footage shows a guitar entering before the other players, a stop,
an instruction, a hand cue, and a second entrance that lands together. It does not show
that the whole rehearsal is finished, that the band has mastered the piece, or why anyone
made the first mistake.

Source time       → edited time       | picture and source sound
00:12–00:16        → 00:00–00:04        | first entrance does not land together; they stop
00:22–00:26        → 00:04–00:08        | “看我抬手，再进。” / “Watch my hand go up, then come in.”
00:26–00:28        → 00:08–00:10        | the leader raises a hand; the others wait
00:28–00:34        → 00:10–00:16        | second entrance, complete short phrase and its necessary audible release
00:34–00:38        → 00:16–00:20        | the phrase and its release are over; hands lower in the remaining room tone

The gap at source 00:16–00:22 is already omitted from this illustrative edit.
All edit decisions below use the right-hand clock, not the source-video timestamps.
The hand cue and second entrance stay consecutive in source order; no reaction from
another attempt has been substituted.

A problem deliberately placed in this example draft:
- A narration recording and its matching caption occupy edited 00:05–00:09.
- Chinese line: “抬手以后，第二次起拍合在了一起。”
  Meaning: “After the raised hand, the second entrance lands together.”
- For this placement exercise ONLY, assume that the complete existing recording is four
  seconds long. That is not an observed speaking time or a duration to force onto new TTS.
- The voiceover covers part of the instruction; original-audio volume keyframes also
  lower that region. Moving only the caption cannot make the instruction audible again.

A — KEEP A SHORT EXPLANATION, AFTER THE RESULT (illustrative 20-second edit)
1. Keep the failed start, complete instruction, hand cue and second phrase in order.
2. Move the complete four-second narration from 00:05–00:09 to 00:16–00:20, with its caption
   shifted by the same eleven seconds. It now comments on the result after the viewer
   has heard it, rather than speaking over the instruction.
3. Inspect the video clip’s original-audio keyframes: remove the obsolete reduction over
   the instruction where appropriate, preserve the audible entrance, and shape any new
   reduction/recovery around the late narration. Inspect optional music there too.
   A moved audio segment does not itself relocate keyframes on another segment.
4. If the actual recording or source phrase lasts longer than the illustrative window,
   enlarge or change the edit. Do not amputate a syllable, assume a silence, or hide the cue
   just to preserve the number “20.” The late shot must truly contain a usable settling beat.

B — LET THE RETRY SPEAK FOR ITSELF (illustrative 16-second editor cut)
1. Remove this added narration and its corresponding narration caption; do not delete
   unrelated captions indiscriminately. If original-dialogue captions exist, keep only
   those that match what remains audible. The standard recap text track is not a promise
   that every original line has already been transcribed into an editable caption.
2. Remove the 00:16–00:20 tail, not the instruction or the 00:08–00:10 cue.
3. Remove the now-unneeded original-audio reduction and listen to both entrances at normal
   speed. If music masks the comparison, lower or omit it rather than lifting every track.
   End after the complete second phrase, with enough audible release in the real footage.

A adds one retrospective explanation; B gives the audible comparison more responsibility.
Neither supports a title such as “They finally mastered the whole piece.” A narrower
editorial title is “Same opening, second try.” These are two author-selected cuts, not
built-in exporter presets, and this exercise supplies no finished recording or video.

When the correction is about WORDS, not placement:
Suppose an existing recording says “They finally mastered the whole piece.” Changing its
caption to the narrower claim would leave the unsupported spoken claim audible. Remove
that recording with its caption, or obtain a separately approved replacement and fit its
real duration. An export-only command does not synthesize the replacement voice.

Handoff note — plain editorial notes, not a required file format or a new feature:
Chosen version: A or B; record the decision, not both as one final cut.
Protected beats: first stop → complete instruction → hand cue → second phrase.
Changed elements: narration placement/removal, matching captions, source/music volume.
Working master: the named editor project, while the original export remains untouched.
Final deliverable: the render from that chosen edit, not the older pipeline MP4.
Still to judge in the real media: full spoken endings, cue visibility, phrase release
and whether the target editor opens the bundled media correctly.

Running the standalone exporter again reads its input timeline again. A new output folder
name does not make it include changes from the editor project. Keep the bundle intact and
record which version you actually chose to finish.
example.zh:
从已有时间轴导出（替换所有 /ABS 路径）：
python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-assemble/scripts/export_jianying.py \
  /ABS/work/timeline.json \
  --out-dir /ABS/drafts \
  --name rehearsal_base

读取返回的 draft_dir 与全部警告。
把完整草稿目录与其中的 Resources/local/ 媒体一起保留。

原创编辑练习——《第二次起拍》
以下是虚构的画面描述与剪辑位置，不是真实视频、已导出的工程或 TTS 实测结果。
所有时间仅用于说明剪辑关系，不能当作实际录音长度。真实素材确实包含这些拍点时
才采用相应方案，不要为了套例子补造不存在的镜头。

观众问题：两次起拍之间，什么发生了变化？
这份虚构素材里，吉他先于其他人进入，大家停下；随后有人发出指令、抬手，
第二次起拍合在一起。它没有证明整场排练已完成、整首曲子已熟练，也没证明
第一次失误究竟出于谁的什么心理。

原片时间          → 剪后时间          | 画面与原声
00:12–00:16        → 00:00–00:04        | 第一次起拍没合上，大家停下
00:22–00:26        → 00:04–00:08        | “看我抬手，再进。”
00:26–00:28        → 00:08–00:10        | 领拍的人抬手，其他人等着
00:28–00:34        → 00:10–00:16        | 第二次一起进入，奏完短乐句并留足必要余音
00:34–00:38        → 00:16–00:20        | 乐句及其余音已结束，手放下，只余现场底声

原片00:16–00:22这段已从示例剪辑中省略。下文的编辑操作都用右边的剪后时钟。
手势和第二次起拍保持原片中的相邻顺序，没有拿另一次尝试的反应镜头来替代。

给示例草稿故意放入一个问题：
- 一段旁白录音及其对应字幕位于剪后00:05–00:09。
- 旁白是：“抬手以后，第二次起拍合在了一起。”
- 只为讲清移动关系，假设这段已有完整录音长四秒；这不是实测语速，也不是
  要求新 TTS 硬塞进去的规定时长。
- 它盖住部分原话，视频片段的原声音量关键帧也压低了这个区域。
  只移动字幕，不会让那句指令重新听清。

A——保留一句解释，但放到结果之后（示意20秒版）
1．保留第一次没合上的起拍、完整指令、抬手与第二次短句的先后关系。
2．把完整四秒旁白从00:05–00:09移到00:16–00:20，对应字幕也整体后移十一秒。
   先让观众听到结果，再回看一句，不在发出指令时抢话。
3．检查视频片段的原声音量关键帧：按需解除指令处已经过时的压低，保住两次
   起拍的可听性，并处理新旁白位置的压低/恢复；有配乐时也检查那个位置。
   移动一段配音，不等于另一个片段上的关键帧会跟着搬家。
4．真实录音或原声短句比示意窗口长，就扩展或另选剪法；不要切尾字、假设有
   静默空隙，或为了凑“20秒”删掉手势。尾镜也必须真的有可用的收束过程。

B——让这次重来自己说话（示意16秒的编辑器短版）
1．删掉这段新增旁白及其对应的解说字幕，不盲目清空所有文本。
   若原声对白字幕已经存在，只保留与实际可听内容相符的部分；常规解说文本轨
   不等于已经为全部原声对白做好了可编辑字幕。
2．删的是00:16–00:20尾段，不是指令，也不是00:08–00:10的手势。
3．解除不再需要的原声压低，按正常速度听两次起拍。配乐遮住比较时，降低或
   去掉配乐，而不是把所有轨道一起拉响。实际结束点要在第二次乐句完整奏完、
   余音有足够收束之后，不能只照示例秒数硬切。

A 多留一句事后解释；B 让可听的比较承担更多叙事。两者都不足以支持
“他们终于练熟了整首曲子”这样的标题；更窄的编辑标题可以是“同一个开头，再来一次”。
这是作者选的两种剪法，不是导出器内置预设，也没有提供已生成的配音或成片。

如果错的是说话内容，而不只是位置：
假设已有录音说“他们终于练熟了整首曲子”，只把字幕改成较窄的判断，观众仍会
听到过度结论。应连同字幕去掉这段录音，或另外准备获准的新录音，再按真实时长
放置。仅导出草稿的命令不会替你合成新配音。

交接说明——普通编辑笔记，不是必需文件格式或新增功能：
选定版本：A 或 B，记下选择，不把两版同时当成最终稿。
保留拍点：第一次停下 → 完整指令 → 抬手 → 第二次短句。
修改元素：旁白移动/删除、对应字幕、原声/配乐音量。
当前母版：点名的编辑器工程；最初导出保留不动。
最终交付：从选定精剪版导出的成片，不是之前那份流程 MP4。
实际素材仍要判断：原话是否完整、手势是否可见、短句是否收住，目标编辑器能否
正确打开媒体包。

再次运行独立导出器，只会再次读取它的输入时间轴。换一个输出目录名，不会自动
带上编辑器工程中的修改。完整保留媒体包，并注明最后真正选中了哪一版。

en: The returned `draft_dir` contains `draft_content.json`, `draft_info.json` and `draft_meta_info.json`.
Bundled media goes under `Resources/local/video/`, `Resources/local/audio/` and `Resources/local/image/`; missing files remain explicit external references with warnings.
Non-empty output directories are not overwritten: export chooses a numbered sibling. This draft export is separate from the assembled MP4, subtitles and `timeline.json`.

The editor finishing version is a separate deliverable from the pipeline snapshot. Edited captions do not replace narration audio; a fresh draft exported from unchanged `timeline.json` does not contain the editor’s revisions. Keep the chosen project and the media it still references together.
zh: 返回的 `draft_dir` 包含 `draft_content.json`、`draft_info.json` 与 `draft_meta_info.json`。
打包媒体位于 `Resources/local/video/`、`Resources/local/audio/`、`Resources/local/image/`；缺失文件保留为带警告的外部引用。
不会覆盖非空输出目录，导出器会选择带编号的相邻目录。草稿导出与已合成的 MP4、字幕和 `timeline.json` 相互独立。
编辑器精剪版与流程快照是两份不同交付。改过的字幕不会替换旁白音频；未修改的 `timeline.json` 再导出一次，也不会包含编辑器里的修订。选定工程和它仍引用的媒体要一起保留。

en: Confirm the three draft JSON files and referenced media, then test opening in the exact desktop/region version you intend to use. A schema template version or a historical smoke test is not universal CapCut/JianYing compatibility.

For the rehearsal exercise, the instruction, cue and second entrance must remain in order and audible where needed. Check the original-audio keyframes at the old voiceover position as well as the new one, and compare the actual spoken words with their displayed captions. The illustrative 20/16-second alternatives are not measured output requirements.

Check voiceover endings, audio sync, original-audio transitions, BGM levels, subtitle line breaks and cuts. Drafts reference source media, so hard subtitles already present in that footage can remain and may need masking.
An export-only smoke test validates the local draft contract, not a remote generation run, a successfully opened desktop editor or the final rendered video.
zh: 检查三份草稿 JSON 与引用媒体，再在实际目标桌面/地区版本中测试打开。Schema 模板版本或历史 smoke test 不等于所有剪映/CapCut 版本都兼容。
针对排练练习，指令、手势、第二次起拍要保持顺序，并在需要处听得清。既看新旁白位置，也看旧位置的原声音量关键帧；把实际说的话与显示字幕对照。示意的20/16秒两版不是实测交付时长要求。
检查旁白尾字、音画同步、原声交接、BGM 音量、字幕断行与剪点。草稿引用源媒体，原素材已有的硬字幕可能仍在，需要时应遮罩。
只运行导出 smoke test 验证的是本地草稿契约，不证明已执行远程生成、桌面编辑器成功打开或最终成片正确。

title.en: Agent skills for writers: prompts, skill packs, plugins and MCP explained
title.zh: 不会编程也能用写作 Skill 吗？提示词、技能包、插件与 MCP 怎么分

answer.en: An agent skill packages task instructions and optional resources so a compatible AI agent can reuse a workflow. For a writer, that might mean turning an idea into an outline, importing an existing manuscript or revising a chapter against project notes—not writing software. Oh Story is a fiction-writing skill pack, not a new model or a standalone chat app. Start with the writing job you need done, then choose the host and workflow. Oh Story can stop at planning before drafting prose, but creating that plan still writes project files. The first-request example compares two concrete investigation openings in chat before the separate step of creating planning files; it keeps the author’s open decisions visible.
answer.zh: Agent Skill 把任务说明和可选的参考资料、脚本等打包，让兼容的 AI Agent 复用一套工作流程。对作者来说，任务可以是把灵感整理成细纲、导入已有小说，或结合项目设定修改章节，不一定是编程。Oh Story 是小说创作技能包，不是新模型，也不是独立聊天软件。先想清楚要完成哪项写作任务，再选运行环境与流程。Oh Story 可以只做规划、暂不写正文，但建立规划仍会写入项目文件。 首轮请求示例先在聊天里比较两个具体调查开端，再单独进入创建规划文件的步骤，并保留作者尚未作出的决定。

en: One concrete writing task and material you own or are authorized to use. A premise, a chapter needing revision or an unfinished manuscript is enough to choose a starting point.

For Oh Story, a configured supported agent host and a writing-project folder. You do not need to author code for the writing tasks below, but you do need to open the right folder, follow installation instructions and review requested file/tool access. If you prefer not to manage that setup, see the separate [hosted workbench](https://zenstory.ai/workbench).
zh: 一项具体写作任务，以及你拥有或获准使用的材料。一个故事点子、一章待修改的正文，或一部未完成的小说，都可以作为起点。
使用 Oh Story 需要先配置受支持的 Agent 宿主，并准备写作项目目录。下面的写作任务不要求你编写代码，但需要会打开正确的目录、按说明安装，并判断是否允许文件与工具操作。不想管理这套环境，可以了解独立的[托管写作工作台](https://zenstory.ai/workbench)。

en: Decide whether a prompt is enough

For “suggest five titles” or a one-off paragraph edit, a clear prompt may be all you need. Prompts can also be reusable templates. Consider a skill when you repeatedly paste the same process, refer to the same resources or need a consistent handoff between research, outlining and revision. Packaging makes the process reusable; it does not make every answer better.
Distinguish the instruction from the package

A skill has a SKILL.md entry with metadata and instructions, and may include references, templates or scripts. A compatible host discovers it and loads relevant instructions when needed. “Skill pack” is an informal name for a collection of related skills, not a separate object defined by the Agent Skills standard. Oh Story groups writing, import, analysis and revision tasks this way.
Separate the model, host, plugin and MCP connection

The model generates responses; the host runs the session and manages tools and permissions. In Claude Code, a plugin is a distribution container that can include skills, agents, hooks and MCP servers. MCP is a protocol for connecting AI applications to external data and tools, not a writing model or a synonym for a skill. These layers can work together; installing a skill does not train a new model.
Choose the entry by what you already have

Only an idea: use story-long-write to plan a long-form project, or story-short-write for a short story. Existing manuscript: follow the [import and continuation guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue) before asking for chapter 21, rather than starting from an empty project. A draft needing editorial feedback: use story-review; a passage needing less formulaic wording: use story-deslop and the [annotated prose revision example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose). Unsure which to pick? Ask the story router to choose. Oh Story specializes in Chinese web-fiction workflows; its rubrics are not universal standards for all fiction. If the premise is still loose, the first-reply example below asks for two concrete starts and their open choices without launching a project.
Install one matching route, then work in your book folder

The [Oh Story project page](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story) shows the npx skills installation path. In Claude Code, that path uses /story-setup, followed by a fresh session and /story. The Claude Code marketplace plugin has namespaced commands such as /oh-story:story-setup instead. Follow the path you actually installed; other hosts can use different command syntax and may not support the same hooks or specialist agents.
Can I plan the novel without having AI write it?

Yes: a new-book request such as /story-long-write 帮我开书 defaults to planning and stops before prose unless you also ask for a chapter or daily writing. This is not a read-only preview: it writes settings and outlines, then initializes tracking when the outline stage is complete. If you only want to compare ideas, ask in ordinary chat: “Discuss two possible structures in this reply only; do not start the new-book workflow or create or change files.” That is a requested boundary, not a separate skill mode or a guaranteed file-access restriction. A bare /story-long-write diagnoses the project and offers next steps; it does not itself deliver a full planning preview.
Ask for the whole-book structure, not every detailed chapter at once

Name the deliverables: the whole-book volume overview, volume outlines and the first batch of up to ten chapter outlines. The volume overview maps the larger direction; chapter outlines specify what characters do in the next stretch. Later details are built in rolling plot-unit batches, not implied by “plan the whole book.” An explicit chapter range can be delivered in successive batches. For an existing book, name the unfinished range instead of restarting the new-book workflow; use the scoped revision example in [outline to chapter](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter) to protect already agreed material.
Resolve author decisions without approving every small detail

In the coastal-mystery brief below, repairing old radios, family avoidance, close-third-person viewpoint and observable-clue rule are agreed constraints. The central mystery and the family’s role are still open. Ask for one or two alternatives and how each changes clues, character choices and the eventual reveal; do not let a proposed culprit become an established fact. The documented workflow allows incidental invention and records reusable additions within the agreed framework. Whole-book truths, mainline changes or conflicts with earlier decisions need the author’s ruling; affected material waits while independent planning can continue. Once you choose, have the decision saved in the relevant settings and finish the affected outlines before explicitly requesting prose. If the character card is detailed but the story still will not move, use [character motivation](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-motivation) to connect a goal, personal reason and habitual tactic to a concrete choice.
Continue the project, not just the conversation

On the next session, return to the same writing folder and ask what is already established and what comes next. Point to the exact chapter or passage when requesting revisions. Keep author preferences separate from facts about this book, and ask the agent to update the relevant project records rather than only acknowledging a correction in chat. For DeepSeek Harness, use the separate [DSH writing guide](https://zenstory.ai/dsh/deepseek-novel-writing).
zh: 先判断一句提示词是否已经够用
只是“想五个书名”或临时修改一段文字，一条清楚的提示词往往就够了；提示词也可以保存成可复用模板。如果你反复粘贴同一套步骤、反复提供同一批参考资料，或需要让拆文、列纲、修订之间有固定交接，再考虑 skill。打包让流程可复用，不等于每次回答都会更好。
分清指令与技能包
一个 skill 以 SKILL.md 为入口，包含元数据和任务说明，也可以附参考资料、模板或脚本。兼容宿主发现它后，按需加载相关说明。“Skill pack / 技能包”通常是一组相关 skills 的非正式叫法，不是 Agent Skills 标准另外定义的对象。Oh Story 就把写作、导入、拆解、修订等任务组织成一组技能。
把模型、宿主、插件和 MCP 分开看
模型负责生成回答；宿主负责运行会话、管理工具与权限。在 Claude Code 中，plugin 是分发容器，可以一起装入 skills、agents、hooks 和 MCP servers。MCP 是让 AI 应用连接外部数据和工具的协议，不是写作模型，也不是 skill 的同义词。这些层可以配合使用；装一个 skill 并不等于训练了一个新模型。
按手头材料选择入口

只有点子：长篇用 story-long-write 规划，短篇用 story-short-write。已有小说：按[导入续写指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue)重建项目，而不是在空目录里直接要求写第 21 章。已有正文想听编辑意见：用 story-review；只想改掉某段的套话和机械表达：用 story-deslop，并参考[带修改理由的前后对照](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose)。不知道该选哪个，就让 story 路由判断。Oh Story 侧重中文网文流程，它的评审尺度不是所有小说的通用标准。 点子还很松时，可先用下方首轮回复示例比较两个具体开端及其未决选择，不启动项目。
选一种匹配的安装方式，在自己的书稿目录里工作

[Oh Story 项目页](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story)提供 npx skills 安装方式。在 Claude Code 里，这条路径使用 /story-setup，完成后新开会话，再用 /story。Claude Code marketplace 插件则使用 /oh-story:story-setup 这样的命名空间命令。按实际安装路径使用命令，不要混用；其他宿主的语法以及 hooks、专用 agent 支持也可能不同。
能不能只让 AI 规划小说，不代写正文？

可以。新书请求如 /story-long-write 帮我开书，默认只做规划，在正文前停下；同次明确要求写章或日更才会进入正文。但这不是只读预览：会写入设定、大纲，并在大纲阶段完成后初始化追踪状态。如果只是想比较点子，用普通聊天说明：“只在本次回复里讨论两种结构，不启动开书流程，不创建或修改文件。”这是你提出的操作边界，不是另一个 skill 模式，也不是文件访问限制的保证。裸调用 /story-long-write 只诊断项目、列出下一步，不等于交付完整规划预览。
要全书结构，不等于一次铺完所有章级细纲

把交付物说具体：全书卷级鸟瞰、卷纲，以及首批最多十章细纲。卷级鸟瞰交代全书大方向，细纲说明接下来一段中人物具体做什么。后续按剧情单元滚动补纲，“规划整本书”不自动意味着一次写完所有章的细节；明确指定章节范围时，也可以分批连续交付。已有书稿应点名待补的区间，不要重新启动开书；用[从章纲到章节](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter)里的限定范围修订示例，保护已经确认的内容。
作者裁定关键选择，不必逐项批准所有小细节

下面的海港悬疑简报中，修收音机、回避家庭矛盾、第三人称限知与可观察线索，是已经确定的约束；核心谜底和家人与谜案的关系尚未确定。要求列出一至两个候选，说明各自怎样改变线索、人物选择和最后的揭示，不把候选嫌疑人直接当成既定事实。现有流程允许自由补充一次性细节，并在既定框架内为会复用的新设定建档；牵连全书的真相、主线变更或与旧裁定冲突的内容，要交作者决定。受影响部分等待裁定，其余规划可以继续。选定后先把决定落入相应设定，再补齐受影响细纲，最后才明确要求正文。 如果角色卡很详细、故事却仍推不动，接着看[人物动机指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-motivation)，把目标、在乎的理由和惯用办法连到具体选择。
续的是同一个项目，不只是同一段聊天
下次打开时，回到同一个写作目录，先询问已确定的内容与下一步。修订时指出具体章节或段落；把作者习惯与这本书的故事事实区分开，要求更新相关项目记录，而不是只在聊天里答应“记住了”。如果使用 DeepSeek Harness，接着看独立的[DSH 写作指南](https://zenstory.ai/dsh/deepseek-novel-writing)。

example.en:
In Claude Code, after the npx skills installation and /story-setup, open a fresh session in your writing folder. These are suggested requests, not recorded model output.

With only a premise, ask for one reply that helps you choose
You do not need a complete character dossier, final chapter count or software vocabulary before discussing the idea. Separate what you have decided, what remains open and what this reply should deliver. Start with an ordinary-chat comparison; “help me start a book” need not be a greeting.

A brief you can adapt:
“So far I have decided: a coastal setting, a protagonist who repairs old radios and avoids family conflict, close third person and observable clues without a supernatural solution. Length and the central mystery remain open. In this reply only, compare two investigation openings: what she does first, what resists her and what each option still needs me to decide. Do not start new-book planning or any other skill, scan rankings, research external sources, create or change files, or draft chapter prose. Label added people, objects and clues as proposals.”
This states the requested work boundary, not a special command or file-permission isolation; tool-enabled hosts still need their actual permission settings managed separately.

An original illustration of a first reply—not recorded software output
These openings are alternatives, not consecutive events in one story. The collection slip, customers and repair marks are new material proposed for this comparison, not established project settings.

Direction one: trace an object's history from a collection slip.
One proposed opening has a customer bring an old radio with a collection slip bearing a family member's name. She wants to establish whether the slip really belongs with this machine but avoids asking her family directly. She could begin by questioning the person who delivered it and checking a visible identifier. The obstacle is that the same name does not yet explain what the family member did.
The author still chooses whether the slip leads toward earlier safekeeping, repair or a transfer, and how the family was involved. A name alone is not evidence of falsification. This direction brings private relationship pressure into the investigation early.

Direction two: begin with two customers' conflicting accounts.
One proposed opening has two people claim the same old radio, each giving a detail related to a visible repair mark. The protagonist selects one checkable claim to question rather than vouching for whoever sounds more certain. Their accounts differ, but that need not mean one is true and the other false: the object may have changed hands.
The author still chooses which account she pursues first, what observable evidence exists and whether her family participated in a transfer. This direction first puts her in a face-to-face disagreement. Its family connection still needs design rather than remaining only in her character description.

This is enough for the first discussion: would you rather begin with a private relationship complicating an inquiry, or with the protagonist handling two people's disagreement? Each option supplies a first action, but neither settles the whole-book truth, the family’s role or the final reveal, and neither creates chapter outlines. Two openings are not a complete serial design. Choosing a direction does not automatically approve every proposed detail: people, objects and clues can be kept, rejected or left open, without settling them all in this first exchange.

What to do next instead of only saying “continue”
If undecided, name one comparison to develop: “Keep direction two's face-to-face disagreement and explain how it can press on her avoidance of family conflict. Still proposals only; do not make a new relationship an established fact.” The next reply need not redo the genre, character dossier and whole opening.
When ready to create a writing project, put your chosen direction into the new-book request below and list the central truth and family role that remain undecided. That request leaves both open for author decisions; replace those two lines with your actual rulings if you already have them, rather than marking them both fixed and pending. Choosing an investigation opening settles one direction, not the required settings and affected chapter outlines that precede an explicit prose request.

When ready to create planning files:
/story-long-write 帮我开书
Plan an original Chinese-language coastal mystery serial.
The protagonist repairs old radios and avoids confronting her family.
Use close third person. Clues must be observable; no supernatural solution.
Deliver the premise, character constraints, whole-book volume overview,
volume outlines and the first ten chapter outlines. Stop before prose.
Do not decide the central mystery or the family's role for me:
list one or two options and the affected outlines; pause affected material
until I choose, and continue independent planning.
At the stopping point, list files created or changed, the completed outline
range and pending author decisions. Say whether initial tracking has been
created; do not claim it is initialized if the outline stage is still incomplete.

If choices remain, resolve them first and explicitly ask to save the chosen
settings and complete the remaining planning—still no prose.
After reviewing and revising the completed plan:
/story-long-write 写第1章
Follow the agreed outline. Let the conflict emerge through dialogue and action.
Write only chapter 1, then summarize the changed project records.
example.zh:
在 Claude Code 中通过 npx skills 安装并完成 /story-setup 后，在写作目录新开会话。下面是建议请求，不是模型运行记录。

只有一个想法时，先要一轮能帮你作选择的回复
不必先补齐完整人设、全书章数和软件术语，才开始讨论。把已经决定的事、还没决定的事，以及这轮要什么结果分开写。下面先用普通聊天比较方向；不需要把“帮我开书”当成打招呼。

可以直接改这段请求：
“我暂时只确定：故事在海港，主角修旧收音机，遇到家庭矛盾时习惯回避。用第三人称限知、可观察的线索，不靠超自然力量解谜。篇幅和核心谜底还没定。只在本次回复中比较两种调查开端：主角先做什么，会碰到什么阻力，各有什么还要我决定。不要启动开书或其他技能，不扫榜、不查外部资料，不创建或修改文件，也不写章节正文。新增人物、物件和线索先标作提案。”
这是你提出的工作范围，不是特殊命令或文件权限隔离；有工具权限的宿主仍需按实际权限设置管理。

一份原创的首轮回复示意——不是软件运行结果
下面的两种开端是替代方案，不是同一故事连续发生的两件事。取件条、来客和修理痕迹都是本指南为比较而提出的新材料，还没成为项目设定。

方向一：从一张取件条追查来历。
候选开端是来客送来旧收音机，附着一张写有她家人姓名的取件条。她想先核对条据和机器是否真的对应，却不愿直接问家人。第一步可以向交件者追问来源，再核对可见编号；阻力是“同一个名字”还不能说明家人做过什么。
需要作者选择的是，这张条据要把调查引向保管、维修还是转赠的往事，以及家人以什么方式卷入。先不要把姓名当成作假的证据。这一方向把私人关系压力较早放到调查里。

方向二：从两位来客的不同说法开始。
候选开端是两人同时认领一台旧收音机，各自说出一个与机器上可见修理痕迹有关的细节。主角先选一项能够核对的说法追问，而不是凭谁说得笃定就替谁担保。阻力在于两个说法不同，却未必是一真一假；物件也可能经历过转手。
需要作者选择的是，哪种说法值得她先追查、可观察证据是什么，以及家人是否参与过转手。这一方向先给她一个当面处理分歧的处境；家庭联系仍要设计，不能只留在人物简介里。

首轮到这里就能讨论：你更想先写私人关系牵住调查，还是先写主角面对两个人的分歧？两版都有可做的第一步，但没有替你确定整部书的真相、家人角色或最终揭示，也没有生成章纲。这不是用两个开头冒充一整套连载设计。选方向不等于自动接受其中每项提案；具体人物、物件和线索仍可保留、拒绝或待定，首轮不必逐项定完。

接下来怎样用，而不是只回复“继续”
若还在犹豫，可以点名比较一个差异，例如：“保留方向二的当面对质，再说明它怎样逼近主角回避家人的问题；仍只是提案，不把新关系记成事实。”不必让下一轮把题材、人物卡和开头全部重做。
准备建立写作项目时，把自己选定的方向写进下面的开书请求，并列明仍未确定的谜底与家人角色。下方请求保留了这两项待裁定；如果你已经决定，就用自己的裁定替换那两行，不同时写成“已定”又“待定”。选择一个调查开端，只完成了一个方向选择；必要设定与受影响细纲仍要补齐，才到明确要求正文的步骤。

准备创建规划文件时：
/story-long-write 帮我开书
规划一部原创的中文海港悬疑连载。
主角修理旧收音机，遇到家庭矛盾时习惯回避。
第三人称限知视角，线索必须可观察，不用超自然力量解谜。
交付核心卖点、角色约束、全书卷级鸟瞰、卷纲和前十章细纲。
到这里停下，不要写正文。
核心谜底和家人与谜案的关系先不要替我定：列出一至两个候选，
说明影响哪些细纲；受影响部分等我选择，其余规划继续。
停下时列出创建或修改的文件、已完成细纲的章节范围，
以及尚待作者裁定的问题。说明初始追踪是否已创建；
大纲阶段尚未完成时，不要声称已经初始化。

还有未决问题时，先完成选择，并明确要求保存选定的设定、
完成剩余规划，仍不写正文。
读完并修改完整规划后：
/story-long-write 写第1章
按已确认的细纲推进，用对话和行动呈现冲突。
只写第一章，最后说明本次更新了哪些项目记录。

en: For the optional chat-only first request: two proposed openings, their first actions, obstacles and author choices. This is a comparison in the reply, not a manuscript, a saved project or completed whole-book planning.
Setup creates the host-specific skill/configuration files for the chosen installation. Those are the working environment, not the manuscript.

Planning files include settings, 大纲/大纲.md (the whole-book volume overview), 大纲/卷纲_第X卷.md (volume outlines) and separate 大纲/细纲_第XXX章.md chapter outlines. Report the range actually completed and unresolved decisions, not “the entire book is planned” if dependent sections are still pending.

After the outline stage is complete, including necessary author decisions and the affected outlines, the new-book workflow initializes a checkpoint, a continuation context card and empty clue/timeline views and directories. These are starting records, not evidence that chapters have been written. Planned reveals belong in outlines, not in tracking as events that already occurred. For an imported book, inspect its reconstructed project before asking for continuation.
Chapter continuity uses project records such as tracking state, not a promise that the model remembers every message. Preserve the writing folder and a backup of material you want to keep.

Once a chapter plan exists, use [outline to chapter](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter) to turn abstract plot labels into visible evidence, choices and consequences, without forcing a twist into every chapter.
zh: 可选的聊天首轮交付：两个候选开端、各自的第一步、阻力与作者选择。这是回复中的比较，不是书稿、已保存项目或已经完成的全书规划。
环境部署生成所选宿主的技能与配置文件。这些是工作环境，不是书稿本身。
规划文件包括设定、全书卷级鸟瞰 大纲/大纲.md、卷纲 大纲/卷纲_第X卷.md，以及逐章独立的 大纲/细纲_第XXX章.md。交付时说明实际完成的章节范围和未决问题；依赖裁定的部分还没完成，就不能笼统说“整本规划已完成”。
必要的作者裁定完成、受影响细纲补齐，大纲阶段完成后，新书流程才初始化检查点、续写状态卡，以及空的伏笔/时间线视图与目录。这些是起始记录，不表示正文已经发生；未来揭示留在大纲，不当作已发生事件写入追踪。已有小说导入后，先读重建的项目材料，再要求续写。
章节连续性依靠追踪状态等项目记录，不靠“模型记得每句话”的承诺。保留写作目录，并备份需要保存的材料。
已有章纲时，接着看[从章纲到章节](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter)：把剧情标签变成可见证据、选择与后果，不给每章硬塞反转。

en: Read for the intended scene, character choices and continuity before accepting a chapter. A completed workflow is not a guarantee of literary quality, detector scores or publication acceptance.
Review installation trust and model/service configuration separately. Open-source skills are not free model access, and files on your computer do not imply offline inference.
zh: 接纳一章前，先读场景是否成立、人物选择是否可信、前后事实是否一致。流程完成不保证文笔、检测器分数或投稿通过。
安装信任与模型、服务配置需要分别判断。开源技能不等于免费模型额度，文件放在本机也不等于推理离线。
