title.en: Writing a novel with DeepSeek: choose a workspace and continue your draft
title.zh: 用 DeepSeek 写小说：选对工作区，从已有稿件接着写

answer.en: Choose by where the writing needs to live. Use an ordinary DeepSeek model chat for a disposable brainstorm, outline critique or scene rewrite that you will copy into your own manuscript. Use DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plus the community Oh Story DSH plugin when you want a local writing folder, persistent sessions, creation skills and a file/editor/Chat workbench. Use the separate hosted ZenStory service at app.zenstory.ai when you want an account-based browser project instead of running DSH locally. These are different layers: DeepSeek is the model/provider choice, DSH is the agent host, `@oh-story/dsh` is a community plugin for that host, and hosted ZenStory is a separate application. Installing the plugin does not add it to an ordinary DeepSeek chat, and this guide does not claim that hosted ZenStory natively uses DeepSeek. For the broader difference between chat, skills and agents, see [AI agent skills for writers](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers); for a field-by-field comparison of the three ZenStory AI writing environments, see [the workflow comparison](https://zenstory.ai/compare/writing-workflows). Already have a draft? Start with the latest accepted manuscript, the last complete chapter and any unfinished tail—not a bare “continue.” The worked archive mystery below shows how to turn those materials into a next-scene choice before importing or changing files.
answer.zh: 按作品需要保存在哪里来选。只想临时脑暴、点评大纲或改一段文字，并准备自己复制回稿件，用普通 DeepSeek 模型聊天即可；希望围绕本地写作目录持续创作，由会话、Skills 和文件/编辑器/Chat 工作台共同管理项目，可选 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）加社区插件 Oh Story DSH；不想在本地运行 DSH，而想用账户化的浏览器项目，则选独立的 ZenStory 托管服务 app.zenstory.ai。四者不是同一层：DeepSeek 是模型/Provider 选择，DSH 是 Agent 宿主，`@oh-story/dsh` 是装进该宿主的社区插件，ZenStory 托管版是另一套应用。安装插件不会把它装进普通 DeepSeek 聊天，本指南也不声称 ZenStory 托管版原生使用 DeepSeek。 若要先理解聊天、Skills 与 Agents 的通用差异，可阅读[写作者的 AI Agent Skills 指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)；若要逐项比较 ZenStory AI 的三种写作环境，可查看[工作流对比](https://zenstory.ai/compare/writing-workflows)。 已有稿件时，先交代当前确认版、最后完整章与尚未完成的尾稿，不要只说“继续写”。下方的档案悬疑示例把这些材料转成有代价的下一场戏选择，再决定是否导入或改文件。

en: For ordinary chat, bring only the excerpt and constraints needed for that one task. Keep your own manuscript as the durable source; a chat answer is not automatically synchronized with a writing project.

For the local DSH route, use Node.js 24+ and a folder you are comfortable granting to the DSH workspace. The pinned installation below uses DSH `0.1.5-rc.1` and the community plugin `@oh-story/dsh@0.1.9`.

Configure a model/provider in DSH before asking it to generate text. The source supports adding a provider and API key under Settings → Models, or setting `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` before launch. DSH owns models, credentials, permissions and sessions; the plugin does not read those credentials.

For hosted ZenStory, use `https://app.zenstory.ai` as a separate account-based workflow. Do not expect a local DSH workspace, DSH plugin installation or ordinary DeepSeek chat history to appear there automatically.

For an existing draft, keep a separate backup and name the manuscript files, any unfinished chapter, and the relevant settings or old plan. A discarded outline is not an event in the story. State whether this turn may only discuss options, create planning files, or change prose.
zh: 使用普通聊天时，只带上这次任务所需的片段和约束，并由你自己保管权威稿件；聊天回答不会自动同步到写作项目。
使用本地 DSH 路线时，准备 Node.js 24+，以及一个愿意交给 DSH workspace 管理的作品目录。下方固定版本安装使用 DSH `0.1.5-rc.1` 与社区插件 `@oh-story/dsh@0.1.9`。
让 DSH 生成文本前先配置模型/Provider。源码说明可以在“设置 → 模型”中添加 Provider 和 API Key，或在启动前设置 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。模型、凭据、权限和会话由 DSH 管理，插件不读取这些凭据。
ZenStory 托管版位于 `https://app.zenstory.ai`，属于独立的账户化流程。不要预期本地 DSH workspace、插件安装或普通 DeepSeek 聊天历史会自动出现在其中。
已有稿件时先留独立备份，点名原稿文件、未完成章节，以及相关设定或旧续写设想。没有采纳的细纲不是故事里已经发生的事；说明本轮只讨论、可以写规划文件，还是允许修改正文。

en: Pick the smallest environment that matches the job

For one question—three premise variants, feedback on a synopsis, or a rewrite of one supplied scene—ordinary chat keeps setup low. For an 80,000-word draft or a serial whose settings, chapter plans, prose and continuity must survive later sessions, consider DSH plus the plugin. If the manuscript should live in an account-based browser project and you do not want to run a local DSH process, use hosted ZenStory. If you already use another supported coding-agent host, follow the separate [agent-skills guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers) rather than assuming the DSH plugin installs there.
Install the community plugin in DSH Web

Run the versioned command in the example. It temporarily supplies pnpm because DSH's `plugin add` needs it, installs `@oh-story/dsh` into the `web` profile, and then starts DSH Web. Keep the terminal running. If a browser does not open, use the complete local URL printed by DSH; do not share its first-auth token.
Configure the model at the host layer

In DSH, add the provider and model under Settings → Models, or start DSH with `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` present when that is the provider you intend to use. This configuration belongs to DSH, not to the Oh Story plugin. Viewing existing work can be deferred without a model key, but generating new prose requires a configured model.
Open the writing folder before prompting

Use the plus button beside Workspaces, add the folder that should own the novel, choose that workspace and open a session. An empty folder initially stays in native DSH Chat. The novel workbench appears after recognized story files are created; a visible tab is a view of the same DSH workspace, not a second agent or a ZenStory account.
New book: start with a bounded brief

Use `/story-long-write 帮我开书` (or the English intent in the example) and state genre, reader promise, protagonist, central pressure, length target, viewpoint, tone, hard exclusions and the desired stopping point. The bundled workflow's default opening path creates the project, core settings, volume outline and the first ten chapter blueprints, then stops before prose. Review the direction instead of asking for an entire novel in one turn.
New chapter: name the chapter and its ending

After approving the setup, explicitly request `/story-long-write 写第1章`. Check the actual file under `正文/`, its matching file under `大纲/`, and the relevant settings rather than judging only the chat summary. Give corrections as concrete constraints—what fact, voice, reveal boundary or ending beat must change—then request a revision of the named chapter.
Existing draft: discuss the next scene before importing

In the same workspace, name only the manuscript and setting files needed for the question. Ask for accepted facts, what the viewpoint character knows, unresolved hypotheses and two possible next scenes. Mark the unfinished tail separately. A plain Chat-only request can prohibit file creation, moves, prose generation and media calls; this discussion does not initialize a novel project or make a new workbench appear. In the example, recognizing a handwriting habit creates a question, not proof of who wrote the entry.
Choose discussion, full import or an existing project

Keep a one-scene discussion in Chat if that is all you need. For a standalone manuscript that you want to turn into a writing project, the bundled `/story-import` accepts text files, a directory or pasted text, confirms scope and whether the last chapter is complete, then requires the full analysis pipeline before migration. It is not a lightweight “load this fragment” operation. Choose whether to continue from the unfinished chapter or finish it before importing. If the book already has current-format `追踪/_tracking-state.json`, confirm the active book instead of re-importing it. DSH supplies the bundled roles; do not deploy another host’s agent directories for this route.
Choose a consequence, then request the right kind of writing

Choose between next scenes by what the protagonist must risk or give up, not by which sounds more dramatic. Separate approval of a new chapter plan from permission to write prose. A genuinely new chapter can use `/story-long-write 写第N章`; an existing partial chapter needs an explicit revision/completion request with its opening protected, not an assumed empty target. The bundle defaults to one named chapter, but daily continuation can mean two or three; say which chapter and where to stop. Reopen the same workspace on later visits and back up manuscript files separately from DSH profile configuration.
zh: 按任务选择最小够用的环境

只问一个问题——例如给出三个梗概、点评简介或改写你提供的一场戏——普通聊天准备最少。已有八万字稿件，或需要让设定、逐章细纲、正文与连续性状态跨会话保留的连载，可选 DSH 加插件。希望稿件位于账户化网页项目、又不想在本地运行 DSH，则用 ZenStory 托管版。若本来就在其他受支持的 coding-agent 宿主里工作，请按单独的 [Agent Skills 指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)选择，不要假设 DSH 插件也能直接装进去。
在 DSH Web 中安装社区插件
运行示例中的固定版本命令。命令临时提供 pnpm，因为 DSH 的 `plugin add` 会用到它；随后把 `@oh-story/dsh` 装入 `web` profile，并启动 DSH Web。终端需要保持运行。浏览器没有自动打开时，使用 DSH 在终端打印的完整本地地址，但不要分享其中用于首次认证的 token。
在宿主层配置模型
在 DSH 的“设置 → 模型”中添加 Provider 和模型；如果准备使用对应的 DeepSeek Provider，也可以在启动 DSH 前提供 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。这是 DSH 的配置，不是 Oh Story 插件的配置。查看已有作品可以稍后再配模型，但生成新文本需要可用的模型配置。
先打开作品目录，再发写作请求
点击 Workspaces 旁的加号，添加真正存放小说的目录，选中 workspace 并打开会话。空目录起初仍显示 DSH 原生 Chat；Agent 写出可识别的小说文件后，小说工作台才会出现。这个标签只是同一 DSH workspace 的视图，不是第二个 Agent，也不是 ZenStory 账户。
从零开书：给出有边界的请求
输入 `/story-long-write 帮我开书`，并写清题材、读者承诺、主角、核心压力、预计篇幅、视角、语气、明确禁区和本轮停靠点。内置流程默认先建立项目、核心设定、卷纲与首批十章细纲，然后停在正文前。先审方向，不要一轮要求生成整本小说。
写新章：点名章节与停笔点
确认设定和细纲后，再明确输入 `/story-long-write 写第1章`。检查 `正文/` 中的实际章节、`大纲/` 中对应细纲及相关设定，不要只看 Chat 摘要。修改意见要落到可执行约束：哪个事实、人物声音、信息揭示边界或章尾节拍需要变化，然后点名要求修改该章。
已有稿件：先谈下一场戏，不急着导入
在同一 workspace 中点名这次需要的原稿和设定，先要求列出已确认事实、视角人物所知、未解假设，再给两个续写方向；未完尾稿单独标注。自然语言的 Chat-only 请求可以明确禁止创建或移动文件、生成正文及调用媒体服务；这轮讨论不会初始化小说工程或让新工作台自动出现。示例里，“认出一种笔迹习惯”提出了问题，不等于已经证明是谁写的。
区分只讨论、完整导入与已有工程

只想讨论一场戏，就留在 Chat。松散原稿需要变成可续写工程时，随包 `/story-import` 支持文本文件、目录或粘贴文本，先确认范围和尾章是否完整，再经过完整拆解管道迁移；它不是“轻量载入这段文字”。尾章未完时，由作者选择基于残章续写，还是先补完再导入。如果书目已有当前格式的 `追踪/_tracking-state.json`，先确认当前书目，不重复完整导入。这一路线的专业角色由 DSH 随包提供，不要为了导入而部署其他宿主的 Agent 目录。
先选行动代价，再明确写作范围

比较续写方向时，看主角要冒什么风险、放弃什么，而不只是哪个更刺激。批准新细纲与允许写正文是两件事；确实尚不存在的新章可用 `/story-long-write 写第N章`，已有残稿则要明确提出修改/补完、保护开头，不把目标当空白文件。随包流程的指定章默认一章，日更续写却可能默认两到三章，因此要点名章节与停笔点。以后回到同一 workspace 继续，稿件文件与 DSH profile 配置分别备份。

example.en:
Suggested input — original example, not an observed model answer:

Terminal — install the pinned plugin and start DSH Web:
npx -y --package pnpm@11.7.0 --package @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1 dsh plugin --profile web add @oh-story/dsh@0.1.9 &&
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1 web

In the DSH session for your chosen empty workspace:
/story-long-write 帮我开书
Create a 240,000-word near-future mystery serial for adult readers.
Premise: a municipal archivist discovers that one ordinary resident disappears from every public record at 02:17 each night, but her handwritten corrections return by morning.
Reader promise: procedural investigation plus the cost of deciding which version of a person deserves to survive.
Protagonist: meticulous, conflict-averse, and personally implicated by a missing sibling.
Use close third person, restrained prose, and no omniscient explanation of the system in the opening volume.
For this turn, create the project settings, volume outline and first ten chapter blueprints only. Stop before prose and list the files created.

After reviewing the plan:
/story-long-write 写第1章
Use the approved chapter blueprint. Write only chapter 1, preserve the reveal boundary, and end when the protagonist sees correction handwriting with the same missing-stroke habit as her own in a file she has never opened; do not yet establish who wrote it. Save the prose in the project; do not continue to chapter 2.

EXISTING-DRAFT EXERCISE — original editorial fiction, not generated output
The archivist is named Ji Ning for this worked example. The following are excerpts,
not a complete chapter or actual workspace files. Replace the illustrative paths
with your own files; give the agent the full relevant manuscript, not just this exercise.

Materials supplied by the author:
- 原稿/第001章.md: accepted, complete chapter 1; the ending below is its final beat.
- 原稿/第002章_未完.md: an unfinished opening, not a completed chapter 2.
- 参考/旧续写设想.md: an unaccepted proposal, not manuscript evidence.
- 参考/本书设定.md: the approved brief, including the missing sibling and limited viewpoint.

Accepted chapter 1 ending:
Ji Ning opened file 417 for the first time. At the foot of the page,
the handwritten Chinese word 更正, “correction,” caught her eye: the final stroke
of 更 was missing, exactly the habit she had never managed to change.

Unfinished chapter 2 opening:
She pushed the request card toward the desk. The duty clerk held it down.
“To request the original register, you have to leave your employee number.”
Ji Ning held her pen just above the signature box.
[The author stopped here. No signature, submitted request or register access yet.]

Old, unaccepted chapter 2 proposal:
“Steal the original register from storage and confirm that her missing sibling
forged the handwriting.” This is a possible plot proposal, not evidence already
established; adopting it would change the proposed investigation and reveal timing.

First request — natural-language Chat only, no writing skill needed:
Read only the four named files. Chapter 1 is complete; chapter 2 is unfinished.
Separate accepted events, the partial chapter’s proposed situation, and old planning.
What does Ji Ning actually know? What is she merely suspecting?
Give two ways to pursue the original register without confirming the writer’s identity.
For each, name her action, the resistance and the visible change by the scene’s end.
Keep close third person; no omniscient explanation, automatic access or off-page signature.
Reply only in Chat. Do not create, move or edit files, generate prose or call media services.

Editorial reading of these materials — not a claim about an agent’s response:
- Chapter 1 establishes a recognizable handwriting habit in a file she had not opened.
  It does not prove that she wrote it, that her sibling forged it, or that time travel occurred.
- The partial opening places a pen above a box. Even within that fragment she has not signed.
  The clerk states a requirement; this excerpt alone does not prove a universal archive rule.
- If the author retains that opening, chapter 2 starts with an unresolved decision.
  Until completed, its events must not be treated as a completed chapter in tracking.
- The investigation can advance without identifying the writer: obtain a traceable request,
  or make another person confront the question. Neither is the same as receiving the register.

Two NEW candidate scene plans — fictional choices, not existing project facts:
A. Accept personal exposure. Ji Ning signs her own employee number and states that she
   wants to check the correction handwriting. The clerk accepts the request and gives
   a receipt number, not the register. She gains a way to follow up, but the signed
   request now connects her to the investigation. End on the handover itself;
   do not imply that access has been granted or that anyone has identified the writer.
B. Seek a witness without signing. Ji Ning asks the clerk to look at the disputed page
   with her. He refuses to assess it on his own and reaches for the phone to call a supervisor.
   End before a call connects: she has not obtained access, and keeping the inquiry quiet
   now requires her to respond to another person’s initiative. The clerk need not recognize
   her handwriting, know the secret, or be a villain for this resistance to work.

Choose A if this chapter should make a conflict-averse investigator take responsibility
in her own name. Choose B if it should put her attempt at secrecy under immediate social
pressure. They are alternative plans, not two events to silently combine.

An editorial candidate ending for A — a short prose illustration, not a full chapter,
an accepted manuscript change or an observed DSH result:
“Reason for the request?”
Ji Ning lowered the pen and wrote her employee number in the signature box.
Below it she added: Check the correction handwriting.
She pushed the signed card across. The clerk tore off the receipt. An application number; no access decision.
She folded the slip. The signed request stayed on his side of the desk.
This resolves whether she puts her name to the inquiry, not who wrote the correction.

Before writing — choose the material state:
If these are still standalone files, either keep discussing them or explicitly choose
full import. For import, confirm the scope, target book and unfinished-tail strategy first;
choose “continue from the partial chapter” if retaining it. Notes under 参考/ are separate
from the manuscript source directory. Do not describe a Chat discussion as completed import.
For an already initialized, current-format project, do not import the book again.

After the project is ready, a planning-only request:
/story-long-write 补纲
I choose A and retain the unfinished opening. Plan only chapter 2; stop before prose.
Do not adopt the unaccepted theft/forgery proposal. I authorize setting the chapter 2 plan
to the signed-request scene.
Do not change other chapters, the accepted chapter 1, or established tracking facts.
The receipt records a submitted request, not granted access. Keep the writer’s identity unknown.

After reviewing that plan, when a chapter 2 partial file already exists:
/story-long-write 修改第2章
This is an unfinished chapter, not a request to skip ahead or overwrite a blank new chapter.
First identify and back up its actual file; show the opening you will preserve and the
proposed completion boundary. Wait for my confirmation before changing prose.
Then complete only chapter 2 using the approved A plan. Preserve the existing opening;
end with the signed request handed over and a receipt, without access or identity confirmation.
Do not rewrite chapter 1, count the old fragment as a finished chapter, or continue to chapter 3.
If the actual files or tracking disagree with this description, report the conflict first.

If no chapter 2 prose file exists at all, use the named-new-chapter route instead.
The distinction depends on the actual files, not just on what the last Chat message said.
example.zh:
建议输入——以下为原创示例，不是实测模型回答：

终端——安装固定版本插件并启动 DSH Web：
npx -y --package pnpm@11.7.0 --package @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1 dsh plugin --profile web add @oh-story/dsh@0.1.9 &&
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1 web

在你选定的空 workspace 对应 DSH 会话中输入：
/story-long-write 帮我开书
写一部约 24 万字、面向成年读者的近未来悬疑连载。
核心梗：市档案员发现，每晚 02:17 都有一名普通居民从全部公共记录中消失，但她手写的修订次日又会恢复。
读者承诺：程序化调查，以及“哪个版本的人值得留下”带来的选择代价。
主角：严谨、回避冲突，并因失踪的手足与事件有私人关联。
使用第三人称限知和克制文风；第一卷不得全知解释系统真相。
本轮只建立项目设定、卷纲和首批十章细纲，停在正文前，并列出创建的文件。

检查并确认计划后输入：
/story-long-write 写第1章
严格使用已确认的本章细纲，只写第 1 章，保留信息揭示边界；在主角发现一份从未打开的档案里出现了与她有相同缺笔习惯的修订笔迹时收尾；此时不证明是谁写的。正文写入项目文件，不要继续第 2 章。

已有稿件练习——原创编辑示例，不是生成结果
这次给档案员取名“纪宁”。下文只是相关摘录，不是完整章节，也没有创建真实
workspace 文件。实际使用时换成你的真实文件名，并提供相关完整原稿，不只给这份练习。

作者提供的材料：
- 原稿/第001章.md：作者已确认的完整第一章，以下摘录就是章尾。
- 原稿/第002章_未完.md：未完成的开头，不是已经写完的第二章。
- 参考/旧续写设想.md：没有采纳的提议，不是正文证据。
- 参考/本书设定.md：已确认的创作简报，包括失踪手足与限知视角。

已确认的第一章末尾：
纪宁第一次翻开417号档案。页脚那行“准予更正”里，“更”字少了最后一捺，
正是她多年改不掉的写法。

第二章未完开头：
她把调阅卡推到窗口。值班员压住卡片：“申请调原始登记，得留你的工号。”
纪宁把笔尖停在签名栏上方。
［作者写到这里停下。尚未签字、递交申请或拿到登记册。］

旧的、尚未采纳的第二章设想：
“潜入保管室偷走原始登记册，确认是失踪的手足伪造了笔迹。”
这是剧情提议，不是已经成立的证据；采纳它会改变调查方式与揭示时机。

第一轮请求——自然语言 Chat 讨论，不必启动写作 Skill：
只读上述四份文件。第一章已完，第二章未完。
分开列出已确认事件、残稿提出的当前情境，以及旧规划。
纪宁实际知道什么，又只是在怀疑什么？
给出两个继续追查原始登记的方向，不确认笔迹作者。
每个方向说明她采取什么行动、遇到什么阻力、场末发生什么可见变化。
保持第三人称限知，不全知解释，不自动获准调阅，不跳过签字动作。
只在 Chat 回复，不创建、移动或修改文件，不生成正文，不调用媒体服务。

编辑对材料的阅读——不是声称 Agent 已经这样回答：
- 第一章确立了：她在从未翻开的档案里认出一种笔迹习惯。
  尚不能推出“就是她写的”“手足伪造”或“发生了时间穿越”。
- 残稿停在笔尖悬空；即使只看这个片段，她也还没签字。
  值班员说需要工号，不等于这一摘录已证明整座档案馆的统一制度。
- 作者若保留这个开头，第二章要接住的是尚未作出的决定；章没完成前，
  不能把残稿情节当成已完成章节写入追踪检查点。
- 调查不必马上查明笔迹作者也能前进：留下可追问的申请，或让另一个人
  面对这个疑点；这两者都不等于已经拿到登记册。

两个新增的候选场景——虚构创作选择，不是项目已有事实：
A．承担署名代价。纪宁签下自己的工号，写明要核对修订笔迹；值班员收下申请，
   给的是回执编号，不是登记册。她获得了可追问的线索，也让签名把自己与调查
   联系起来。章尾落在交出申请：动作已经做出，但不能暗示调阅已获批或身份已查明。
B．不签字，先求一个见证。纪宁请值班员和她一起看有疑点的那一页。
   他不愿独自判断，伸手拿电话准备叫主管。停在尚未接通时：她没有取得调阅权，
   想悄悄调查却必须应对另一个人的主动行动。值班员不必认得她的笔迹、知道秘密，
   更不必先被写成反派，这个阻力就可以成立。

选 A，是让回避冲突的主角第一次用自己的名字承担调查；选 B，是让她保密的打算
受到当场的人际压力。它们是两种方案，不是可以悄悄拼成一段既成剧情的两个事件。

A 的候选收束——仅为编辑写的短段示意，不是完整章、已采纳的改稿或 DSH 实测输出：
“申请理由？”
纪宁让笔尖落下，在签名栏写完自己的工号。
她在下面补了一行：核对修订笔迹，再把签好的卡片推过去。
值班员撕下回执。上面只有申请编号，没有调阅结果。
她折好纸条，签过工号的申请留在窗口里面。
这里回答的是“她是否署名追查”，不是“谁写了那行修订”。

准备落稿前——先区分材料状态：
如果仍是松散文件，可以继续只讨论，也可以明确选择完整导入。导入前先确认范围、
目标书目和尾稿策略；要保留开头就选“基于残章续写”。参考/下的规划笔记要与原稿
目录分开。不要把 Chat 讨论说成已经导入；已有当前格式工程则不重复导入整本书。

工程准备好之后，先只规划：
/story-long-write 补纲
我选 A，保留残稿开头。本轮只规划第二章，停在正文前。
不要采纳未确认的旧第二章续写设想。我授权将本章细纲定为署名申请这一场戏。
其他章、已确认的第一章和既有追踪事实不变。
回执只说明申请已递交，不代表调阅获批；笔迹作者仍然未知。

审过细纲后，如果第二章的残稿文件已经存在：
/story-long-write 修改第2章
这是未完成章节，不是要求跳到下一章，也不是覆盖一个空白新章。
先定位并备份实际文件，列出将保留的开头和本次补完边界；等我确认后再改正文。
然后只按已确认的 A 方案补完第二章，保留已有开头；在交出署名申请、拿到回执时
收尾，不获得调阅权、不确认笔迹作者。
不重写第一章，不把原残稿算成已经完成第二章，不继续第三章。
真实文件或追踪状态如果与这些描述冲突，先报告。

如果实际上根本没有第二章正文文件，才用“写第2章”的新章入口。
区分依据是真实文件，不只是上一条 Chat 消息说了什么。

en: After the default book-opening pass, expect creator-readable files for positioning and relationships under `设定/`, a book and volume outline plus per-chapter blueprints under `大纲/`, and initialized continuity state under `追踪/`. The bundled workflow says the first pass normally stops after the first ten chapter blueprints.

After an explicit chapter request, prose is written by chapter under `正文/` (for example `正文/第001章_章名.md`) and the continuity views are updated through the writing workflow. The manuscript file, not a celebratory chat message, is the deliverable to review.

The DSH novel workbench presents the same project as a file tree, editor and Chat. Hosted ZenStory also uses a browser workbench, but it is a separate account/application boundary; neither surface name proves that the same plugin, model or project files are underneath.

For full import, manuscript text is migrated without rewriting the source content. A partial chapter can be present in the prose files while `last_chapter` and current-state snapshots still end at the last complete chapter; the unfinished-tail strategy belongs in continuity risks. File presence does not certify chapter completion.
zh: 默认开书完成后，通常会得到 `设定/` 下供作者阅读的题材定位与关系等文件，`大纲/` 下的全书/卷级大纲和逐章细纲，以及 `追踪/` 下初始化的连续性状态。内置流程说明第一轮默认停在首批十章细纲之后。
明确请求写章后，正文按章写入 `正文/`（例如 `正文/第001章_章名.md`），连续性视图也由写作流程更新。需要审的是稿件文件，而不是 Chat 中一句“已经完成”。
DSH 小说工作台用文件树、编辑器和 Chat 呈现同一项目。ZenStory 托管版也有浏览器工作台，但它属于独立账户与应用边界；界面都叫工作台，不代表底层使用同一插件、模型或项目文件。
完整导入会迁移原文而不改写其内容。残章可以出现在正文文件中，但 `last_chapter` 与当前状态快照仍截至最后完整章，尾稿处理策略写入连贯性风险。文件存在不代表该章已经完成。

en: Before continuing, open the files named in the completion message and confirm that the premise, viewpoint, exclusions, reveal boundary and chapter stopping point are actually present. A workbench tab or a fluent answer alone is not proof that the project was updated.

For the archive exercise, look for the actual decision: if A was chosen, the signature and submitted request must happen on the page. A receipt must not silently become access to the register; recognition of handwriting must not become proof of its writer. Confirm whether chapter 2 is now complete from the manuscript and resulting project state, not merely because a chapter 2 file exists.
Reopen the same workspace in a later session and ask for a project-state diagnosis before generation. Confirm the last completed chapter and next blueprint, then request only the scope you want.

Treat model output as a draft: review continuity, copied or unsupported material, factual claims and publication rights yourself. This guide compares workflows, not measured writing quality or a guarantee of publishable fiction.
zh: 继续前，打开完成消息中点名的文件，确认核心梗、视角、禁区、信息揭示边界与本章停笔点确实落在项目里。只看到工作台标签或一段流畅回答，不能证明项目已更新。
针对档案例子，看行动是否真的写出来：选 A 就要让签字与递交申请在场内发生；回执不能偷换成已经获准调阅，认出笔迹也不能偷换成证明作者。结合正文与实际项目状态核对第二章是否已经补完，不因存在“第二章”文件就当作完成。
之后换会话时重新打开同一 workspace，先要求诊断项目状态。核对最后完成章节与下一章细纲，再明确只生成你要的范围。
把模型输出当作草稿：连续性、可能复用或缺乏依据的内容、事实与发表权利都需要作者自行复核。本指南比较工作流，不代表实测写作质量，也不保证直接可发表。

title.en: Continue an unfinished novel with AI: import 10–20 chapters into Oh Story
title.zh: 已有 10–20 章怎么让 AI 接着写：导入 Oh Story，接续人物设定与前史

answer.en: If you already have 10–20 chapters, do not ask an empty chat to ‘continue in the same style.’ Use story-import to reconstruct the manuscript as an Oh Story writing project, review its inferences, then request the next chapter. Import preserves the source prose while building settings, outlines and continuity records. It cannot recover unwritten intent, guarantee a perfect voice match or settle every ambiguity; the manuscript remains the evidence. Reconstructed history and a future chapter plan do different jobs: one describes what was written, the other needs an author’s choice. The harbor-radio example below shows why continuation should pay off a decision already made, rather than reset it or invent a completed repair.
answer.zh: 已经写了 10–20 章，不要在空白聊天里只说“照这个风格续写”。先用 story-import 把书稿重建成 Oh Story 写作工程，审阅反推结果，再点名写下一章。导入会保留原文，同时建立设定、大纲与连贯性记录；它不能恢复未写进正文的意图，也不保证无损复刻文风或补对所有歧义。书稿证据始终优先于模型猜测。 已写章节的重建与下一章规划是两回事：前者描述原稿，后者需要作者裁定。下方的海港收音机示例说明，续章应接住已经作出的决定，而不是重新问一遍，或把尚未完成的修理补猜成结果。

en: Back up material you own or may use. Documented direct inputs are one .txt/.md file, a directory of chapter files, or pasted text; direct .docx, EPUB and PDF import is not documented.

Open a supported agent host in the writing workspace. New to skills or hosts? Read [Agent skills for writers](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers). Commands below follow Claude Code’s npx skills path; other hosts and the marketplace plugin can differ.

Identify the last complete chapter. Keep a half-written ending marked as a partial draft so unfinished events do not become established facts. Keep an unaccepted alternate opening outside the import source, and explicitly choose whether to retain it. In the worked example it is excluded, not a chapter file to overwrite.
zh: 先备份你拥有或获准使用的书稿。当前明确支持单个 .txt/.md、章节文件目录或直接粘贴文本；流程没有声明可直接导入 .docx、EPUB 或 PDF。
在写作工作区打开受支持的 Agent 宿主。若还分不清 skill 与宿主，先看[写作者的 Agent Skill 入门](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)。下文按 Claude Code 的 npx skills 路径书写，其他宿主或 marketplace 插件的语法可能不同。
确认最后一个完整章号。把只写一半的末章明确标成残稿，避免其中尚未完成的动作被登记为事实。 未采纳的另一版开头应放在导入源之外，明确是保留还是不用；本例选择排除它，不把它当作可以覆盖的章节文件。

en: Choose import, not deconstruction

Use story-import for a continuable project: settings, outlines, normalized prose and tracking. Use story-long-analyze only for a deconstruction library and report. Import analyzes your manuscript, but that analysis is a data source, not the deliverable or an external comparison title. If you only want to learn how a passage works, the [fiction-analysis guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction) shows an evidence-to-mechanism reading exercise without starting an import.
Prepare a clean source boundary

Use one .txt/.md file, a directory with sortable chapter filenames, or pasted text. Exclude advertisements, author notes and alternate drafts unless they are evidence. State the title, genre, platform, completion status and last complete chapter. Confirm the detected chapter range and long/short classification.
Set up first, then import

For Claude Code’s npx path, run /story-setup in the workspace, refresh the session, then run /story-import and provide the path. Direct import is allowed, but missing project infrastructure can mean setup first or a serial fallback. Do not mix this spelling with namespaced marketplace-plugin commands.
Keep author decisions with the author

Confirm continuable project versus analysis only, the last complete chapter, and treatment of a partial ending. If the text has no volume markers, review candidate divisions before volume outlines are finalized. Unsupported fields should stay [待补充] or become continuity risks—not confident-looking filler.
Review history without treating a proposed future as a fact

Confirm 正文/ has the expected chapters with unchanged prose, then inspect 设定/角色/, 大纲/ and 追踪/上下文.md. Past events and current locations, possessions, relationships and knowledge need manuscript evidence or an explicit author-confirmed background boundary. Separate that history from an inferred interpretation and from a newly approved next-chapter plan. A future repair, revelation or reconciliation does not belong among completed events just because a planning field mentions it.
Do not rewrite old chapters to fill a new template

Historical chapter blueprints are reconstructed descriptions, not instructions to make the old manuscript conform to a new outline. The import records each chapter’s measured original length and leaves unsupported hooks, relationship changes or side plots missing rather than inventing them. An empty field may mean “not established,” not “the author must add a twist.” Preserve the old prose; make future-facing choices in the next chapter’s plan.
Restore the unwritten intention before prose

An unresolved ending can lead to several defensible stories; the importer cannot know which one you meant to write. State the next chapter’s job, viewpoint, voice and reveal limits, and approve the plan before prose. Also identify what the last chapter has already decided. If it ends with “one more try,” continue that attempt and its consequences instead of spending another chapter asking whether to try. Leaving together can fulfill a local promise without repairing the receiver, solving the mystery or restoring all trust.
Name the next chapter and keep one authority

From the imported book directory, use /story-long-write 写第21章 (replace 21 with N+1) or a scoped daily request. A bare command only diagnoses the project. Revise an old chapter through its revision route; do not hand-edit derived tracking views. A current project with 追踪/_tracking-state.json normally continues without full re-import. If you expand the imported source range, the documented path is another full import rather than appending history to old snapshots. Back up any work added since the first import before rebuilding.
zh: 先选导入续写，不要只做拆文

要得到可续写的设定、大纲、正文与追踪状态，就用 story-import；只要拆解资料和报告，才用 story-long-analyze。导入会分析书稿，但拆文库是重建数据源，不是最终工程，也不会把自己的书自动登记成外部对标。 如果只想学一段文字为什么起作用，[小说拆文指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction)提供从证据到机制的精读练习，不必启动导入。
把导入范围整理干净
使用一个 .txt/.md、文件名可排序的章节目录，或直接粘贴文本。广告、作者的话和不同版本草稿若不是故事证据，就移出导入集。说明书名、题材、平台、完本状态与最后完整章，并确认系统识别的章节范围和长短篇分类。
先部署环境，再导入
按 Claude Code 的 npx 路径，在工作区运行 /story-setup，刷新会话，再运行 /story-import 并提供路径。直接 import 也可以，但基础设施缺失时会选择先 setup 或串行降级。不要与 marketplace 插件的命名空间命令混用。
作者决定不能外包
确认目标是可续写工程还是仅分析、最后完整章号，以及残稿如何处理。原文没有卷标时，先审阅候选卷界，再定卷纲。正文无法证明的字段保留 [待补充] 或写入连贯性风险，不为表格整齐而补猜。
审阅前史，不把拟写的未来当成事实
先确认 正文/ 章节齐全且原文未改，再看 设定/角色/、大纲/ 和 追踪/上下文.md。已发生事件，以及当前的位置、持有物、关系与认知，要有书稿证据或作者明确确认的背景边界；它们与可选解读、刚批准的下一章规划分开。拟写的修好设备、揭露真相或和解，不会因为出现在规划字段里就成为既成事实。
别为了补齐模板，把旧章重写一遍
历史章节细纲是反推描述，不是让旧原稿服从新模板的改写命令。导入记录原章的实测长度；没有依据的钩子、关系变化或副线可以保持待补充，不靠编造填满。“字段空着”可能只是尚未建立，不等于作者必须补一个反转。保留旧正文，把面向未来的决定放进下一章规划。
补回未写出的意图，再要正文
同一个未完结尾可以通向不止一种合理故事，导入器无法知道你原本想写哪一种。说明下一章任务、视角、声音与揭示边界，先批准规划，再写正文。也要指出上一章已经作出的决定：结尾若是“再试一次”，续章就应推进这次尝试及其后果，不再花一章讨论试不试。两人一起离开可以兑现一个局部承诺，不必同时修好设备、破案或恢复全部信任。
点名下一章，只保留一个权威工程
进入导入后的书名目录，用 /story-long-write 写第21章（把 21 换成 N+1），或给出范围清楚的日更请求。裸调用只诊断状态。旧章变化影响连续性时走大修流程，不要手改派生追踪视图。已有 追踪/_tracking-state.json 的项目通常直接续写；扩大原文导入范围时，文档要求重新完整导入，而不是向旧快照追加历史；重建前先另存备份，保留首次导入后新增的工作。

example.en:
ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXAMPLE — Harbor Radio
This is an authored reading/handoff exercise, not an observed model response or an executed
Oh Story project. It assumes an author-owned, complete chapter 1–20 manuscript. Only the
relevant excerpts are shown here; they are not a replacement for the complete import source.
All /ABS paths are placeholders for real files in your own environment.

Source boundary:
/ABS/harbor-radio/complete-chapters.md — accepted chapters 1–20 only.
/ABS/harbor-radio/alternatives/ch21-unused.md — an old, unaccepted opening, excluded.
The author chooses NOT to retain that alternate opening. No chapter 21 prose file is
present in the imported book in this example. A real retained partial chapter needs a
revision/completion request, not an assumed empty new-chapter target.

Accepted chapter 18 promise:
“When we stop work this time, I’ll leave with you,” Lin Zhou told Chen Yu.

Chapter 19 evidence and confirmed information boundary:
The manuscript shows Lin Zhou finding a red notebook and hiding it in his inside pocket.
The reader has seen it. The author confirms that Chen Yu has not learned about it by the
end of chapter 20. Who changed the broadcast log remains unresolved for the reader;
this exercise does not supply that person’s identity as a hidden answer.

Accepted chapter 20 ending, at 20:10 in the old radio room:
“At twenty-forty, the causeway closes,” Chen Yu said. She set the torch beside the toolbox.
“I can wait another half hour.”
Lin Zhou felt the hard corner of the red notebook through his inside pocket.
“One more try.” He turned the lamp toward the open receiver.

What the import handoff can preserve:
- Both characters are still in the radio room. The receiver has not been repaired.
- Lin has the notebook; Chen does not know about it. Reader knowledge is not shared
  character knowledge.
- Lin has promised to leave with Chen when they stop work; they have not left yet.
- He has already committed to one more attempt. The next scene must carry that action
  forward, not reset the ending to “Will he try?”
- Chen has stated a time limit. It does not establish that a repair will succeed,
  that they have already left, or that every conflict between them is settled.

A reconstruction mistake — a deliberately authored counterexample:
Suppose the imported handoff already reports the following as established history:
“The receiver finally worked. Chen Yu opened his red notebook and pointed to the culprit’s
name. By morning they had all the answers, and nothing stood between them anymore.”
This is wrong as the imported chapter-20 state: the attempt is unfinished, Chen has neither
the notebook nor that knowledge, and the next morning is outside the stated cutoff. It also
turns a local promise into complete reconciliation. Those could be proposed future events,
but they are neither established history nor a recovered intention from chapters 1–20.

What the author NOW chooses — a future plan, not imported history:
Chapter 21 is about leaving an unfinished task without abandoning a promise to another
person. The extra attempt will fail. Chen prepares her own things but does not pack Lin’s
for him. Lin stops, packs the still-unrepaired receiver and leaves with her before her
stated deadline. The notebook stays in his pocket; its contents and the person who changed the log are
not revealed here. This is one chosen direction, not the only valid reading of the source.
Do not turn the choice into a romance, permanent trust or an explanation of Chen’s private
feelings unless the author separately establishes those things.

Why the intention belongs in the plan:
A different author could choose a successful repair and the cost of staying. The accepted
chapter 20 alone cannot choose between those futures. Here, the author’s decision governs
chapter 21; it must not be backfilled as “the receiver failed and they left” in the imported
chapter-20 checkpoint before the new scene has been written.

Suggested import request, after the host setup described above:
/story-import
Import only /ABS/harbor-radio/complete-chapters.md as a continuable long-form project.
Chapters 1–20 are complete; the book is unfinished. Do not import the excluded alternate
opening, rewrite old prose, or turn my future chapter-21 decision into past events.
Before migration, show the detected chapter range and any candidate volume divisions
that require my choice. Leave unsupported reconstruction fields uncertain.
Complete the declared import workflow, but do not write chapter 21 in this request.

After reviewing the reconstructed project, make the next-chapter plan explicit:
/story-long-write 补纲
Plan chapter 21 only; stop before prose. Keep chapter 20’s “one more try” decision.
I approve the unsuccessful attempt, Lin packing the unrepaired receiver himself, and
both characters leaving together before Chen’s stated deadline. Do not give Chen the
notebook, reveal the person who changed the log or claim a complete reconciliation.
Preserve chapters 1–20 and their established events. This is a new plan, not a historical
correction. If the reconstructed outline points elsewhere, show the change before applying it.

After that plan is accepted, and no chapter 21 prose file exists:
/story-long-write 写第21章
Write only chapter 21 from its approved blueprint, in Lin Zhou’s close third person with
restrained dialogue. Carry through the extra attempt and the decision to stop, then show
packing and leaving together. Keep the notebook in his pocket and Chen’s knowledge limited.
Do not jump to the next morning, finish the repair off-page, or continue to chapter 22.
If a chapter-21 file or incompatible project state is present, stop and report it rather
than overwriting. Report the actual changed files when the chapter is finished.

A candidate closing passage — original editorial prose, not a complete chapter or output:
Static rose again. Lin Zhou turned the dial back.
Chen Yu picked up her raincoat. She left the screwdriver beside his hand.
“Still trying?”
The notebook’s corner pressed against his ribs.
“No. Let’s go.”
He put the screwdriver into the box and closed the lid himself. A quarter of an hour
remained before the time Chen had named. He lifted the unrepaired receiver and stepped
outside with her.

This small ending enacts stopping, packing and leaving together. It does not prove that
Chen has forgiven him, that they reached home, or that the mystery is solved. In a complete
chapter, the attempted repair still needs its scene; this closing excerpt does not replace it.
Only after the approved chapter actually contains these events should the resulting
continuity state advance. Judge the voice beside the last original chapters; import is
not a guarantee that this illustrative prose is your voice.
example.zh:
原创编辑示例——《海港收音机》
这是作者编写的阅读与交接练习，不是模型实测回答，也没有运行 Oh Story 工程。
假设作者拥有完整第1–20章，下面仅摘录相关部分，不能拿这些摘录冒充完整导入源。
所有 /ABS 路径都要替换为你环境中的真实文件。

原稿边界：
/ABS/harbor-radio/complete-chapters.md ——只含已接受的完整第1–20章。
/ABS/harbor-radio/alternatives/ch21-unused.md ——未采纳的旧开头，不导入。
作者本次选择“不保留”那版开头，因此本例导入工程里没有第二十一章正文文件。
真实项目若保留了残稿，就应提出修改/补完请求，不把目标当空白新章覆盖。

第18章已经作出的承诺：
“这次收工，我跟你一起走。”林舟对陈雨说。

第19章证据与已确认的信息边界：
原稿写了林舟找到一本红色笔记本，藏进内袋。读者看见过它；作者确认截至
第20章，陈雨还不知情。谁改了广播日志，对读者仍未揭晓；本练习也没有私下
给出改动者的身份。

第20章已接受的结尾，旧广播屋，20:10：
“二十点四十，堤道就封了。”陈雨把手电放在工具盒旁。“我还能等半小时。”
林舟隔着内袋摸到红册子的硬角。
“再试一次。”他把灯头转向拆开的接收机。

导入交接能保留什么：
- 两个人仍在广播屋，接收机还没修好。
- 红册在林舟身上，陈雨不知情；读者知道，不等于角色共享这份知识。
- 林舟答应收工时跟陈雨一起走；他们现在还没走。
- 他已经决定再试一次，下一场戏要接着做，不能退回“要不要试”的原点。
- 陈雨说出了时间限制，但这没有证明修理会成功、两人已经离开，或双方一切
  矛盾都已经解决。

错误重建的反例——以下是特意编写的示意：
假设导入交接已经把这段当成既定前史：
“接收机终于修好了。陈雨翻开他的红册子，指着作假者的名字。天亮时他们有了
全部答案，彼此之间也再没有任何隔阂。”
把它当作导入至第20章的现状就错了：尝试尚未完成，陈雨没有红册和这些知识，
次日早晨也在声明的截止点之外；它还把局部承诺变成了彻底和解。这些事件可以
作为未来方案提出，却不是已建立的前史，也不是从第1–20章恢复出来的作者意图。

作者现在才作出的选择——未来规划，不是导入前史：
第21章要写“工作还没做完，也可以不辜负对另一个人的承诺”。再一次尝试会失败；
陈雨准备自己的东西，但不替林舟收拾。林舟停手，亲自收起仍没修好的接收机，
在她说的时限之前和她一起离开。红册留在内袋，这里不揭内容，也不揭日志改动者。
这是本次选择，不是原稿唯一合理的读法；不要另外把它定为恋爱、永久信任，或替
陈雨解释内心，除非作者另行建立这些事实。

为什么意图要放在规划里：
另一位作者也可以选择修理成功，并让留下来产生代价。仅凭已接受的第20章，
导入无法替作者选定哪一种未来。本例现在批准的方向约束第21章，却不能在新场景
尚未写出时，倒填成第20章追踪检查点里的“维修失败、两人已走”。

按上文完成宿主 setup 后，可这样请求导入：
/story-import
只把 /ABS/harbor-radio/complete-chapters.md 导入为可续写长篇工程。
第1–20章完整，整本书未完；不导入已排除的旧开头，不重写原文，不把我新选的
第二十一章方向当成既往事件。迁移前展示识别的章节范围，以及需要我裁定的候选
卷界；没有依据的重建字段保留未知。完成本次声明范围的导入流程，但本轮不写第21章。

审阅重建工程后，单独说清下一章计划：
/story-long-write 补纲
只规划第21章，停在正文前。保留第20章“再试一次”的决定。
我批准这次尝试失败、林舟自己收起没修好的接收机，以及两人在陈雨说的时限前
一起离开。不要把红册交给陈雨，不揭日志改动者，不宣告彻底和解。
第1–20章正文和已建立事件不变。这是新规划，不是纠正历史；若重建细纲方向
不同，先说明要改哪里，再落实规划。

计划已接受，并确认没有第21章正文文件后：
/story-long-write 写第21章
只按已批准细纲写第21章，用林舟的第三人称限知与克制对白。
推进那次额外尝试和停手决定，再写出收拾、一起离开。红册仍在内袋，陈雨所知不越界。
不跳到第二天早晨，不在画外修好接收机，不接着写第22章。
若实际上已有第21章文件或项目状态冲突，先停下报告，不覆盖。
本章完成后说明真实改动的文件。

候选收束片段——原创编辑文字，不是完整章或生成结果：
噪声又漫上来。林舟把旋钮退回原处。
陈雨拎起雨衣，没碰他手边的螺丝刀。
“还试？”
红册子的角抵着肋骨。
“不试了。走。”
他把螺丝刀放回盒里，自己扣上盖。离陈雨说的时间还差一刻钟。
他提起没修好的接收机，和她一道出了门。

这个小结尾把停手、收拾、一起离开写成动作，并没有证明陈雨已经原谅他、两人
已经到家或日志疑问已经解决。完整章里仍要写那次尝试的过程，不能拿这一小段末尾替代。
只有获准的章节真的写出这些事件后，后续连续性状态才据此前进。文风要和最后几章
原稿并读判断；导入不保证本例这段文字就是你的声音。

en: 拆文库/{book}/ retains the source backup and reconstruction analysis; it is not the continuable project by itself.
A long-form project puts preserved prose in 正文/, reconstructed settings in 设定/, outlines in 大纲/, and continuity state in 追踪/.

Reconstructed blueprints for chapters 1–N describe the imported prose; they are not newly written replacement chapters. A later author-approved blueprint for N+1 describes an intended future. Keep that plan separate from the historical checkpoint until prose establishes the new events.
追踪/_tracking-state.json is authoritative. Context, character, foreshadowing and timeline Markdown are generated views; continuation begins after the last complete imported chapter.

For ongoing chapters after import, use the [long-novel continuity example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity): separate author truth, character/reader knowledge, unresolved promises and future plans before drafting.
zh: 拆文库/{书名}/ 保存原文备份与重建分析；它本身不是可续写工程。
长篇工程把保留的正文放在 正文/，反推设定放在 设定/，大纲放在 大纲/，连贯性状态放在 追踪/。
第1–N章反推细纲描述导入的原稿，不是新写的替换正文；作者随后批准的第N+1章细纲描述拟写的未来。在正文建立新事件前，不把这份计划混入历史检查点。
追踪/_tracking-state.json 是权威状态；上下文、角色、伏笔和时间线 Markdown 是派生视图。续写从最后完整导入章之后开始。
导入后持续写章，可接着看[长篇连续性示例](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity)：写前分开作者真相、角色/读者认知、未完承诺与未来计划。

en: Before chapter N+1, compare the final scene, active characters’ locations and knowledge, unresolved promises and reader-visible facts with the manuscript. Correct unsupported inferences or keep them uncertain.

Read the first continuation beside the last two original chapters for voice, viewpoint, knowledge boundaries and causal handoff. Revise old chapters through the workflow, not by patching generated tracking files.

For the harbor exercise, distinguish an action already chosen from an outcome not yet achieved. The continuation must actually show the attempt and, if that plan is approved, stopping and leaving together; it must not reset the choice, teleport the notebook, reveal its secret to Chen or equate leaving with complete reconciliation.
zh: 写第 N+1 章前，把最后场景、活跃角色的位置与已知、未结承诺、读者可见事实对回书稿。无证据推断要纠正或保留为未知。
把第一章续写与最后两章原稿并读，检查文风、视角、认知边界和因果承接。旧章需要修改时走大修流程，不手补派生追踪文件。
针对海港练习，分清已经选择的行动与尚未实现的结果。续章应真正写出尝试，并在计划获准时写出停手、一起离开；不能把选择重置、让红册凭空换人、让陈雨突然知情，或把离开等同于彻底和解。

en: [Installation paths, command namespaces and import/continuation order](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/070d744b075024b530d1befbaa2474531f4700a1/README_EN.md#L82-L142)

[Import order, continuable-project choice, supported inputs and author confirmations](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/070d744b075024b530d1befbaa2474531f4700a1/skills/story-import/SKILL.md#L40-L121)

[Project skeleton, unchanged prose migration and author-confirmed volume boundaries](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/070d744b075024b530d1befbaa2474531f4700a1/skills/story-import/SKILL.md#L264-L320)

[Evidence-limited outline reconstruction and continuity initialization](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/070d744b075024b530d1befbaa2474531f4700a1/skills/story-import/SKILL.md#L335-L424)

title.en: Adapt a novel into a short drama: episodes, scripts and storyboards
title.zh: 用 AI 把小说改成短剧：分集、剧本与分镜怎么衔接

answer.en: Start with the source story and the decisions an adaptation may change—not a request to turn every chapter into an episode. Drama Skills can help analyze the source, plan episode handoffs, write a pilot and develop its visual specifications and storyboard. It is an open-source agent skill suite, not a one-click finished-video service. This guide stops at a text handoff. Its original repair-shop example turns prose into visible action, then compares one-episode and three-episode versions without cutting away the reason for the protagonist’s choice. The same private thought is also compared as subjective VO and spoken dialogue, distinguishing audience knowledge from what another character hears. A small dialogue revision shows how the mother can express concern without removing the rent problem or deciding for her daughter.
answer.zh: 从原著和允许改动的范围开始，而不是直接要求“每章变一集”。Drama Skills 可以辅助原著分析、分集交接规划、试写一集，以及视觉设定和分镜设计。它是开源 Agent 技能合集，不是一键交付成片的视频服务。本指南止步于文本交付：用原创维修铺案例把小说文字转成可见行动，再比较一集与三集两种切法，说明怎样压缩而不删掉主角作出选择的理由。 另用同一句心里话比较内心旁白与当面对白，分清观众听见和现场人物听见。再用一段对白改稿，示范怎样让母亲表达体谅，而不抹掉租金难题、替女儿作决定。

en: Source material you own or are authorized to adapt, in a form the host can read. Select a coherent source segment for the first pass; tell the agent which characters, facts, themes and ending promises must remain.

A target form and a manageable first deliverable. For example, ask for a three-episode plan and only the first episode’s script. Choose the intended duration, audience and live-action or motion-comic form; these are project choices, not platform-wide requirements.

A configured supported agent host and a project folder. For the documented Claude Code route, ask “Install this skill suite: https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills”, review the proposed setup, then use /short-drama. See the [project page](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills) for the suite and the [writer’s skill guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers) for host terminology.
zh: 准备你拥有或获准改编、且宿主能够读取的源材料。首次选一段相对完整的故事，说明哪些角色、事实、主题与结局承诺不能改。
给出目标形态和范围可控的首次交付，例如先规划三集，只写第一集剧本。单集时长、受众以及实拍短剧或漫剧形态由项目选择，并非所有平台的统一要求。

准备已配置的受支持 Agent 宿主与项目目录。按文档中的 Claude Code 路径，可先请求“Install this skill suite: https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills”，审阅安装方案后使用 /short-drama。[项目页](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills)介绍技能合集；不熟悉宿主等概念，可先读[作者 Skill 指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)。

en: Separate source facts from adaptation decisions

Ask the agent to retain source locations, established facts, allowed changes and unresolved questions. Identify what already works on screen, what needs an observable carrier such as an action or prop, and what exists only as prose. Original ideas can be developed too, but proposed additions must not be attributed to a novel that never contained them. If you have not yet decided whether the novel is suitable, start with short-drama-novel-analyze for a source triage; use short-drama-develop to develop the chosen adaptation direction.
Cut episodes around dramatic results, not chapter numbers

Use an [episode map](https://zenstory.ai/glossary/fenji-ditu): incoming state, immediate goal, opposition, turn, local result and the pressure inherited by the next episode. A long chapter may support several episodes; several chapters may serve one dramatic result. Preserve causality when compressing or reordering events. If the selected source cannot support the requested count without invention, surface that choice rather than padding. Below, wiping the inscription, being hurried and reading the signature do not automatically become three episodes. A candidate three-episode map uses explicitly added premises, gives each episode a local payoff and prevents the next one from rediscovering the same fact as a new twist.
Compress repeated delivery, not the reason for a choice

List what each passage does before cutting it: establish a fact, let a character learn it, change the available choices or show a consequence. Those functions may move into one scene without keeping every pause, recap or episode break. In the repair-shop example, remove the breaks and keep one phone call; retain the mother’s confirmation, the rent problem and Shen Ning’s lack of replacement funds before she releases the clock. A tighter version trades away some time with her hesitation, not the information that makes her decision understandable. Voice-over and slower scenes remain creative options, not forbidden forms.
Write one pilot before scaling the series

Ask for the first episode’s screenplay from the accepted map. Make important internal reasoning understandable through action, dialogue, evidence or deliberate voice-over, rather than simply reading the novel over images. First ask who hears it: subjective inner VO may inform only the audience, while spoken dialogue can change another character’s knowledge and response. An action does not necessarily express one precise belief. Review who wants what and what the ending changes. If the story continues, identify the real question or pressure left for the next episode; carry forward the decisions already made. When revising dialogue, name what the speaker wants the other person to do, not just an emotion to perform. Keep the necessary facts explicit; a different relational tactic need not invent a new motive or outcome.
Record reusable visual facts

Define recurring characters, locations and props before relying on them across shots. For the example below, the oil-stained left sleeve, damaged clock corner and position of the consignment slip are continuity facts; “make it cinematic” is not. If a director’s statement is proposed, accept the intended visual direction before treating it as binding. Optional look exploration does not require commissioning images.
Turn the accepted scene into a storyboard

Each shot should have a purpose, a source in the screenplay, duration, visible action and start/end states. A [frozen keyframe](https://zenstory.ai/glossary/dongjie-guanjianzhen) describes a boundary frame, normally the shot’s start; it is not the whole movement and not an already-created picture. Distinguish a planned reference from an actual image that has been inspected and bound for use.
Keep text handoff separate from media production

Deliver the requested screenplay, visual specification and storyboard first; add image/video prompts only when needed. If you later commission media, choose available providers and review the actual assets and scope. The documented production flow prepares a preview and requires explicit confirmation before running external generation. A local skill installation is not a promise of free or offline model work.
zh: 先把原文事实与改编决定分开
要求保留来源位置、已成立的事实、可改范围和待确认问题。分清哪些内容已经能直接拍，哪些需要动作、道具等可见载体，哪些只存在于小说叙述中。原创点子也能开发，但新增设定必须标为改编选择，不能说成原著里本来就有。 还没决定这本小说是否适合改编，可以先让 short-drama-novel-analyze 做原著快评；确定方向后，再由 short-drama-develop 推进开发。
按戏剧结果切集，不按章节号平均分

使用[分集地图](https://zenstory.ai/glossary/fenji-ditu)，记录进入状态、当前目标、阻力、转折、局部结果和下一集继承的压力。一章可以支持多集，几章也可能共同完成一个戏剧结果；压缩或调整事件顺序时，要保住因果。如果所选原文不足以支撑目标集数，应明确提出取舍，而不是灌水或悄悄编造。 下方先展示为什么“擦字、催促、看签名”不是天然的三集，再用明确标出的新增设定，给出三集候选地图。每集写清已经兑现的结果，下一集不得把同一个发现重新当作反转。
压缩重复交代，不删掉选择的理由
删段落前，先写清它的作用：建立事实、让人物得知事实、改变可选方案，还是呈现后果。这些作用可以集中在一场戏里，不必保留每次等待、回顾或断集。维修铺案例可取消集间断点、保留一次连续通话，但交钟之前，仍要让母亲确认委托、说出租金问题，并让沈宁面对自己拿不出替代资金的处境。紧凑版牺牲的是部分犹豫的停留时间，不是让决定可理解的信息。旁白与慢场仍是创作选项，并非一律禁止。
先写一集，再扩展整季

根据已接受的分集地图，只写第一集剧本。为关键心理活动选择观众能理解的动作、对白、证据或有意旁白，不只是给小说朗读配图。外化前问清谁会听见：主观内心旁白可以只给观众，当面对白则可能改变另一人物的已知与接话。动作也不一定唯一表达某个具体判断。先读清楚谁想要什么、结尾改变了什么。如果故事还要继续，再明确留给下一集的真实问题或压力，并带上已经确认的创作决定。修改对白时，先说清这句话想让对方做什么，不只给演员一个情绪词。必要事实仍要讲清；改变交谈策略，不必新增动机或改掉结果。
先记录能复用的视觉事实
跨镜头反复出现的角色、场景和道具，需要明确可见规格。以下示例中，左袖油渍、座钟缺角、委托单位置是连续性事实；“拍得有电影感”不是。如果提出导演阐述，先由创作者接受视觉方向，再把它作为下游约束；可选的画风探索不要求立刻付费生成图片。
从已接受的场次拆分镜
每个镜头都应有职责、剧本来源、时长、可见动作和起止状态。[冻结关键帧](https://zenstory.ai/glossary/dongjie-guanjianzhen)描述一个边界画面，默认是镜头起点，不代表整个运动过程，更不代表图片已经存在。未来计划使用的参考与已经检查、绑定的真实图片，要分开记录。
把文本交付与媒体制作分开
先交付所需的剧本、视觉设定和分镜，确实需要时再加图片、视频提示词。以后决定制作媒体时，再选择可用供应商、检查实际素材和执行范围。文档规定外部生成先准备预览、再明确确认、最后运行。技能装在本地，不代表模型工作免费或离线。

example.en:
Suggested request in Claude Code after setup (replace the path):
/short-drama
Use /ABS/my-authorized-story.txt for a short-drama adaptation.
First identify source facts, proposed changes and open questions.
Plan the first three episodes for a 60–90 second target each; explain if the source needs a different split.
Keep the protagonist’s motivation and the agreed ending. Do not add a hidden villain as an established source fact.
Write only episode 1 after I accept the map. Then develop that episode’s visual facts and storyboard when requested.
Stop at text files. Do not generate images, video, voices or music.

ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXAMPLE — written for this guide, not tool output or a timed film.
Source fragment:
When an auction-house courier arrived to collect a repaired clock, Shen Ning recognized her father’s handwriting underneath it. She believed he would never have sold it. The courier needed her handover signature for an auction starting in twenty minutes; the consignment slip carried her mother’s signature.

Adaptation choice:
Keep the handwriting, deadline and signature. Show recognition and hesitation through inspection and questioning. Those actions do not uniquely state her belief that her father would never sell the clock. The invented sleeve/clock details below are staging choices, not extra source facts.

Scene excerpt:
INT. REPAIR SHOP — EVENING
Shen turns the clock over and rubs dust from the inscription with her left sleeve.
SHEN: He wrote that last character backwards. Every time.
COURIER: Twenty minutes. I need your signature.
He slides a slip onto the right side of the workbench.
Shen reaches for the pen, sees the consignor’s signature and stops.
SHEN: My mother sent this?

Who should hear the same private thought?
The source says Shen does not believe her father would sell the clock. That establishes her belief, not proof that he never sold it. Inspecting the writing and delaying her signature can show that she values the clock without precisely expressing that belief. If the adaptation needs to state it, compare these original alternatives at the same beat: after “He wrote that last character backwards. Every time” and before the courier asks for the signature. Choose one, not both in succession.

Subjective voice-over candidate — for the audience only in this proposal, not spoken aloud in the shop:
[VO] SHEN: I don’t believe Dad would sell this clock.
The audience learns what she doubts; the courier has not heard this thought. He can still press for the signature and present the slip as in the original excerpt. Do not have him answer “Of course your father would sell it” just because the audience heard her. Her subjective voice does not establish her father’s actual intention either.

Spoken-dialogue candidate — addressed to the courier:
SHEN (to the courier): I don’t believe Dad would sell this clock.
The words are identical, but now the courier has heard the objection too. He may still press for the signature and present the slip, but consider how that response follows her line; do not simultaneously stage him as if he had not heard the objection. Hearing an objection does not mean agreeing, knowing her father’s intent or knowing her mother’s intended use of the money. Do not automatically supply him with an explanation.

Choose whether the scene needs private uncertainty or an objection made face to face. Keeping the original excerpt without VO is also possible: acknowledge that the precise belief remains an inference, rather than claiming a close-up transmits it word for word. In this project’s format, [OS] is offscreen dialogue within the scene and [VO] a non-local subjective/narrative voice. A person being outside the picture does not make their speech nonexistent within the story’s space.

The four-shot sketch below still follows the original excerpt. These unselected comparisons do not automatically revise the screenplay, storyboard or later episode map. After choosing, hand the affected response and sound decisions to the appropriate stage.

Four-shot handoff excerpt (not a full episode or a production-ready storyboard):
01 — Clock underside: dusty writing partly visible; sleeve wipes it clean. Reveal the recognizable clue.
02 — Two-shot: Shen holds the clock; courier checks the time. Establish the opposing deadline.
03 — Slip insert: paper arrives on the right of the bench; a finger stops beside the signature. Reveal the new fact.
04 — Shen’s reaction: pen held above paper; her gaze lifts to the courier. End on the question, not a generic shocked face.

Continuity notes: oil stain on Shen’s left sleeve; clock missing its upper-right ornament; slip stays to the right of the clock. No reference images have been generated or bound.

From the four-shot excerpt to a candidate three-episode map
Do not assume “EP001 wipes the inscription → EP002 the courier hurries her → EP003 she sees the signature” already makes three episodes. Those actions may serve one scene, but do not yet supply three distinct choices and consequences. The short source can first become one scene; there is no need to repeat the demand for a signature, invent a villain or interrupt a sentence just to reach three episodes.

For a different structure, this guide adds the following original adaptation premises. They are not facts established by the source excerpt. In a real adaptation, have the author accept the added direction first:
A. Her mother personally signed the consignment form and intends to put any auction proceeds toward rent for a community repair class. No sale or payment has occurred, and nothing establishes this as her father's final wish.
B. Shen Ning wants to keep an object associated with her father but cannot currently offer replacement rent money. Her problem is how to preserve a memory, not how to find another convenient signature mistake.
C. The courier can wait one extra minute while she photographs the inscription; that does not give him authority to stop the auction. Her mother can answer a call. Time advances continuously across the episodes; the twenty-minute countdown does not reset each time.

EP001 | Recognition is not an answer
Entry: the clock is in the repair shop, and Shen Ning has not signed the handover form. She recognizes the inscription while the courier hurries her.
Goal and action: establish where the clock came from before handing it over. She asks to inspect the consignment form.
Turn and local payoff: the form names her mother. There is now a specific person to ask, but the signature alone cannot explain a motive and has not yet been confirmed by its signer.
Exit → EP002: Shen Ning takes out her phone and calls her mother. The clock and unsigned handover form remain in the shop. Neither Shen Ning nor the audience knows why it was consigned. The next episode starts with her mother answering, not another discovery of the same name.

EP002 | Keeping it also has a cost
Entry: the clock has not been handed over, the handover form is unsigned, and the call is awaiting an answer.
Goal and action: Shen Ning wants her mother to withdraw the consignment. Her mother confirms signing it herself and explains her plan for the class rent. Shen Ning proposes keeping the clock but cannot say where replacement funds would come from.
Turn and local payoff: the mother's account rules out a mistaken delivery or signature. The conflict becomes a choice between keeping the object and supporting the class. The audience now knows her mother's plan, not what her father would have wanted.
Exit → EP003: Shen Ning stops disputing the paperwork. She ends the call and asks for one minute to photograph the inscription; the courier agrees. The clock has not left, and her final choice remains open. Episode three must not make her forget the rent plan or treat an unknown sale price as settled money.

EP003 | What leaves, what stays
Entry: the clock is still in the shop, the handover is unsigned, and the agreed minute has begun. Shen Ning knows her mother's plan.
Choice and action: she photographs the inscription, sends the photograph to her mother, signs the handover form and gives the courier the clock. After the handover, she tells her mother the clock has gone with the courier and asks that they discuss such old belongings together in future; her mother replies in agreement.
Local payoff: the object leaves, the inscription has a record, and mother and daughter make a specific new agreement. This settles how Shen Ning acts on this occasion, not all of her sadness.
Final state: the courier has the clock; Shen Ning has the photograph; her mother knows she has released it. The auction result, actual proceeds and whether the class goes ahead have not happened. If the story continues, those are later tasks—not a reason to add an unrelated abduction for a cliffhanger.

One-episode alternative: remove the breaks, keep the decision
Removing all of EP002 would make Shen Ning jump from questioning a signature to releasing the clock without learning what changes her judgment. Removing EP003 would leave a plan without its consequence. Keep those functions, but not necessarily their episode boundaries.

The earlier scene excerpt ends with “My mother sent this?” For a one-episode version, continue directly with the passage below instead of cutting to another episode. It uses the same proposed premises A–C; it is an alternative to the three-episode map, not an EP004 or a second handover. The new staging keeps her mother on speakerphone through the courier’s departure rather than ending the call and contacting her again. The dialogue and staging are original proposals requiring author acceptance, not recovered source prose.

INT. REPAIR SHOP — CONTINUOUS
The courier places a separate handover form beside the consignment slip. Shen sets the clock upright and puts her phone beside the papers. She calls her mother on speakerphone.
SHEN: Did you sign this yourself?
MOTHER (PHONE): Yes. I want to put whatever it brings toward the repair class’s rent.
SHEN: Could you withdraw it? I could cover—
MOTHER (PHONE): Can you?
Shen lowers the pen beside the still-unsigned handover form.
SHEN: Not now.
She turns to the courier.
SHEN: One minute. Let me photograph the writing.
COURIER: One minute.
With the call still connected, she tilts the clock, photographs the inscription and sends the photograph to her mother. She sets the clock upright, signs the handover form, gives the form to the courier and passes him the clock. He leaves carrying the clock.
SHEN: It’s gone with him. Next time, can we talk before putting one of these things up for sale?
MOTHER (PHONE): We will.
Shen enlarges the last character in the photograph.

What was cut, and what still has to land?
• Cut: episode breaks and repeated re-entry into the same question; the phone conversation stays continuous. The twenty-minute deadline is not restarted, and the courier grants only the already-proposed minute, not a postponed auction.
• Keep: the signature leads her to the person who can explain it; her mother confirms the consignment and intended use of possible proceeds; Shen cannot offer replacement funds. Her next move is to preserve the inscription before choosing to release the object. The handover form she signs is not the mother’s consignment form.
• Show the consequence: the courier actually leaves with the clock; Shen retains the photograph; her mother hears about the handover and agrees to discuss future decisions. This is not merely “she understood and let go.” It does not establish a sale, rent payment, her father’s wishes or the end of her sadness at parting with the object.
• Tradeoff: one episode keeps the discovery, negotiation and choice together. Three may give more room to dwell on recognition, the failed alternative and the parting—but only if the dramatic material and intended form support that space. Extra breaks alone do not create it. This short continuation illustrates the causal compression; neither version is a timed 60–90-second script or a filmed result.

Revise the conversation without changing the decision
Suppose the author asks, “Can her mother show concern for Shen, while still making the rent problem felt?” This is a new dialogue direction, not proof that the original short question was wrong. The following original replacement uses the same proposed premises A–C. It replaces only the exchange after the mother has confirmed signing and explained her intended use of possible proceeds; it is not another call or an extra scene.

SHEN: Could you withdraw it? I could cover—
MOTHER (PHONE): Don't take on the rent just to keep it. Could you actually cover it now?
Shen lowers the pen beside the still-unsigned handover form.
SHEN: Not now.
She turns to the courier.
SHEN: One minute. Let me photograph the writing.

What changes in the conversation?
Shen first tries to obtain withdrawal by offering an alternative. The mother's proposed response discourages an unaffordable promise before asking whether that alternative is possible. The rent still matters; no new money or extension appears. The original “Can you?” is terser; this version makes room for concern as well as resistance. Choose the relationship and pace you want, rather than treating the longer line as automatically more natural.
The lowered pen and explicit answer interrupt Shen's proposed bargain. They do not yet establish agreement to release the clock. Her next request seeks a way to keep the writing; the later photograph, signature and courier's departure must still occur. Retain the existing last exchange about consulting together in future. None of this establishes a sale, paid rent or what her father would have wanted.
Not every line needs subtext. “Did you sign this yourself?” and “Not now” make information needed for the choice understandable. The photograph and final enlargement of the last character already give the audience a concrete trace of what she wants to keep; adding “I have completely let go of my grief” would claim more than those actions show. An explicit admission or deliberate voice-over is still an authorial option, not a forbidden technique.

After choosing the revision, adapt this request to your actual scene:
Use $short-drama-write on the current 剧集/<EP>/剧本.md in /ABS/my-drama. Revise only the named rent exchange in [real scene ID] to discourage an unaffordable promise before asking whether Shen can cover the rent. Keep the earlier confirmation and intended use of possible proceeds, her inability to replace the funds, and the later photograph, handover and agreement to consult. Preserve unrelated wording and the deadline; do not invent a balance, sale price or father's final wish. Write the selected revision into the screenplay only. No assets, storyboard, image/video prompts or media production.
This is a bounded writing request, not an executed skill call or a timed performance.

Add this scope to the earlier request:
Before writing the script, propose one-episode and three-episode cuts with their tradeoffs. For each episode, list entry facts, choice and local result, what the audience newly learns, and what the next episode must inherit. Separate source facts from proposed additions; do not decide missing motives for me. Once I accept the structure and added premises, write only EP001 and stop at text.
example.zh:
在 Claude Code 完成安装后，可这样请求（替换路径）：
/short-drama
用 /ABS/我有权改编的故事.txt 开发短剧。
先区分原文事实、拟改内容和待确认问题。
先规划前三集，每集目标 60–90 秒；如果原文更适合其他切法，说明理由。
保留主角动机和已约定的结局，不把新增幕后反派写成原著事实。
我接受分集地图后，只写第一集剧本；之后按请求补该集视觉事实与分镜。
止步于文本文件，不生成图片、视频、配音或音乐。

原创编剧示例——为本指南编写，不是工具实测输出，也不是已计时成片。
源故事片段：
拍卖行的取件员来到维修铺，要取回修好的旧座钟。沈宁在钟底认出了父亲的字，她不相信父亲会卖掉它。取件员催她签交接单，拍卖二十分钟后就要开始；委托单上却签着母亲的名字。

改编选择：
保留字迹、倒计时和签名。用检查座钟和追问来承载认出字迹、迟疑交还的过程；这还不等于明确说出“不相信父亲会卖”的判断。下方袖口与座钟缺角是新增调度细节，不冒充原文事实。

剧本片段：
内景·维修铺·傍晚
沈宁翻过座钟，用左袖擦掉刻字上的灰。
沈宁：最后这个字，他每次都写反。
取件员：二十分钟。我还等你签字呢。
他把委托单推到工作台右侧。
沈宁伸手拿笔，看见委托人签名，停住。
沈宁：是我妈送来的？

同一句心里话，谁应该听见？
源文里的“不相信父亲会卖掉它”是沈宁的判断，不是父亲确实没有出售的证据。检查刻字、迟迟不签，可以让观众看见她重视这只钟，却未必准确传达这个判断。若本次改编需要明确交代它，可以比较下面两种原创新写法；都放在“最后这个字，他每次都写反”之后、取件员催签之前，只择其一，不是连说两遍。

内心旁白候选——本方案约定只给观众听，不在维修铺现场发声：
[VO] 沈宁：我不信爸会卖掉这只钟。
观众知道她在怀疑什么，取件员没有听见这句判断。他仍可按原片段催签、递单，不能因为观众听到了，就让他接一句“你爸当然会卖”。这条主观旁白也不替父亲证明真实意愿。

现场对白候选——明确朝取件员说：
沈宁（向取件员）：我不信爸会卖掉这只钟。
文字相同，但取件员现在也听见了质疑。接下来可以仍催签、递单，却要检查接话是否承接这一句；不能一面把话说给他，一面仍按“他没听到”安排反应。听见质疑不等于他同意、知道父亲意愿或知道母亲用款打算，不自动替他补解释。

选择取决于这场戏要写私下的犹疑，还是当面提出异议。也可以保留原来的无旁白片段，让具体判断不被明说；但应承认它留给观众推断，而不是声称一个特写已逐字传达内心。按本项目格式，[OS] 是现场画外对白，[VO] 是非现场的主观/叙述声音；人没出现在画面里，不等于他的说话在故事现场不存在。

下方四镜仍对应原片段。这两条是未选定的比较，不会自动改掉剧本、分镜或后面的分集地图；选用后再把受影响的接话和声音安排交给相应阶段。

四镜交接片段（不是完整单集，也不是可直接投产的完整分镜）：
01 座钟底部特写：灰尘遮着刻字，袖口擦过，字迹显露。职责是交付可识别的线索。
02 双人中景：沈宁抱着钟，取件员看时间。职责是让保留证据与交还座钟的压力同场成立。
03 委托单特写：纸从桌右推入，手指停在签名旁。职责是交付改变判断的新事实。
04 沈宁反应：笔尖悬在纸上，她抬眼看取件员。用有对象的问题结束，不只写“震惊表情”。

连续性备注：沈宁左袖有油渍；座钟右上角装饰缺失；委托单留在座钟右侧。此处尚未生成或绑定任何参考图片。

从四镜片段到三集候选地图
别把“EP001 擦出字迹 → EP002 取件员催促 → EP003 看见签名”当成已经成立的三集。这些先后动作可以服务于同一场戏，但尚未提供三次不同的选择及其后果。只凭上面的短源文，可以先完成一场戏；不必为了凑三集反复催签、插入新反派或截断一句话。

为演示另一种分集，本指南另写以下原创改编设定；它们不是那段源文已经交代的事实。真实改编中，应先让作者接受新增方向：
A. 母亲确实亲自签了委托单，打算把可能获得的拍卖款用于社区修理课的场地租金。尚未成交或到账，也没有证据表明这是父亲的遗愿。
B. 沈宁想保住与父亲有关的物件，但暂时拿不出替代租金。她需要决定怎样保留记忆，而不是再找一个“原来签错了”的巧合。
C. 取件员能在现场多等一分钟让她拍下刻字；这不等于他有权暂停拍卖。母亲可接电话，三集时间连续推进，二十分钟不会每集重置。

EP001｜认出的不是答案
入口：钟在维修铺，沈宁尚未签交接单；她认出钟底字迹，取件员正在催促。
目标与行动：先问清钟的来处再决定交还，她要求查看委托单。
转折与当集兑现：单上是母亲的名字。寻找委托人有了具体对象，但签名本身不能证明母亲的动机，甚至尚未由本人确认。
出口 → EP002：沈宁拿出手机拨给母亲。钟和未签的交接单仍在铺内；沈宁和观众都还不知道卖钟的理由。下一集从母亲接听开始，不重新表演一次“发现母亲名字”。

EP002｜留下也要有代价
入口：继承钟未交出、交接未签、电话待答的状态。
目标与行动：沈宁想让母亲收回委托。母亲在电话中确认亲自签署，并说出修理课租金的打算；沈宁提出留下钟，却答不出替代资金从哪里来。
转折与当集兑现：误送或签错的猜想被本人解释排除，冲突变成保留物件与支持课程之间的选择。观众现在知道母亲的计划，不等于知道父亲会赞成什么。
出口 → EP003：沈宁不再争论单据真伪。她结束通话，请取件员留一分钟拍清刻字，对方答应；钟仍未交出，最终选择仍由她作出。第三集不能又让她不知道租金计划，也不能把卖价写成已知金额。

EP003｜带走什么，留下什么
入口：钟仍在铺内，交接未签；拍照的一分钟已经开始，沈宁已知道母亲的计划。
选择与行动：她拍下刻字，把照片发给母亲，再签交接单、交出座钟。交接后，她告诉母亲钟已由取件员带走，并提出以后处置这些旧物先一起商量；母亲回复同意。
当集兑现：实物离开，刻字有了记录，母女作出一个具体的新约定。收束的是沈宁这次如何取舍，不是假装她不再难过。
结束状态：取件员带走钟，沈宁持有刻字照片，母亲知道她已交出钟。拍卖结果、实际收入与课程能否落实仍未发生；若继续写，它们属于后续任务，不凭空补一场绑架来强留悬念。

一集备选：合并断点，保住决定
整段删掉 EP002，沈宁就会从疑惑签名直接跳到交钟，没获得改变判断的信息；删掉 EP003，就只剩计划，没有选择后果。要保留的是这些作用，不一定是它们之间的集数边界。

上方剧本片段停在“是我妈送来的？”一集版可直接续写下面这段，不在这里断集。它沿用拟新增设定 A–C，是三集地图的备选，不是 EP004，也不是第二次交钟。新增调度把“结束通话、之后再联系”改成母亲一直留在免提电话中，直至取件员离开。对白和调度仍是待作者接受的原创方案，不是从原著找回来的正文。

内景·维修铺·连续
取件员把另一张交接单放到委托单旁。沈宁把钟放正，将手机搁在两张单据旁，拨通母亲的电话，打开免提。
沈宁：是你亲自签的？
母亲（电话）：是。拍得多少，我想拿来贴修理课的场地租金。
沈宁：能不能撤回来？租金我来——
母亲（电话）：你现在拿得出吗？
沈宁把笔放到尚未签字的交接单旁。
沈宁：现在拿不出。
她转向取件员。
沈宁：一分钟。让我把字拍下来。
取件员：一分钟。
通话未断。她倾起座钟，拍下钟底刻字，把照片发给母亲。她把钟放正，在交接单上签字，把交接单和钟交给取件员。他抱钟离开。
沈宁：他带走了。下次卖这些旧东西之前，能不能先一起商量？
母亲（电话）：好，先商量。
沈宁放大照片里最后那个字。

删了什么，哪些作用仍要落地？
• 可删：集间断点，以及重新进入同一个问题的重复交代；把电话保留为一次连续交谈。二十分钟没有重置，取件员只给前述设定中的拍照一分钟，不是把拍卖延期。
• 要留：签名让她找到了能解释的人；母亲确认委托及可能收入的用途；沈宁拿不出替代资金。接下来她先保留刻字，再选择交出实物。她签的是交接单，不是母亲已经签过的委托单。
• 后果要出现：取件员确实抱钟离开，沈宁留有照片，母亲得知交接并同意以后先商量。不能只用“她想通了，放下了”代替这些变化；这也不证明已成交、付了租金、父亲本来就赞成，或沈宁不再舍不得这件旧物。
• 取舍：一集让发现、交涉和决定连续发生；三集可能容纳更多认出字迹、替代方案落空和告别的停留，但前提是戏剧材料与目标形态确实支撑，不是多放两个断点就自然丰富。本续写片段演示因果压缩，两版都不是已计时的 60–90 秒剧本或已拍成片。

对白改稿：改变相处方式，不偷换这次决定
假设作者提出：“能不能让母亲体谅沈宁一点，但仍让她面对租金难题？”这是新的对白方向，不证明原来的短问句写错了。下面是沿用拟新增设定 A–C 的原创替换段，只替换母亲确认签字、说清可能收入用途之后的这一轮交谈；不是又打一次电话，也不是新增一场。

沈宁：能不能撤回来？租金我来——
母亲（电话）：别为了留下它，就把租金揽过去。你现在真拿得出吗？
沈宁把笔放到尚未签字的交接单旁。
沈宁：现在拿不出。
她转向取件员。
沈宁：一分钟。让我把字拍下来。

这轮交谈改了什么？
沈宁先提出替代办法，想争取撤回委托。备选里的母亲先劝她别勉强许诺，再问办法是否可行；租金压力仍在，没有新增资金或延期。原来的“你现在拿得出吗？”更短、更紧，备选则给体谅与阻力同时留下位置。应选择想写的母女关系与节奏，而不是把台词更长当成更自然。
放笔和明确回答打断了沈宁刚提出的交换，却还不等于她同意交钟。下一句是在争取保留字迹的方法；后面仍要真的拍照、签交接单，并让取件员抱钟离开。最后关于以后先商量的对话也保留。这些变化不证明已成交、付清租金，或父亲本来就希望卖钟。
不是每句话都要藏潜台词。“是你亲自签的？”和“现在拿不出”把选择所需的信息说清。照片以及最后放大那个字，已经让观众看见她想留下什么；再补“我彻底放下了悲伤”，就比动作已经表现的多认定了一步。直接承认感受或有意使用旁白，仍是作者可选的写法，不是禁用手段。

选定改法后，按自己的真实场景调整这个请求：
在 /ABS/my-drama 项目中，用 $short-drama-write 修改当前 剧集/<EP>/剧本.md 的[真实场景 ID]。只改点名的租金交谈，让母亲先劝阻勉强许诺，再问沈宁能否承担。保留此前本人确认委托及可能收入用途、沈宁拿不出替代资金，以及后面的拍照、交钟和以后先商量的约定。无关措辞与倒计时不动，不编账户余额、成交价或父亲遗愿。只把选定修改写入剧本，不扩到资产、分镜、图片/视频提示词或媒体制作。
这是有范围的写作请求，不是已经执行的技能调用或计时表演。

可接在前述请求后的分集范围：
先给一集与三集两种切法及其取舍，不写正文。逐集列入口事实、当集选择和结果、观众新知道什么、下一集必须继承什么。把源文事实与拟新增设定分开；缺失的动机不要替我拍板。等我接受分集和新增设定后，再只写 EP001，止步于文本。

en: A source/adaptation record and, when the task needs it, `项目开发/episode-map.jsonl`: the episode map separating established material, proposed changes and episode handoffs.

The requested episode uses `剧集/<EP>/剧本.md`; later stages can add `视觉设定.md`, `分镜.md`, `图片提示词.md` and `视频提示词.md` in that episode folder. These five document types are created as needed, not a requirement to generate every file in advance or proof that media exists.

An explicit next task: revise the pilot, write the next mapped episode or prepare a media-production preview. Text may inform a later workflow, but this does not establish automatic synchronization with Oh Story or the hosted ZenStory app.

For the next visual handoff, see [character consistency across shots](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/character-consistency): one original three-shot scene separates identity, costume, held props and real versus planned references.
zh: 原著与改编记录，以及任务需要时建立的 `项目开发/episode-map.jsonl`：分开记录已有材料、拟改内容和各集交接。
所请求单集的剧本位于 `剧集/<EP>/剧本.md`；进入后续阶段后，可在该集目录添加 `视觉设定.md`、`分镜.md`、`图片提示词.md`、`视频提示词.md`。五类文档按需创建，不要求提前建齐，也不证明媒体已经存在。
明确下一项创作任务：修改试写集、按地图写下一集，或准备媒体制作预览。文本可以给后续流程提供材料，但不表示与 Oh Story 或托管 ZenStory 应用自动同步。
进入视觉交接时，可读[角色跨镜一致性指南](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/character-consistency)：用原创三镜场景，区分人物身份、造型、持物状态，以及真实参考图与计划参考图。

en: Read the pilot against the source and the map: can the audience see the information needed to understand the turn, and does the next episode inherit the actual exit state? Treat proposed additions as author decisions.

A shot description or repeated continuity phrase is not evidence that generated faces, props, motion or voices match. Review real media separately if you later produce it; no quality, duration or publication result is established by this editorial example.
zh: 把试写集与原著、分集地图对照着读：观众是否看到了理解转折所需的信息，下一集是否继承了真实的出口状态？新增内容由作者决定。
镜头描述或重复的连续性词句，不证明实际生成的人脸、道具、动作或声音一致。以后制作媒体时需要另行审看；本编剧示例不建立质量、实际时长或发布效果结论。
