title.en: Revise formulaic AI prose without changing your story
title.zh: AI 写的小说太套路？用具体改稿减少“AI 味”

answer.en: Treat “AI-sounding” prose as an editorial complaint to make specific: vague emotions, repeated sentence patterns, unearned commentary or dialogue that explains too much. Oh Story’s story-deslop combines pattern checks with bounded revision. Keep facts, meaningful details and the chosen narrator’s cadence; removing generic commentary does not require making every sentence short. The original before/after and connected-cadence alternative below show editorial choices, not recorded skill runs, authorship verdicts or detector-score results.
answer.zh: 把“AI 味重”拆成能修改的问题：情绪太空泛、句式反复、议论拔高，或对白解释过多。Oh Story 的 story-deslop 把模式检查与有边界的修订结合起来。保留事实、有功能的细节和选定的叙述节奏；删掉套话，不等于把所有句子削短。下面用原创前后对照及另一种连贯句式展示取舍，不是技能运行记录、作者身份判断或检测分数结果。

en: Choose a passage, chapter or explicit set of files. For a short trial, paste the excerpt; for file-based work, keep a backup first. The documented file mode edits the specified manuscript files in place rather than returning a full replacement novel in chat.

Write down facts, viewpoint, information boundaries and any deliberate verbal habits that must survive. If you only want diagnosis, say “detection only; do not edit files”. For setup and installation-route syntax, use the [writer’s skill guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers).
zh: 选定一个片段、一章或明确的一组文件。短片段可直接粘贴；处理文件前先备份。文档中的文件模式会直接修改指定正文文件，不是在聊天里另给一本完整替换稿。
写清必须保留的事实、视角、信息边界，以及有意安排的口头习惯。只想找问题时，明确说“只检测，不修改文件”。安装与命令路径参见[作者 Skill 指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)。

en: Name the reading problem

Instead of “make it human”, say what fails here: the paragraph names an emotion without showing its cause; several sentences repeat the same rhythm; or the narrator explains a choice that the action already makes clear. A metaphor, repeated phrase or polished sentence is not automatically a mistake. Keep it when it does useful work for this narrator, character or scene.
Set the preservation boundary

Separate the scene’s facts from wording you are willing to change. In the example, the last ferry, broken radio, ticket, hand movement and decision to stay are approved facts. The reason for staying must remain unrevealed. A new childhood memory or secret promise would be a story change, not merely a smoother sentence.
Ask for diagnosis before choosing edits

Use a /story-deslop request with the scope and “detection only” when you want to inspect findings first. The scanner identifies specified patterns and reports locations; a hit is not proof of bad prose or AI authorship. Ask why a flagged phrase is redundant in its actual scene, and leave purposeful expressions for contextual judgment. If the draft is truncated or shows blocking degeneration, return to the drafting/recovery workflow rather than trying to hide missing text with polish.
Revise the smallest useful unit

Prefer a word or sentence change over rebuilding an unaffected paragraph. Turn explanatory narration into clearer wording, an already-established action or dialogue where the scene supports it. The workflow limits deletion by severity and does not allow dropping whole paragraphs or losing plot functions. Shorter is not automatically better, and adding sensory decoration is not a substitute for a scene decision. Choose the passage’s cadence before treating sentence length as a defect. A current, explicit voice choice can override the default expression advice, but not the preservation boundary; it is not automatically a lasting author preference.
Compare meaning as well as wording

Read the original and revision side by side. Did a prop move, a character learn a secret, a promise disappear or the narrator suddenly gain access to another mind? Keep the revision only after resolving such changes. The example’s improvement is specific: dialogue carries the warning and the existing hand movement carries the hesitation, while a generic claim about destiny is removed.
Stop polishing and use the right next workflow

The documented pass stops after two rounds with no new change to the same paragraph, with at most three full-text rounds. Do not keep rewriting to chase a percentage. If a chapter needs changed events or a different information reveal, use the chapter-revision route and its tracking transaction instead. If you are importing an old book first, start with [import and continuation](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue).
zh: 先说清读起来哪里不对
不要只说“写得像人”，而要指出：这段只有情绪名称，没有造成情绪的原因；几句话节奏重复；或动作已经说明选择，旁白还在解释。比喻、重复、工整句子本身不是错误，只要它对当前叙述者、角色或场景有用，就可以保留。
划定不能改的故事边界
把场景事实与可改措辞分开。以下示例中，末班渡船、坏收音机、船票、手部动作和留下的决定都是已确认事实；留下的原因必须暂不揭露。新增童年回忆或秘密承诺，是改故事，不只是改顺一句话。
需要先看问题时，明确只检测
使用 /story-deslop 请求，并写明范围及“只检测”。扫描器定位指定模式；命中不等于文笔差，更不证明文本由 AI 创作。要求解释某处表达在当前场景里为什么冗余；有功能的写法留给语境判断，不机械删除。 如果草稿出现截断或阻断级退化，应回到写作、恢复流程处理，不用润色掩盖缺失内容。
修改能解决问题的最小单位
能换一个词、改一句，就不重建无关段落。场景允许时，可把解释腔换成更清楚的措辞、原本已有的动作或对白。流程按强度限制删除，不允许整段丢弃或删掉剧情功能。更短不自动等于更好，堆感官描写也不能代替场景中的选择。 先确定这段要用的节奏，再判断句长是不是问题。当前明确选择的声音可以覆盖默认表达建议，但不能改动事实边界，也不自动成为长期作者偏好。
前后对读，不只看句子顺不顺
检查改稿有没有移动道具、让角色提前知晓秘密、丢掉承诺，或突然读到了另一个人的内心。先解决这些变化，再接受修订。以下示例的修改理由很具体：用对白完成催促，用已有的手部动作承载犹豫，去掉没有增加信息的宏大议论。
到达目标就停，别反复磨成另一篇
文档规定同段两轮无新改动即停，全文最多三轮。不要为了一个百分比继续重写。如果需要改变事件或信息揭示，就进入章节大修及追踪事务，而不是借润色悄悄改剧情。旧书还没变成项目时，先看[导入续写指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue)。

example.en:
ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXAMPLE — a possible edit written for this guide, not a recorded story-deslop run.
Approved facts: the last ferry sounds its horn; the radio remains dismantled; Chen Yu pushes a ticket to Lin Zhou and urges him to leave; the paper touches his hand; he withdraws it to hold the loose casing; Chen waits for his answer; he chooses to stay and tells her to go first. Do not reveal his reason.

Before:
The last ferry sounded its horn. Looking at the dismantled radio, Lin Zhou felt a surge of complicated emotions he could scarcely describe. Chen Yu pushed the ticket toward his hand and reminded him there was still time to leave. The paper touched him; he withdrew his hand and held the loose casing. He knew he stood at a crossroads in life. This was not merely a repair, but a defense of his deepest convictions. Finally, he chose to stay and told Chen Yu to go first.

One possible revision:
The last ferry sounded its horn. Chen Yu pushed the ticket toward Lin Zhou. “We can still make it.” He did not take it. His eyes stayed on the dismantled radio. The paper brushed his hand; he drew it back and held the loose casing instead. Chen Yu waited for an answer. Lin Zhou offered no reason for staying. “You go first.” The radio lay open on the table, the ticket still beside his hand.

What changed:
- The warning becomes direct dialogue; its meaning stays the same.
- The existing hand movement replaces a vague emotion label.
- The crossroads/convictions commentary is removed because it supplies no established reason in this scene.
- Names, objects, decision and withheld motive remain. This is one restrained voice choice, not a universal rule against expressive narration.

Another voice choice: connect the movement, keep the pause
This is a separate original editorial alternative to the revision above, not its next scene or another tool output. For this exercise only, choose connected narration rather than several short statements. The earlier restrained version remains a possible choice; neither sentence length is a universal target.

The last ferry sounded its horn as Chen Yu pushed the ticket beside Lin Zhou’s hand, telling him there was still time to leave; he kept looking at the dismantled radio, and when the paper brushed his hand, he drew his hand back to hold the loose casing. Chen Yu waited for his answer. The ticket was still beside his hand, the radio still open, and Lin Zhou offered no explanation for staying as he said, “You go first.”

What this version keeps:
- The paper brushes his hand before he withdraws it to hold the casing. Linking those actions keeps the response legible without labeling him frightened, guilty or angry. Those feelings have not been established.
- Chen Yu’s wait gives the unanswered offer its own beat. It need not become another gesture or an explanation of her private thoughts.
- The two uses of “still” return to the unreceived ticket and unfinished radio after his choice. Here the unchanged objects matter; that is a reason to retain the repetition, not a requirement to add it elsewhere.
- “You go first” remains his instruction, not evidence that she leaves, boards or misses the ferry. Nothing here supplies the reason for staying or completes the repair.

Two different ways a “cleaner” edit can go wrong:
“Chen offered the ticket. Lin stayed.” is a possible summary, but not an equivalent replacement for this chosen scene: it loses the paper/hand/casing response, her wait and his instruction. A short form is not inherently bad; this one removes functions the exercise asked to keep. Separately, “Chen Yu pressed the ticket into his palm” changes the action, even if the sentence sounds fluent: the approved ticket stays beside his hand and he does not take it. Recover the existing detail rather than inventing a clenched fist, a secret oath or a new memory to replace it.

Suggested request for YOUR excerpt, after the skill is installed:
/story-deslop
Detection only. Identify specific wording problems in the passage below; do not edit any file.
Preserve my fact list, viewpoint and intentional dialogue habits. Explain each suggested change in context.
[Paste your approved facts and passage.]

After reviewing the findings, request a bounded revision and a before/after explanation. For file mode, inspect the saved file and backup rather than expecting the whole chapter in chat.

If you choose to revise a pasted fragment after diagnosis, make a separate request:
/story-deslop
Revise only the pathless excerpt pasted below, using my approved facts and the findings I have accepted. Return the complete revised excerpt and a brief before/after explanation, including useful flagged expressions you retained. For this passage only, keep connected narration and a separate unanswered pause; do not turn every action into a short sentence. Preserve the paper/hand/casing order, the ticket beside his hand, the dismantled radio, her wait, his choice to stay and “You go first”. Leave his reason unrevealed; do not narrate her departure. Do not edit files or save this one-off cadence choice to author memory.
[Paste your approved facts, accepted findings and excerpt. For your own story, replace this exercise’s facts and voice choice rather than borrowing them.]

This request authorizes a revision, unlike “detection only”; the documented pasted, pathless fragment mode returns the full revised fragment. That does not make a chapter file a chat-only task: file mode writes the specified manuscript and returns only a representative excerpt of at most 200 characters, so retain a backup and inspect the saved text. The examples above are editorial comparisons, not evidence that a skill pass met its deletion limits.
example.zh:
原创改稿示例——为本指南写的一种方案，不是 story-deslop 运行记录。
已确认事实：末班渡船鸣笛；收音机仍拆着；陈雨推来船票并催林舟离开；纸边碰到他的手；他收手按住松开的机壳；陈雨等他答复；他决定留下，让陈雨先走。暂不揭露留下的原因。

改前：
末班渡船的汽笛响了，林舟看着桌上拆开的收音机，内心涌起一股难以言喻的复杂情绪。陈雨把船票推到他手边，提醒他现在走还来得及。纸边碰到他的手，他收回手，按住松开的机壳。他知道，自己正站在人生的十字路口；这不仅仅是一次维修，更是对内心信念的坚守。最终，他决定留下，让陈雨先走。

一种改法：
末班渡船的汽笛响了。陈雨把船票推到林舟手边：“现在走，还来得及。”林舟没有拿票，仍看着拆开的收音机。纸边碰到他的手，他把手收回去，按住松开的机壳。陈雨还在等他的答复。林舟没有解释为什么要留下，只说：“你先走。”收音机仍拆在桌上，船票还搁在他的手边。

为什么这样改：
- 用直接对白完成催促，不改变这句话传达的意思。
- 用原本就有的手部动作承载犹豫，替换空泛情绪标签。
- “人生十字路口”“信念坚守”没有交付已成立的动机，在这里删掉。
- 人名、物件、选择和未揭露的原因保留。这只是克制叙述的一种选择，不是禁止抒情旁白的通用规则。

另一种声音：动作连着写，把等待留下
这是一份独立的原创替代稿，不是上版之后的新场景，也不是另一次工具输出。仅在本练习中，选择较连贯的叙述，不把动作逐个切成短句。前一版克制的节奏仍可选；长短都不是通用目标。

末班渡船的汽笛响了，陈雨把船票推到林舟手边，提醒他现在走还来得及；他仍看着拆开的收音机，纸边碰到手时，便把手收回去，按住松开的机壳。陈雨等他答复。票还在手边，收音机也还拆着，林舟没有解释为什么要留下，只说：“你先走。”

这版为什么留下这些表达：
- 纸边碰手，随后收手按住机壳。把动作接起来，读者仍能看清他的回应，不必把它另判成恐惧、内疚或愤怒；这些情绪尚未成立。
- 陈雨的等待，让没有得到答复的催促单独停一拍。不必再给她补一个动作，或解释她心里怎么想。
- “票还在手边”“收音机也还拆着”在他作出选择后回到两个未变的物件。这里的重复有用，不等于其他段落都该添两个“还”。
- “你先走”仍是他的要求，不证明她已经离开、登船或误船，也没有交代留下的原因、写成维修完成。

两种不同的“改干净了，却改错了”：
“陈雨递票，林舟留下。”可以是梗概，却不能等价替换本练习选定的场景：纸、手与机壳的回应、她的等待、他的要求都丢了。短写法本身没有错，这个压缩版删掉了要求保留的功能。另一句“陈雨把票塞进他掌心”即使读着顺，也已经改了动作：原定的票留在手边，林舟没有接。应恢复原有细节，不用攥拳、秘密誓言或新增回忆来填补。

技能安装后，可这样请求处理自己的片段：
/story-deslop
只检测下面这段的具体措辞问题，不修改任何文件。
保留我的事实卡、视角和有意安排的口头习惯，结合场景说明每项建议。
[粘贴你已确认的事实和正文。]

审阅建议后，再请求有范围的修订及前后说明。文件模式应检查已保存正文和备份，不必期待聊天里返回整章。

诊断后若决定修改粘贴的片段，另发一条请求：
/story-deslop
只修订下面粘贴的、没有文件路径的片段，依据我的事实卡和已接受的问题建议。完整返回修订片段，简述前后差异，也说明哪些命中表达有用而保留。这一次保留连贯的叙述和单独等待答复的一拍，不把每个动作都拆成短句。保留纸边碰手、收手按机壳的顺序，手边未接的票、拆开的收音机、她的等待、他决定留下及“你先走”。不揭露留下的原因，不写她已经离开。不修改文件，也不把本次句式选择保存为作者长期偏好。
[粘贴已确认事实、已接受的问题建议和原文。处理自己的故事时，换成自己的事实和声音选择，不照搬本练习。]

这条请求与“只检测”不同，明确授权修订；文档中的交互式无路径零散片段模式会返回完整改稿。这不把整章文件变成只在聊天里处理的任务：文件模式会写回指定正文，只返回不超过 200 字的代表片段，仍应事先备份、查看保存后的正文。上面的对照是编辑示例，不证明某次技能处理已经满足删除比例上限。

en: Detection-only work should give located findings and reasons without changing the manuscript. A zero-pattern result is not a certificate of authorship or literary quality.

An authorized revision of an interactively pasted, pathless fragment returns the full revised fragment. File mode instead saves changes to the specified manuscript files and returns a representative excerpt of at most 200 characters, with change statistics and before/after information. A detection-only request authorizes no rewrite.

For a change to events, timeline or reader knowledge, use the chapter-revision transaction to update tracking authority and derived views. Do not manually patch separate tracking files to make them appear consistent.

If the edit sounds smoother but no longer sounds like you, use [preserve your author voice](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/preserve-author-voice) to separate this book’s style, a one-off request and a lasting preference without copying the sample’s story facts.
zh: 只检测时，应获得问题位置与理由，正文不应被修改。“没有命中模式”不是作者身份或文学质量证明。
明确授权修订交互式粘贴、无路径的零散片段后，返回完整片段；文件模式则保存到指定正文文件，返回不超过 200 字的代表片段，并附修改统计与前后信息。“只检测”不授权其中任何一种改写。
改动涉及事件、时间线或读者认知时，通过章节修订事务更新追踪权威与派生视图，不要分别手补追踪文件来凑一致。
改完更顺，却不像自己了？看[保留作者文风](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/preserve-author-voice)，分清本书笔调、一次性要求与长期偏好，不把样本的故事事实一并搬来。

en: Ask whether the scene is clearer while the author’s facts, voice and pacing still hold. A recurring phrase may be intentional; pattern counts do not overrule that judgment.
External AI detectors cannot be promised a score by this workflow. This guide concerns prose revision, not hiding provenance or establishing a “human-written” percentage.
zh: 判断场景是否更清楚，同时作者的事实、声音和节奏是否还在。重复表达可能有意为之，模式数量不能替代这种判断。
此流程不承诺外部 AI 检测分数。本指南谈正文修订，不以隐藏来源或建立“真人写作比例”为目标。

title.en: Turn a local video into a source-grounded Chinese narration recap
title.zh: 怎样把本地视频做成有画面与原声依据的中文解说

answer.en: Video Recap Skills separates a Chinese-narration recap into understanding, editorial planning, narration, voiceover and assembly. Starting from an authorized local video, it builds a scene/speech/frame evidence index, chooses a viewer promise and POV, and writes only claims that evidence or supplied context supports. It can deliver a rendered MP4 or an editable draft—not merely a summary over footage. The source need not already have narration: the original no-dialogue example below compares two story angles and a short Chinese script, without treating a claim written on screen as a verified result. A separate partial-source variant shows what to do when only the initial attempts are available: request the missing payoff footage or propose a narrower account, without silently changing a fixed direction.
answer.zh: Video Recap Skills 把中文视频解说拆成理解、编导、写稿、配音与合成。先从你有权使用的本地视频提取场景、对白和画面证据，再确定一条观众承诺与主视角，只写素材或已提供背景能够支持的内容。最终可交付解说 MP4，也可另导出可编辑草稿，而不是给原片随意铺一层摘要。 原片不必已经有旁白：下方用原创无对白素材比较两种叙事角度，再写一小段中文解说，不把画面上写出的承诺当成已经验证的结果。 另一个前半段素材变体说明：只有起初尝试时，应补要结尾证据，或提出范围更窄的观察稿，不默默改掉已确认方向。

en: Install Video Recap Skills in a supported agent host using the current route on the [project page](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap), then open the authorized video’s workspace. In manual commands, /ABS/video-recap-skills means the installed checkout’s absolute path—not a system path.

A local .mp4, .mov, .mkv or .webm that you own or may process, plus Python 3.10+, ffmpeg on PATH and space for frames, WAV files and renders. Burned subtitles require ffmpeg’s libass/subtitles filter.

A Xiaomi MiMo API key for remote ASR, VLM and default TTS. Fish Audio can replace TTS only and needs another key; ASR/VLM still use MiMo. This is not fully offline. Check provider privacy, region and billing terms before sending authorized material.
zh: 先在受支持的 Agent 宿主中安装并配置 Video Recap Skills；按[项目页](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap)选择当前宿主的安装方式，再用该宿主打开获准视频所在工作区。下文手工命令中的 /ABS/video-recap-skills，指已安装 skill 仓库的绝对路径，不是系统自带目录。
一个你拥有或获准处理的本地 .mp4、.mov、.mkv 或 .webm，以及 Python 3.10+、PATH 中的 ffmpeg 和足够的中间文件空间。烧录字幕需要 ffmpeg 的 libass/subtitles filter。
远程 ASR、VLM 与默认 TTS 需要 Xiaomi MiMo API key。Fish Audio 只能替换 TTS，并需要独立 key；ASR/VLM 仍用 MiMo。这不是全离线流程，发送获准素材前应查看服务商当前的隐私、地区与计费条款。

en: Choose the edit shape

Primary route: invoke the installed video-recap skill in its configured host (for hosts exposing that slash name, /video-recap) with a natural-language brief. Use full to retain the source timeline; use cut for a shorter story rendered before narration. State audience, duration, context, subtitles and material that must survive.
Build an evidence index

Understanding detects scenes, extracts frames, transcribes speech, finds quiet windows and writes timeline_fusion.json plus agent_narration_brief.md. It observes rather than invents: facts and inference remain separate. Script-first entry: python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-understanding/scripts/understand.py /ABS/input.mp4 --work-dir /ABS/work. No existing narration does not mean no dialogue: keep speech evidence when people speak. For footage with no dialogue, the understanding script supports --skip-asr; that skips transcription, not remote visual understanding or source sound. An empty transcript is not permission to invent speech or motives.
Separate what is visible from what somebody claims

Record the observed action or readable text, who supplied any background, and what remains unknown. A card saying “opens in ten seconds” proves the card makes that claim, not that the demonstration met it. A pointing gesture does not establish a person’s job, private thoughts or intent to expose someone. Check important frame details against the source; VLM notes can be incomplete or mistaken. The worked example below labels its evidence notes as fictional teaching material, not actual model observations.
Choose an angle before writing

Read the brief, contact sheet, frame facts and ASR. Decide the viewer promise, POV, dramatic question, emotional endpoint and delayed information. For a new recap, compare viable story shapes; for a directed request, honor that direction. Record the spine and change-based beats in recap_story_plan.json. Compare only defensible angles. The example can follow a changing public claim or the visible action that lets a demonstration continue; neither angle supports a fraud accusation. If a later outcome is missing, identify the gap instead of writing it. Propose a narrower promise or state the limit; a fixed direction needs the creator’s decision before substitution.
Assign picture, original sound and narration

In visual_audio_board.json, give every beat a picture task, preferred reaction, in/out reason, original-audio anchor and audio owner. Strong dialogue, action sound or silence may carry a beat alone. In cut mode, create clip_plan.json first; after edited_source.mp4 exists, recheck its storyboard and write on output time.
Write source-grounded Chinese narration

A narration.json block needs a job: context, causal link, foreshadowing, interpretation or transition. Do not restate visible action. Names, motives, relationships and outcomes must trace to visual evidence, ASR, reliable research or user context; never disguise background knowledge as an on-screen fact. Write complete spoken thoughts and preserve dialogue boundaries.
Review, voice and assemble

Ask whether every beat changes knowledge, power, goal, relationship, emotion or risk, and whether any claim lacks support. To review before TTS, take the stage route: after video-understanding, invoke video-script, inspect its plans/narration, then run python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-script/scripts/validate.py --work-dir /ABS/work --mode full. Only then run voiceover.py and assemble.py from their skill directories. Cut validation uses the orchestrator’s output-timeline mode.
Resume from real artifacts

The installed skill normally handles internal handoffs. For script-level cut control, start with python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-recap/scripts/recap.py /ABS/input.mp4 --work-dir /ABS/work --edit-mode cut --target-duration 6m. It exits after analysis for an agent/script handoff, not default human approval. After the required clip plan or narration exists, rerun that exact command; the manifest rejects mismatched source/settings. If you chose stage review, wait before rerunning. After timeline.json exists, use the [draft export guide](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft).
zh: 先选成片形态
主入口是在已配置宿主中调用安装好的 video-recap skill（宿主若暴露该 slash 名，则用 /video-recap），再提交自然语言简报。原片时间线保持完整、只在合适位置加旁白用 full；长素材要收成短故事用 cut，它先剪片，再按剪后时间轴写稿。说明受众、时长、背景、字幕和必须保留的素材。
建立视听证据索引

理解阶段检测场景、抽取代表帧、转写对白、寻找静音窗，并融合为 timeline_fusion.json 与 agent_narration_brief.md。它负责观察，不负责编故事：事实与推断分开，证据不足就保留不确定。脚本优先入口：python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-understanding/scripts/understand.py /ABS/input.mp4 --work-dir /ABS/work。 没有原始旁白，不等于没有人物对白：有人说话时仍应保留对白证据。确无对白的素材，理解脚本支持 --skip-asr；它跳过转写，不跳过远程视觉理解，也不是把原声静音。转写为空不意味着可以编造台词或动机。
分清看见的事与画面中的主张
分别记录可见动作或可读文字、背景由谁提供，以及尚不知道什么。卡片写着“十秒展开”，只能证明卡片作出了这个承诺，不证明演示已经达标。指向一个物件，不足以判定人物职业、内心或“故意拆穿别人”的动机。关键画面细节要回看原片，VLM 笔记也可能漏看或看错。下方的证据笔记是虚构教学材料，不是实际模型观察结果。
先定角度，再写开场

阅读 brief、contact sheet、frame facts 与 ASR，确定观众承诺、POV、戏剧问题、情绪终点和暂缓揭示的信息。首次创作比较可成立的故事结构；用户已给方向时忠实落实。把选定主线和“发生了什么变化”的 beats 写进 recap_story_plan.json。 比较的是素材能支持的角度。下方既可跟随承诺的改写，也可跟随让演示继续的可见动作；两者都不能直接写成“骗局被揭穿”。缺少后续结果时，应先指出缺口，不替素材补结局。可以提出较窄的观众承诺或说明边界；方向已固定时，替换前应由创作者决定。
分配画面、原声与旁白
在 visual_audio_board.json 中为每个 beat 记录画面任务、关键反应或表演、入出点理由、原声锚点和 audio_owner。强对白、动作声或沉默可以独占一拍，不必强铺旁白。cut 模式先写 clip_plan.json；edited_source.mp4 生成后，再看剪后故事板并按输出时间写稿。
写有证据的中文解说
只有一段旁白承担 context、causal_link、foreshadow、interpretation 或 transition 时才写。画面已经说清楚的事不要复述。人物名、动机、关系和结果必须来自画面、ASR、可靠背景或用户上下文，不能把背景资料伪装成当前镜头事实。每段写成可连续朗读的完整意思，并保住原声句界。
短审文案，再配音合成

复核每个 beat 是否改变认知、权力、目标、关系、情绪或风险，只听声音能否懂主线，以及有没有无依据断言。想在 TTS 前人工审阅，就走阶段入口：video-understanding 后调用 video-script，检查计划与旁白，再执行 python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-script/scripts/validate.py --work-dir /ABS/work --mode full；通过后才运行各 skill 目录中的 voiceover.py 与 assemble.py。cut 的输出时间轴校验由编排器选择对应模式。
从真实产物继续

通常由已安装 skill 处理内部交接。若要用脚本明确控制 cut 流程，先执行 python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-recap/scripts/recap.py /ABS/input.mp4 --work-dir /ABS/work --edit-mode cut --target-duration 6m。它在分析后退出，把产物交给 Agent/写稿阶段；这不表示默认流程会请求人工批准。所需 clip plan 或 narration 写好后原样重跑该命令，manifest 会拒绝不匹配的源视频或设置。若选择了阶段审阅，就先保持停止。已有 timeline.json 后再看[草稿导出指南](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft)。

example.en:
For a host exposing this slash name (otherwise select video-recap), this is an original suggested brief—not recorded output, a benchmark or an executed provider run. Its path and timestamps are illustrative placeholders:

/video-recap
Create a six-minute Chinese recap from /ABS/interview.mov in cut mode. I may use it. Show how the guest’s launch claim changes after the failed demonstration. Follow the guest’s POV until failure, then the engineer’s reaction. Preserve the full 18:40–19:05 exchange without narration. Use visible action, transcribed speech and my context; mark uncertain identities. Build the evidence and story/audio plan before concise spoken Chinese. Burn subtitles and retain timeline.json for draft export.

ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXAMPLE — a demonstration with no dialogue
This is a separate, invented teaching example, not the interview file above, a VLM/ASR result or a completed recap. There is no source video, measured runtime, generated voice or importable JSON here. A–E are editorial labels, not timestamps or required schema fields.

Supplied context: the creator identifies the object as a folding display stand. No names, occupations, relationship, product specification or earlier events have been supplied. The imagined footage has no narration or dialogue; room tone and the buckle click remain source sound, not speech to transcribe.

Evidence notes in source order
A. Person A puts a card reading “十秒展开” (“opens in ten seconds”) beside the folded stand. This establishes a written promise, not a measured performance.
B. A pulls at the stand twice. It does not unfold. Do not turn this into a diagnosis that it is broken or a claim that A knew it would fail.
C. Person B points to the still-fastened transport strap. A unfastens it. Pointing is visible; B being an engineer, a supervisor or an accuser is not established.
D. In the same continuous shot after C, A opens the stand. The footage contains no complete, newly timed attempt establishing the ten-second claim. It shows this sequence, not a universal fault diagnosis or product test.
E. A crosses out “十秒” (“ten seconds”) on the card and writes “先解运输带，再展开” (“unfasten the transport strap, then unfold”). The wording changes. We do not know whether A feels ashamed, angry or relieved.

Two supported story angles
1. Follow A and the card: how does a speed promise become a preparation step? Keep A at the beginning and E at the end, with B–D explaining what happens between them. The payoff is a visible change in the claim, not a verdict on someone’s character.
2. Follow the detail B points out: what visible action lets this stalled demonstration continue? Focus on the still-fastened strap, the unfastening and the subsequent opening. This can foreground the practical sequence without claiming a complete instruction manual or general reliability result.
Choose angle 1 for this editorial brief: the before/after card gives the ending a concrete answer. Angle 2 remains a valid alternative; it is not an inferior wording of the same hook. “An expert exposes a deliberate scam” is not a third defensible angle—it adds an occupation, intent and accusation that the notes do not support.

Short proposed Chinese script, with English meaning
Opening, around A — establish what the ending will answer:
“先记住卡片上的‘十秒’。演示结束时，再看这个承诺留下了什么。”
Meaning: Remember the card’s ten-second promise; at the end, see what remains of it.

Middle, B–D — no added line. Let the failed opening, pointing, unfastening and opening remain legible in order. Do not narrate every hand movement or replace the buckle sound with invented dialogue. Keep C and D continuous in this proposed edit, rather than concealing whether something else happened between them.

Ending, after E — distinguish the observed result from the untested promise:
“现在卡片写的是‘先解运输带，再展开’，原来的‘十秒’被划掉了。十秒到底能不能做到，素材并没有重新计时的结果。”
Meaning: The card now says to unfasten the transport strap before unfolding; the original “ten seconds” has been crossed out. There is still no new timed result establishing whether ten seconds is achievable.

The opening directs attention to an actual promise that E revises; the ending names what the footage still does not establish. The middle does not need a sentence for every action. These blocks have no approved timing or proven reading window; this is writing and editorial planning, not narration.json or a six-minute finished script.

A tempting but unsupported rewrite
“He knew the stand was broken, yet kept boasting. An engineer exposed his scam, repaired it and finally proved the ten-second claim.” None of knowing deception, engineering credentials, a repair or a successful timed test appears in A–E. Replacing that sentence with “perhaps” would not create evidence for its added story. Remove those claims; keep the visible sequence and the narrower outcome. Equally, if the real source stops at B, do not borrow C–E from this example to finish it.

If only A–B are available: keep the gap visible; narrow the promise only with approval
This is a separate original editorial variant. The supplied material now stops after the two unsuccessful pulls: C–E are unknown to this edit, even though the full teaching example above describes them. There is still no actual video, measured speaking window or generated output here.

Choose between two different jobs:
- Keep the already-selected before/after-card story. Its ending needs the legible changed card and evidence of the intervening opening sequence. Record those missing source locations or request the missing material; don't write the promised payoff yet. If that direction is fixed, a smaller observation clip is only a proposal, not an automatic replacement.
- With the creator's agreement, make a narrower account of what the supplied excerpt shows. The promise becomes “what this excerpt establishes about the attempts”, not “how the problem was solved” or “what the card eventually said”. Keep A–B in order and make the limited scope clear from the start.

One proposed Chinese narration block for that narrower version:
“卡片写着‘十秒展开’，这里能看到的是两次没有展开的尝试。原因是什么、后来有没有打开，这段素材没有给出答案。”
Meaning: The card says “opens in ten seconds”; this excerpt shows two unsuccessful attempts. It does not establish the cause or whether the stand later opened.

That line identifies the card's claim and the supplied record's limit. Let the two attempts remain visible instead of adding a sentence for every pull. It is not a timing test: two unsuccessful pulls do not prove that ten seconds elapsed or that the stated performance is impossible. Place the line only after finding a real suitable speaking window; no duration, silence slot or finished narration.json is supplied by this example.

Do not import C's pointing, strap or buckle sound, D's opening, or E's crossed-out wording into this variant. Nor should the title or opening promise “the truth at the end” when the available ending cannot answer it. A replay of the same pull is not evidence of an additional failed attempt; an explicitly marked replay is a different editorial use.

Missing supplied footage does not prove that a later event was never filmed, deliberately concealed or never happened. If the notes are incomplete but you have the source, return to the relevant source passage before making a stronger claim. If the available recording itself ends at B, more analysis is not evidence of missing later images. Leave that gap visible or obtain the additional material rather than making an uncertain ending sound conclusive.

Bounded request for this partial-source situation:
Use only the actual A–B-equivalent evidence and source locations I provide; treat all later actions and outcomes as unknown. First say which part of my selected viewer promise cannot yet be delivered. If I require the complete before/after story, list the missing material and stop before writing its ending. Otherwise, propose a clearly narrower observation script and state what it gives up; do not silently replace an already-approved direction. Do not add a repair, a changed card, dialogue, later-event audio or a timed result. Stay in the text proposal; no remote analysis, TTS or rendering.
[Replace the teaching labels with your real source notes and scope.]

Text-only editorial request for your own material
Use the real evidence notes and source locations I supply, not this example’s invented A–E. Separate observations, quoted or on-screen claims, supplied context and open questions. Compare two supported angles unless I have already chosen one; propose the beat order and a short Chinese script for the selected promise. If the required evidence index is absent, identify what is missing—do not silently run remote analysis. Stop at the text plan: no TTS, media rendering or background music. Use actual output-time mappings only after I choose the cut and the edited video exists.
example.zh:
若宿主把已安装 skill 暴露为这个 slash 名（否则在宿主中选择或点名 video-recap），下面是原创建议简报，不是已记录输出、基准结果或执行过的服务商调用。路径与时间戳只是示意占位，不是来自真实文件的证据：

/video-recap
把 /ABS/interview.mov 用 cut 模式做成约六分钟中文解说。我已获准使用录像。让观众看清嘉宾自信的发布承诺怎样在演示失败后变化。失败前跟随嘉宾视角，之后转向工程师反应。完整保留 18:40–19:05 原声，不铺旁白。只使用可见动作、转写对白和我的背景；身份不确定就标明。先建立证据索引与故事/声音方案，再写简洁口语。成片烧录字幕，并保留 timeline.json 以便之后导出草稿。

原创编辑示例——没有对白的展架演示
这是另一个虚构教学案例，不是上方的访谈文件，不是 VLM/ASR 结果，也不是已完成的解说。这里没有源视频、实测时长、生成配音或可导入 JSON。A–E 只是编辑标签，不是时间戳或必填字段。

创作者提供的背景：物件是一副折叠展架。未另外提供人物姓名、职业、关系、产品规格或前史。示意素材没有旁白、没有对白，但仍有环境声和扣件声；这些原声不是等待转写的台词。

按原片顺序记录证据
A. 人物甲把写着“十秒展开”的卡片放在收拢的展架旁。它建立的是书面承诺，不是实测成绩。
B. 甲拉了两次，展架没有展开。不能据此诊断“展架坏了”，也不能说甲早就知道会失败。
C. 人物乙指向仍扣着的运输带，甲解开扣件。指向动作可见；乙是工程师、上司，或有意揭短，都尚未成立。
D. 与 C 连续的同一镜头中，甲随后把展架打开。素材没有一轮完整、重新计时并证实十秒承诺的尝试。它展示这一次的先后过程，不是通用故障诊断或产品测试。
E. 甲在卡片上划掉“十秒”，写上“先解运输带，再展开”。可确认文字被改写，不能据此读出甲到底羞愧、愤怒还是松了一口气。

两个有依据的叙事角度
1. 跟随甲与卡片：一句速度承诺，怎样变成一个准备步骤？开头保留 A，结尾保留 E，用 B–D 连接其间发生的事。兑现的是可见承诺的变化，不是对人物品行下判词。
2. 跟随乙指出的细节：这次卡住的演示，经过哪个可见动作继续下去？重点保留运输带尚扣着、解扣、随后展开的顺序。这可以突出操作过程，不意味着已经给出完整说明书或证明产品普遍可靠。
本次编辑简报选 1：卡片前后变化，让结尾有具体答案。2 仍是可选方案，不是同一句钩子的较差措辞。“专家当场揭穿蓄意骗局”则不是第三个有依据的角度，它额外编出了职业、意图与指控。

一版简短中文稿
开场，围绕 A，提出结尾会回答的问题：
“先记住卡片上的‘十秒’。演示结束时，再看这个承诺留下了什么。”

中段 B–D，不另加一句。让未能展开、指向、解扣与展开的顺序可读，不逐一口播每个手部动作，也不把扣件声替换成虚构对白。本剪法保留 C 与 D 的连续过程，不剪掉两者之间是否另有操作的依据。

结尾，在 E 之后，分清已见结果与未验证的承诺：
“现在卡片写的是‘先解运输带，再展开’，原来的‘十秒’被划掉了。十秒到底能不能做到，素材并没有重新计时的结果。”

开场引导观众留意 E 确实改写的承诺；结尾说明素材仍未证明什么。中间不必每个动作都配一句话。这里没有认可的时间窗口或朗读时长：它是文案与编辑方案，不是 narration.json，也不是六分钟完整成稿。

容易写出、但没有依据的版本
“他明知展架坏了还在吹嘘，工程师当场拆穿骗局，修好以后终于兑现十秒承诺。”A–E 没有证明知情欺骗、工程师身份、修理行为或成功计时。把句子前面加上“也许”，也不会凭空补出故事依据。删掉这些主张，保留可见过程和较窄的结果。同样，如果真实素材只有 A–B，就不能借本示例的 C–E 替它补完结局。

只有 A–B 时：保留证据缺口，获准后再缩窄承诺
这是另一个独立的原创编辑变体。此次提供的素材到两次没有拉开为止；即使上方完整教学例子写了 C–E，对这次剪辑而言，它们仍未知。这里同样没有实际视频、实测朗读窗口或生成产物。

先分清要做哪件事：
- 保留已经选定的“卡片承诺前后变化”主线。它需要可读的改后卡片，以及其间展开过程的证据。先列出缺失的来源位置或补要素材，不先写出承诺的结尾。如果方向已固定，较窄的观察短片只能是备选建议，不能自动替代原任务。
- 经创作者同意，改做只说明现有画面交代了什么的短片。承诺变成“这段能确认哪些尝试”，不再是“问题怎样解决”或“卡片最后写了什么”。保留 A–B 的顺序，从开头就交代范围。

针对较窄版本的一段中文稿：
“卡片写着‘十秒展开’，这里能看到的是两次没有展开的尝试。原因是什么、后来有没有打开，这段素材没有给出答案。”

这段话指出卡片主张与现有记录的边界。让两次尝试在画面上看得清，不必每拉一下再配一句。这不是计时测试：两次没拉开，不证明已经过了十秒，更不证明十秒一定做不到。实际旁白仍须等素材中有合适的朗读窗口再安排，本例没有提供时长、静音槽或可用的 narration.json。

不要借用 C 的指向、运输带与扣件声，也不借 D 的展开或 E 的划字。标题和开头同样不能承诺“看到最后揭晓真相”，然后拿没有后续的素材收尾。回放同一次拉动不是多一次失败的证据；明确标注为回放，是另一种剪辑用途。

没有提供后续画面，不证明后来从未拍摄、有人故意隐瞒或事情从未发生。如果只是笔记不全、原片还在，应先回到相应素材再加强结论。如果现有录像本身就止于 B，重做分析也不是后续影像的证据；应保留缺口或补充材料，不把未知写得像已经落定。

针对不完整素材的有范围请求：
只使用我提供的真实前半段证据及来源位置，把后续动作与结果都当作未知。先指出我选定的观众承诺还有哪一部分无法兑现。如果我要求完整的前后变化故事，就列缺失素材，停在写结尾之前；否则提出明确较窄的观察稿，并说明放弃了什么，不默默替换已确认方向。不加修理、卡片改写、对白、后续事件声音或计时结果。只做文字提案，不远程分析、不配音、不渲染。
[把教学标签换成自己的真实素材笔记与范围。]

用于自己素材的纯文字编辑请求
使用我提供的真实证据笔记与来源位置，不套用虚构的 A–E。分开观察、人物或画面中的主张、外部提供的背景和未决问题。若我还没选方向，比较两个有依据的角度，再按选定承诺给出节拍顺序与简短中文稿；已有方向就沿用。缺少必要证据索引时先列缺项，不自动调用远程分析。停在文本方案，不配音、不渲染、不加 BGM；等我选定剪法、剪后视频确实存在，再用实际输出时间映射编排旁白。

en: Understanding: scenes.json, asr_result.json, vlm_analysis.json, silence_periods.json, timeline_fusion.json and agent_narration_brief.md.
Editorial: recap_story_plan.json, visual_audio_board.json, optional style_card.json, narration.json and, for cut, clip_plan.json plus edited_source.mp4.
Delivery: TTS WAV/metadata, recap_<name>.mp4, subtitles.srt/.ass and timeline.json; editable-draft export is separate.

For a concrete edit decision, see [original sound versus narration](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/original-audio-and-narration): an original five-beat radio scene shows when dialogue, action sound or a pause should lead, and why audio-owner labels alone do not control the mix.

交付产物：TTS WAV 分段与元数据、recap_<name>.mp4、subtitles.srt/.ass 和 timeline.json；可编辑草稿是独立的可选导出。

en: Before TTS, spot-check names, actions, quoted speech and causal claims against frames/ASR; read narration aloud for complete thoughts and usable pauses.
Before delivery, watch the actual final file once, listen once without looking, and inspect joins around preserved dialogue. Reports locate candidates; they do not replace playback.

交付前以正常速度完整看一次实际成片，再只听声音一次，并检查保留原声前后的接点。自动报告只能定位候选问题，不能替代播放。

title.en: Turn a novel scene into meaningful choices and different endings
title.zh: 小说改互动文游：怎样让选择真正改变剧情和结局

answer.en: Start with what the player can change, not a button for every paragraph. Make an important decision’s trade-off understandable, then write a response that preserves what the player actually chose. This original ferry scene goes from source facts to two decision points, advance information, a confirmation exchange and three different ending passages. A meaningful choice need not create a new ending every time; expressive wording can also have a place, as long as it is not sold as a causal branch. These are editorial design notes, not a generated or played game.
answer.zh: 先确定玩家能改变什么，不要给每段小说机械加上按钮。让关键决定的取舍可理解，再写出承接实际选择的回应。本页把一个原创渡口场景从原文事实推进到两个选择点、事前提示、确认对白和三段不同结尾。有意义的选择不要求每次都增加新结局；单纯的表达差异也可以保留，但不能把它宣传成会改变剧情的分支。以下是编辑设计稿，不是已生成或已试玩的游戏。

en: Use a scene you wrote or are authorized to adapt. Separate source facts, author-approved additions and unresolved questions; a character must not act on information they have not learned.
Choose a small narrative-led experience: one player role, a concrete objective, a few locations and an ending condition. More branches are not automatically more agency.

For host setup and the complete pipeline, use the [Novel-to-game quick start](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start). This page focuses on adaptation decisions, not another installation walkthrough.
zh: 使用你创作或获准改编的场景。区分原文事实、作者批准的新增设定与待定问题；角色不能使用尚未获知的信息。
先限定一个叙事主导的小体验：一个玩家身份、明确目标、少量地点与结束条件。分支数量多不等于玩家更有决定权。
宿主配置与完整流程见[小说改游戏入门](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start)。这一页只解决改编设计问题，不重复安装教程。

en: Find the decision hidden in the prose

Write the player’s goal, what blocks it, and what they can actually do. In the ferry example the goal is to leave tonight; the obstacle is an unreadable ticket stamp. Asking someone, fetching a document and accepting a recorded exception are actions; “feel anxious” alone is not.
Protect the source before adding routes

Put cited facts and uncertainties in `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md`. Mark the ferry’s witness-and-register exception as an author-approved rule rather than pretending it was found in the novel. Record narrative-led scope and limits in `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`; let `game-concept` resolve the concept before expanding it.
Put the known stakes before the commitment

In this design, explain both routes while Qiao Ning can still choose: an official duplicate misses tonight’s boat but secures a morning place; testimony preserves the chance to board, while a named exception still needs her separate consent. State these practical stakes through information the character can hear or see, not an omniscient ending spoiler. “Ask a witness” does not mean “consent to everything that follows.” This is a writing decision for this scene, not a mandatory cost-display widget.
Describe actions and effects without moral labels

Use a verb the character can perform, with only the clarification needed for the decision. “Give my name and accept the exception” says more than “Be brave.” Record what the player knows, when the option is available, what changes and how the scene responds. The design labels below are not built-in APIs. In particular, a recorded witness statement and consent to a named boarding exception are different facts; declining the latter does not erase the former.
Reuse the scene without erasing the route

The same dock can appear on several paths, but the ticket, testimony, timing and available actions must agree with the selected path. Here the duplicate route ends with a morning reservation; the witness route leads to consenting or remaining ashore. Do not reuse “You board with no record left behind” for all three. Reusing presentation is not permission to merge incompatible facts.
Write the consequence, not just its state label

Show the character doing the selected action and the world answering it. The three passages below use a held place, a written name and a returned ticket to make their different outcomes readable without inventing a new quest. Not every difference requires another ending: a line that only expresses tone may remain optional flavor, without a promised hidden score or branch. If the concept promises a lasting response to that line, identify where it is read instead of claiming that different wording alone fulfills the promise.
Hand over the causal design before expanding production

Ask `game-world-design` to put the state transitions, ending conditions, narrative beats and smallest playable slice in `design/GAME_DESIGN.md`. Request a design-only handoff explicitly; the main `novel-to-game quick` mode otherwise continues the pipeline. Plain-language input, if used, should map to permitted actions rather than letting a persuasive sentence invent evidence or grant a ticket.
zh: 从正文里找出真正的决定
写出玩家目标、阻碍，以及玩家实际能做的动作。渡口示例的目标是今晚离开，阻碍是船票印章模糊。询问证人、补办凭证、接受登记例外是动作；“感到焦虑”本身不是。
先保护原文，再增加分支
将有引用的事实与疑点写入 `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md`。渡口的“证人加登记”例外要标成作者批准的新增规则，不能假装小说已经写过。在 `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md` 限定叙事主导的范围和边界，先由 `game-concept` 明确概念，再扩展分支。
在行动前说清已知取舍
本例在乔宁还可以选路线时说明：补正式凭证会错过今晚，但能留明早的船位；作证保留今晚登船的机会，实名例外仍要她另行同意。让角色通过能听见或看见的信息理解这些实际后果，不用全知视角剧透结局。“请证人”不等于“同意之后的一切”。这是本场的写作决定，不是产品内置的强制代价提示组件。
把选项写成行动，不贴道德标签
使用角色实际能做的动词，只补足决定所需的说明。“报上姓名，接受例外登记”比“勇敢一点”更准确。写清玩家知道什么、何时能选、改变什么、场景怎样回应。下面的状态记号不是内置 API。尤其要区分已记录的证词与同意实名登船例外：拒绝后者不会抹掉前者。
复用场景，但不清空路线历史
几条路线可以使用同一个渡口，船票、证词、时间与可用行动却要服从已选路径。本例补凭证路线止于明早预约；证人路线才进入同意实名或留岸的选择。不能共用一句“你没有留下记录，顺利登船”收掉三条路线。复用表现不等于可以合并互相冲突的事实。
把结果写成场景，不只写状态值
让人物真正做出所选行动，让世界给出对应回应。下面三段用留好的船位、写下的名字与退回的船票呈现差异，不靠临时加任务制造分量。也不是每个差异都要再开一个结局：只表达语气的句子可以作为表现选项，不承诺隐藏分数或剧情分支。若概念承诺这句话会留下持久回应，就指明在哪里兑现，不能声称只换措辞已经兑现了该承诺。
先交清因果设计，再扩展制作
要求 `game-world-design` 在 `design/GAME_DESIGN.md` 写清状态变化、结局条件、叙事节拍和最小可玩切片。只要设计交接时须明确要求；总入口 `novel-to-game quick` 默认会继续整个流程。若使用自然语言输入，也应映射到允许的动作，不能靠一句“说服他”凭空造出证据或船票。

example.en:
Original editorial example — The Last Ferry (not tool output)

Prose seed:
The last ferry sounded its warning. Rain had blurred the stamp on Qiao Ning’s
ticket. The keeper laid it beside the register instead of tearing it in half.
“The ticket office can issue a duplicate,” he said. “But not before we leave.”

Facts treated as approved within this exercise: Qiao Ning bought a ticket, its stamp is unreadable, and she wants to cross tonight. The keeper cannot accept that stamp alone.
Adaptation additions treated as approved here: a purchase witness plus Qiao Ning’s consent to enter her name in the exception register permits boarding before departure. Finding the witness takes little enough time; fetching a duplicate misses this ferry but secures a morning place afterward. Refusing the named exception leaves her ashore.
No invented bribe, forged ticket, secret relative or magical shortcut. The added rules were not “discovered” in the short prose seed.

The dialogue, staging and register presentation below are original adaptation copy written around those rules, not additional source quotations, screenshots or actual game output. There are still two decision points and three outcomes, with no continuation of the journey.

1. Let Qiao Ning and the player hear the same explanation first
The keeper turned the register toward her.
“Bring a duplicate back and I’ll hold a place tomorrow morning. For this crossing, someone who was there when you bought the ticket has to testify. Their statement goes in the book. I also need your consent to enter your name before I can let you board as an exception.”
“If I ask them to speak, have I already agreed to that?”
“No. You decide about your name afterward. Without that agreement, you stay ashore tonight.”

Decision 1 — show action buttons after this exchange; parentheses are help text visible before selecting:
A. Fetch an official duplicate. (This ferry will be gone; a morning place can be held.)
B. Ask the purchase witness to testify. (The statement will remain on record; named boarding consent comes separately.)

Do not label these “Follow the rules / Cheat,” or substitute “Good ending / Bad ending” for the player’s own view of the cost. The exception is an approved rule here, not a cheat.

2. Testimony is not already consent to a named exception
After B, the passenger steps beside the register.
“I saw her buy that ticket.”
The keeper records the statement and pauses with the pen beside the name field.
“They saw you buy it; that is written here. For an exception, I still need to enter your name. Do you agree?”

Decision 2 — only with the witness and before departure:
A. Give my name and accept the exception.
B. Decline the named exception and stay ashore.

This confirms the already explained cost rather than revealing a new hidden one. A refusal leaves the testimony intact; “Nobody knows you were here” would be false. Nor does the duplicate route guarantee that ticket sales or other processes leave no records: this example distinguishes the specific boarding-exception entry.

3. Write three different closures at the same dock
Each passage replaces its own route’s outcome copy. They are not three consecutive scenes or additional decision points.

Outcome A — official duplicate, a place held for morning:
When Qiao Ning returned, the ferry was no longer beside the steps. She laid the duplicate next to the register.
The keeper checked its number, made an entry under tomorrow morning and handed it back.
“Your place is held.”
She tucked the duplicate inside the wet ticket. Tonight’s whistle was long gone, but tomorrow’s place was settled.

This fulfills a reservation, not tonight’s departure or a completed crossing tomorrow. She did not take the witness route; testimony cannot suddenly grant her boarding tonight.

Outcome B — named exception, boarding tonight:
“My name is Qiao Ning. Register the exception.”
The keeper wrote her name beside the statement, let her see it, and returned the wet ticket.
She crossed the gangplank. As the boat drew away from the steps, she slipped the ticket into her pocket; the line in the register on shore did not disappear with her.

The chosen action and boarding happen, and the exception record remains. This is not unrecorded passage or a prediction that someone will pursue her. Any future use of the record is a separate authorial decision.

Outcome C — no named exception, remaining ashore:
“Don’t enter my name. I’m not boarding this ferry.”
The keeper left the name field empty, closed the register containing the testimony, and returned the wet ticket.
Qiao Ning took it and stepped back from the gangplank. When the boat left, she was still on the stone steps.

The refusal and staying behind remain true; the earlier testimony is not undone, and no morning place has been reserved for her. Neither “She had finally made the right choice” nor an invented punishment is needed to justify this route.

Design labels — not executable syntax or a requirement for another state file:
Initial: proof=none; on_time=true; exception_consent=false; ending=none.
proof tracks purchase evidence the keeper accepts; proof=none does not mean the wet ticket is absent. Having purchase evidence still requires the route’s timing and boarding conditions to be met.
on_time indicates whether the route meets this ferry’s boarding window, not whether the boat is still docked in the ending passage.
- Decision 1-A: proof=duplicate; on_time=false; ending=morning_place. End here; do not show Decision 2.
- Decision 1-B: proof=witness; on_time=true. The statement has been recorded; enter Decision 2. Here proof=witness includes that testimony and record, not consent that has yet to occur.
- Decision 2-A: exception_consent=true; ending=departed_with_record. The prose must deliver both the named entry and boarding tonight.
- Decision 2-B: exception_consent=false; ending=stayed_ashore. Retain the testimony, without a named boarding exception, an assumed morning reservation or later boarding.
Restart restores the initial values and this scene’s history. The subsequent journey is outside this slice. If you later extend it, read back the selected route’s proof, testimony, registration and location; do not claim that future consequences already happened.

Design-only request for a configured agent with the skills installed:
Use this original scene to prepare a narrative-led adaptation design.
Preserve the prose seed; separately label approved adaptation rules and new dialogue.
Use novel-game-analyze, game-concept and game-world-design as appropriate.
Write the brief, source bible, chosen concept and GAME_DESIGN handoff.
Keep two decisions and these three outcomes; write advance information, action buttons,
the confirmation exchange and each route’s outcome passage.
Separate recorded testimony from named-exception consent; do not manufacture trade-offs
through hidden punishment or moral labels. Do not build or generate paid assets yet.
List unresolved decisions instead of continuing the journey on my behalf.
example.zh:
原创编辑示例——《末班渡船》（不是工具运行结果）

正文种子：
末班渡船响过催行的汽笛。乔宁船票上的印章被雨水洇开了。
守船人把票压在登记簿旁，没有撕掉。
“售票处能补凭证，”他说，“但等你回来，这班船就走了。”

本练习采用的已批准事实：乔宁确实买过票，但印章模糊；她希望今晚渡河。
守船人不能仅凭模糊印章放行。
本练习采用的已批准改编新增：购票证人作证，且乔宁同意在例外登记簿实名登记，便可在开船前登船。
找证人来得及；回售票处一定错过本班，但补好凭证后可留明早的船位。
拒绝实名例外则留在岸上。不新增贿赂、假票、隐藏亲属或超自然捷径。
这些新增规则不是从上面几句正文里“读出来”的。

下面的对白、动作与登记簿表现是围绕这些规则写的原创改编文案，不是新增原文引述、截图或实际游戏输出。仍然只有两个选择点、三个结果，不扩写后续旅途。

1. 先让玩家与乔宁听到同一份说明
守船人把登记簿转过来。
“补到凭证再回来，我给你留明早的船位。要赶这班，得找买票时在场的人作证。证词会记在簿上，还得你自己同意实名登记，我才能按例外放行。”
“请他作证，就算我答应登记了？”
“不算。名字要不要记，你再决定；不愿意，这班就不能上。”

选择点1——正文之后再出现动作按钮；括号是点选前已可读的辅助说明：
A. 去补正式凭证。（回来时这班已走，可留明早船位。）
B. 请购票证人作证。（证词会留下；是否实名放行，随后另行确认。）

不要把两项写成“认真守规矩／耍小聪明”，也不要用“正确结局／坏结局”替玩家决定怎样看待成本。这里的实名例外是批准的规则，不是作弊。

2. 证人到场，不等于乔宁已同意实名
选B后，那名乘客走到登记簿边。
“我看见她买了这张票。”
守船人记下证词，把笔停在姓名栏旁。
“这位乘客看见你买票，已经记在这里。要按例外上船，还得记你的名字。你愿意吗？”

选择点2——只在已有证人且尚未开船时出现：
A. 报上姓名，接受例外登记。
B. 拒绝实名例外，留在岸上。

这不是新的隐藏代价，而是前面已说明的最后确认。拒绝后，证词仍在；不能旁白成“无人知道你来过”。走正式凭证路线也不承诺售票等其他环节从未留痕，示例只规定本次例外登记的区别。

3. 同一个渡口，写出三个不同的收束
以下三段分别替换各路线的结果文案，不是顺序发生的三场，也不增加选择点。

结果A——补正式凭证，留好明早船位：
乔宁回来时，船已不在石阶旁。她把补好的凭证放到登记簿边。
守船人核过号码，在明早那一栏记下一笔，把凭证交还给她。
“给你留好了。”
乔宁把凭证夹进湿票里。今晚的汽笛早已听不见，明早的位置却有了着落。

这段兑现的是预约，不是今晚出发，也不是明早已经渡河。她没走证人路线，不能突然拿证词获得今晚放行。

结果B——同意实名，今晚登船：
“我叫乔宁。按例外登记吧。”
守船人在证词旁写下她的名字，示意她看过，再把湿票交还给她。
乔宁踏过跳板。船沿离开石阶时，她把票收进口袋；岸上的登记簿没有因此少掉那一行。

她完成了选择与登船，例外记录保留。这不是无痕通行，也不预告有人将据此追捕她；未来怎样使用记录须由作者另行设计。

结果C——不接受实名例外，留在岸上：
“别登记我的名字。这班我不走了。”
守船人没有填姓名栏，合上已有证词的登记簿，把湿票递回。
乔宁接住票，退离跳板。船开出去时，她还站在石阶上。

这段保留的是拒绝与留岸，不是撤销已有证词；也没有替她预约明早的位置。无需补一句“她终于作出了正确选择”或虚构惩罚来证明这条路线值得存在。

设计记号——不是可执行语法，也不要求新增状态文件：
初始：proof=none；on_time=true；exception_consent=false；ending=none。
proof 记录守船人认可的购票依据；proof=none 不表示湿船票不存在。有购票依据仍须满足该路线的时间与放行条件。
on_time 表示该路线能否赶上本班登船窗口，不保证结局画面里船仍停在岸边。
- 选择点1-A：proof=duplicate；on_time=false；ending=morning_place；结束，不再显示选择点2。
- 选择点1-B：proof=witness；on_time=true；证词已记下，进入选择点2。这里的 proof=witness 包含本例已经发生的作证与记录，不表示尚未发生的实名同意。
- 选择点2-A：exception_consent=true；ending=departed_with_record；实名记录与今晚登船都要在文案里兑现。
- 选择点2-B：exception_consent=false；ending=stayed_ashore；读回已有证词，但不增加实名例外，不默认明早预约或后来上船。
重开时恢复全部初态与本次场景历史；结局后的旅途不在本切片里。若以后扩写续场，再按所选路线读回凭证、证词、登记和位置，不能提前声称后续回响已经发生。

交给已配置且安装了相关技能的 Agent 的“只做设计”请求：
用上述原创场景准备一个叙事主导的互动改编设计。
保留原文种子，把批准的改编规则与新增对白分别标清。
按需要使用 novel-game-analyze、game-concept、game-world-design。
交付产品简报、原著圣经、选定概念及 GAME_DESIGN 设计交接。
只保留两个选择点与这三个结果；写出选择前说明、动作按钮、确认对白和各路线结果文案。
把已记录的证词与实名例外同意分开，不靠隐藏惩罚或道德标签制造取舍。
暂不构建，不生成付费素材；列出待决项，不擅自扩写后续旅途。

en: `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`: player role, scope, narrative-led intent, language and eventual target runtime; a design-only stopping point is not a playable-delivery claim.
`analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md` and `concepts/CONCEPT.md`: cited source facts, approved adaptation departures and the chosen experience.

`design/GAME_DESIGN.md`: a small route map, conditions/effects, advance information, action labels, confirmation dialogue and route-specific closing passages, alongside ending rules and slice scope. Put this writing inside the existing handoff; no extra required file or engine is implied.

When you later request a build, use the [complete quick start](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start). Separately trace each intended ending; one completed playthrough does not establish every route.
zh: `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`：玩家身份、范围、叙事主导意图、语言与后续目标运行环境；停在设计交接不等于已交付可玩游戏。
`analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md` 与 `concepts/CONCEPT.md`：带出处的原文事实、批准的改编偏离，以及选定体验。
`design/GAME_DESIGN.md`：小范围路线图、条件与后果、事前信息、动作标签、确认对白和各路线收束文案，以及结局规则与切片范围。把这些写作内容放进已有交接，不另加必需文件或指定引擎。
后续需要构建时，回到[完整入门流程](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start)。每个计划中的结局须分别走通；一次完整试玩不代表所有路线已经覆盖。

en: Read the choice and its response together: did the player understand the known stakes, did the character actually perform the selected action, and does the ending preserve it? An expressive line need not create a new ending. Do not promise a causal difference that neither the scene nor later design actually uses.

Check impossible combinations: boarding after the ferry has left, using a witness before finding one, or retaining old consent after restart. These are review questions for your implementation, not claims that this page ran it.

Novel to Game is a skills workflow, not a bundled branching engine or a guarantee of coherent, entertaining endings. Runtime state commits must follow replayable rules; a language model’s narration is not itself proof of a state change.
zh: 把选择与回应连起来读：玩家是否理解已知取舍，角色是否真正做出所选动作，结尾是否保留它？表现语气的句子不必再开一个结局；但不能承诺场景和后续设计都没有使用的因果差异。
检查不可能的组合：船开后仍登船、尚未找到证人就用证词、重开后残留旧的同意状态。这些是留给实现的检查问题，不表示本页已经运行过游戏。
Novel to Game 是技能工作流，不是内置分支引擎，也不保证结局自然或好玩。运行时状态须由可重放规则提交；模型叙述“你已上船”本身不等于状态真的改变。

title.en: Character consistency in AI short drama: identity, costume and shot continuity
title.zh: AI 短剧怎样保持角色跨镜一致：人物、造型与镜头状态

answer.en: Separate persistent character identity, the scene’s compatible Look and each shot’s changing state. Then ask what each reference is allowed to control in the current frame—not whether it is simply “a picture of the character.” The original archive example below connects three shots and adds a reference-selection exercise: visible identity, costume compatibility, location geometry and start/end frames need different decisions. Existing images do not have to be regenerated by this suite; external picture plans can support prompt writing without pretending files are ready for the suite’s production API. Text constraints do not guarantee generated consistency.
answer.zh: 先分开长期人物身份、本场相容造型与每镜变化的状态，再问每张参考图在当前画面里允许决定什么，而不只问“是不是这个人的图”。下面沿用原创档案馆三镜，补上挑图练习：可见身份、服装是否相容、场景布局和首尾帧需要不同判断。已有图片不必由本套件重新生成；外部挂图计划可以支持提示词写作，但不冒充本套件投产所需的真实文件。文字约束不保证生成结果始终一致。

en: An accepted scene or episode script. It should establish who appears, which visible state matters and what changes during each shot; resolve story meaning in writing rather than hiding it inside an appearance prompt.
Creator-approved identity facts and scene styling. Do not invent age, ethnicity, facial traits, branded clothing or other details merely to fill a template. Mark unresolved choices instead.

If you plan to use the documented skills, a configured supported agent host and project folder. This guide does not execute image or video generation and its example contains no generated reference asset.
zh: 准备已接受的场次或单集剧本，写清谁出现、哪些可见状态重要、每镜发生什么变化。知识、目标和关系属于编剧，不要把故事语义藏进外观提示词。
准备创作者确认过的身份事实与本场造型。不要为了填模板擅自补年龄、族裔、五官、品牌服装等细节；未决定的内容继续标为待定。
如要使用文档中的技能，还需已配置的受支持 Agent 宿主和项目目录。本指南不执行图片或视频生成，示例也没有生成参考素材。

en: Write Character as the persistent identity

Use observable, comparable anchors that survive a costume change and work beyond a front-facing close-up. In the example, Lin Lan has a V-shaped nape hairline and a right shoulder that sits slightly lower than the left. These belong to Character; the rain jacket, hand-held key, gaze and pose do not. Ask `short-drama-assets` to record the accepted facts in `剧集/<EP>/视觉设定.md`.
Add one compatible Look for this scene

Reference the Character, then record only clothing, hair arrangement, makeup, injury or weathering that can coexist now. Lin Lan’s scene Look is a low-tied hairstyle and a dark-teal matte hooded work jacket with two rows of silver snaps on the left cuff. Keep the brass key as a Prop and its current holder as shot state; neither is part of the Look.
Lock only the invariant visible surface

A LOCK is justified when the fact appears across at least two shots, viewers could notice a mismatch and the story does not change it. Use the minimal phrase “dark-teal matte hooded work jacket, hood down, two rows of silver snaps on the left cuff” across the affected `IMG-*` body, frozen keyframe and `MOTION-*` body. Do not lock the key’s position, hand pose or gaze because those change.
Chain three shots with explicit states

For every shot write `start → one primary action → end`, including each hand, held prop and gaze. The next shot must start from the previous shot’s actual end unless the screenplay establishes a cut or state change. A frozen keyframe normally describes the start only; it must not show an action or prop state that first appears at the end.
Choose references after deciding the frame

Read the finished frozen start frame: which people, places and props are actually visible, and what must stay recognizable? A [creator report](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/issues/94) concerns a named character in prompt text without the corresponding visual-basis entry; it does not establish how a model handles poses. Cite the accepted visual entries for what this frame shows. A portrait that hides the nape cannot establish its rear hairline. Reconsider bindings for every shot rather than carrying the previous shot’s entire reference list forward automatically.
Give each reference a purpose and explicit limits

Identity, Look state, geography, composition and boundary frames answer different questions. Write both what a slot controls and what it must not control. Do not make a costume image dictate where a key is held, or make a location image impose the camera angle and weather of every shot. The source permits one identity slot to include an explicitly fixed whole-episode Look; a changing costume/state needs its own scope. A genuinely different second purpose gets a separate slot, not an “everything reference.”
Distinguish a file, an external plan and a missing input

REF points to a currently readable, inspected project-relative image file. PLAN instead points to a current, resolvable IMG prompt entry or SHOT frozen frame for pictures the creator will prepare and attach externally. It is not a made-up future filename. If the required entry or creative choice is still absent, report the gap rather than presenting a complete plan. With no suitable image-prompt entry, the storyboard can still proceed from screenplay/visual facts; it must not fabricate an IMG merely to keep going.
Keep the external-canvas path separate from suite production

A [creator question and maintainer explanation](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/issues/105#issuecomment-5550666854) distinguish writing reference prompts from calling production with real files. Accepted external plans can support video-prompt writing when that stage is requested; the creator supplies the pictures in their own tool. For short-drama-produce, those planned inputs need actual project files and REF bindings first. Where the chosen route continues actual generated results, the next segment requires the previous real video and its real tail frame, not an early character sheet or planned end frame. No reference plan guarantees model quality or authorizes a paid run.
zh: 先写长期不变的 Character 身份
选换装后仍成立、可观察、可比较，并能在侧面或背面识别的锚点。示例中的林岚有 V 形后颈发际，右肩略低于左肩；这些属于 Character。雨衣、手里的钥匙、视线和姿势都不属于身份。可用 `short-drama-assets` 把已确认事实写入 `剧集/<EP>/视觉设定.md`。
再写本场相容的 Look
先引用 Character，只补本场能同时存在的服装、发型、妆伤与天气化。林岚本场是低束发，穿墨绿色哑光连帽工作夹克，左袖有双排银色按扣。黄铜钥匙仍是 Prop，由谁拿着属于镜头状态，不能吞进 Look。
只锁真正不变的可见表面
同一事实跨至少两镜可见、观众能发现不一致、剧情又不会改变它，才写 LOCK。示例锁面是“墨绿色哑光连帽工作夹克，帽子放下，左袖双排银色按扣”，在受影响的 `IMG-*` 正文、冻结关键帧和 `MOTION-*` 正文中原样携带。钥匙位置、手势和视线会变化，不上锁。
用状态链写三镜
每镜都按“起点 → 唯一主要动作 → 终点”记录双手、持物与视线；除非剧本明确跳时空，下一镜起点应继承上一镜真实终点。冻结关键帧默认只写起点，不能提前出现终点才成立的动作或道具状态。
先定这一格，再选参考图
读已经写出的冻结起点：这一格真正出现哪些人物、地点、道具，哪些需要认出身份？一条[创作者反馈](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/issues/94)指出提示词写进了人物，却没有对应视觉依据；它不证明模型怎样处理姿势。按实际可见内容引用已接受条目。遮住后颈的人像不能证明后侧发际形状；下一镜也要重新判断，不把上一镜整份参考清单自动沿用。
逐图写用途，也写不能决定什么
身份、造型状态、地理、构图与边界帧回答不同问题。每个槽位既写控制范围，也写不得控制范围：不让服装图决定钥匙拿在哪只手，也不让场景图规定每镜的机位和天气。源码允许一个身份槽位明确包含整集固定不变的造型；会改变的服装/状态另设范围。真正不同的第二用途另开槽位，不写笼统的“全参考”。
分清真实文件、外部挂图计划与待补
REF 指向当前项目内可读、已检查的真实图片相对路径；PLAN 指向当前可解析的 IMG 提示词条目或 SHOT 冻结帧，表示创作者将在外部准备并自行挂图，不是虚构的未来文件名。必要条目或创作选择还没有，就报告缺口，不把计划写成已就绪。没有合适图片提示词条目时，分镜仍可从剧本与视觉事实进入，不能为了继续而假造一个 IMG。
外部画布与本套件投产是两条使用路径

一则[创作者提问与维护者解释](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/issues/105#issuecomment-5550666854)区分了参考提示词写作和带真实文件调用生产。已接受的外部计划可在被请求时继续写视频提示词，图片由创作者在自己的工具里准备、挂载；交给 short-drama-produce 时，才须先让计划输入成为项目内真实文件并绑定 REF。采用实际生成结果续接的路线，后段还需上一段真实视频与真实尾帧，不能由早期角色图或计划终点帧替代。挂图计划不保证模型效果，也不授权付费调用。

example.en:
ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXAMPLE — written for this guide, not skill output, generated media or a production test.
Scene: At a rain-soaked archive loading bay, Lin Lan must open locker 17 while keeping a red evidence folder dry. The steel bench stands directly beside locker 17, so the three shots require no off-shot repositioning. Her jacket hood stays down, leaving the nape anchor visible.

Character — Lin Lan: V-shaped nape hairline; right shoulder slightly lower than left.
Look — LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN: references Lin Lan; low-tied hair; dark-teal matte hooded work jacket; hood down; two rows of silver snaps on the left cuff.
LOCK — LOCK-LINLAN-JACKET: “dark-teal matte hooded work jacket, hood down, two rows of silver snaps on the left cuff”; active in SHOT-01 through SHOT-03.
Prop — brass locker key and red evidence folder remain separate assets. Throughout these three shots, the left arm pins the folder and the left hand supports its lower edge; only the right hand handles the key.

SHOT-01 — Start: folder tucked under left arm, key on the steel bench, right hand empty, gaze on the key. Action: Lin Lan picks up the key with her right hand. End: folder under left arm, key in right hand, gaze shifts to locker 17.
SHOT-02 — Start: inherit the preceding end. Action: she inserts the key into locker 17. End: folder under left arm, key remains in the lock, right hand stays on it, gaze on the keyhole.
SHOT-03 — Start: inherit the preceding end. Action: she turns the key once. End: folder still under left arm, key turned in the lock, right hand on the key, gaze moves to the door seam.

Reference-selection exercise: these candidate-picture descriptions were written for the guide. No such images were supplied or inspected in this session.
A | Proposed daytime front portrait of Lin Lan: loose hair, an ivory shirt and bookshelves behind her. If the author confirms identity and an actual inspection supports it, it may provide visible facial features. The filename cannot establish identity, and the portrait cannot establish a V-shaped nape hidden by hair. The shirt, loose hair, shelves and frontal camera are not new facts for the rain-night scene.
B | Proposed rainwear picture: hood up, with one black strap on the left cuff. That conflicts with the accepted hood-down jacket and two rows of silver snaps. To keep the design, choose a compatible picture. If the author changes the Look instead, update the accepted visual specification and affected LOCK/shots; do not call that merely adding a reference. Negative wording cannot guarantee removal of conflicts already present in a picture.
C | Proposed empty loading-bay wide view: daylight, steel bench beside locker 17, fixed entrances clear. It can help establish spatial relations, not force every shot into that wide composition or change the story from rainy night to daytime.
D | Proposed shot-three end frame: the key has turned, the right hand remains on it and the gaze has moved to the door seam. That is the existing end state, not the third shot's start. Using it as a start frame advances the result of the turn; it is not a tail frame taken from an actual video either.

An optional directing choice for this pass: make SHOT-03 a medium view from the left rear, showing the nape, left cuff, folder under the left arm and right hand on the key in the lock. Bench and locker remain adjacent. This is a new camera proposal requiring author acceptance, not a change to the three shots' action order or accepted endpoint.
That frame does not need A's frontal face merely because a character picture is available. It needs support for the visible rear anchors and compatible Look. Resolve B's costume conflict first. C may serve geography. D cannot substitute for this shot's start frame.

Do not hide decisions inside “use everything as reference”
“Use B's person and C's location, then start every shot like D” imports conflicting clothing, a fixed wide composition and an early end state. A clearer request preserves the accepted identity/Look, lets the location reference control only bench/locker spatial relations, and makes each start frame obey its own shot's start. Scope declarations express creative intent; they do not guarantee a model will separate influences perfectly.

How can a reference record avoid inventing files?
1. The author has supplied a picture, it is readable in the project and its content/purpose has been inspected: use REF with a project-relative file path. Do not require regeneration through this suite or invent an IMG entry for a real supplied image.
2. The creator explicitly prepares and attaches pictures in their own canvas: use PLAN with an existing project IMG or SHOT entry, not a future filename such as 待提供/some-picture.png. It says what to attach and in what order; it is not another label for waiting on an upload.
3. The corresponding entry or necessary preparation choice is still absent: keep a stated gap. Missing pictures do not silently select text-to-video or make an incomplete plan ready for external prompt work.

The next two slots illustrate syntax, not a complete production-input list. They assume the author has accepted the proposed camera choice, and that its matching SHOT-03 frozen start and an IMG-LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN entry titled 林岚雨夜造型 already exist in the current project. The author must additionally have confirmed that this Look remains fixed for the entire episode and explicitly chosen external picture preparation. Without those premises, do not copy these as a ready plan:
PLAN-START-03（顺序：1）· SHOT-03《17号柜转钥匙起点》（用途：起始帧；控制：已接受的左后侧中景、站位、钥匙已插入但尚未转动的起始状态；不得控制：已经转过的钥匙、柜门打开或新的终点）
PLAN-LINLAN（顺序：2）· IMG-LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN《林岚雨夜造型》（用途：身份；控制：可见后颈发际、肩线及已确认本集固定造型；不得控制：手势、钥匙位置、视线、场景地理、镜头构图）
Meaning: slot 1 uses the existing SHOT start for the accepted camera/placement and the inserted-but-unturned key, not the endpoint. Slot 2 uses the existing Look prompt entry for visible identity anchors and the separately confirmed whole-episode Look, not hands, key position, gaze, geography or composition. The Chinese field names preserve the source's documented slot syntax.

Including fixed clothing in that identity slot depends on the explicit whole-episode premise above; a costume picture does not automatically become identity. If clothing, wetness or damage changes within the episode, scope that state separately. A genuinely different purpose for the same image gets a separate slot. REF and PLAN can coexist, but their order is one sequence; two different inputs cannot both be Picture 1.
The syntax excerpt omits other potentially needed geography/prop inputs. Formal records must cover the actual visible frame and retain real gaps. No project entries or pictures were created here, so this guide claims no shot has passed readiness or production checks.

If you later choose an end frame for shot three, it can only show the already-selected turned key, hand still on it and gaze at the seam. Opening the locker is not this three-shot sequence's accepted endpoint. An end-frame slot also requires a corresponding start frame. Even both planned boundaries do not establish the intervening movement, or supply the actual video/tail frame required by a later actual-result continuation.

Copyable text handoff request:
In project /ABS/my-drama, EP001, preserve Lin Lan's accepted identity, Look, LOCK and three-shot action order. Read the current frozen frames and explain each frame's visible subjects and reference needs.
Separate images actually supplied and inspected, explicit external preparation plans and remaining gaps. Do not say an unread picture has been checked. Surface costume or boundary-state conflicts without automatically changing the accepted design.
For external plans, PLAN must resolve to a current IMG or SHOT, with order, purpose, control and non-control scope. Report missing entries; do not substitute future filenames.
Text only. Do not move into video prompts unless requested, generate images/video/voices/music or start suite production.
example.zh:
原创编辑示例——为本指南编写，不是技能执行输出、生成媒体或投产测试。
场景：雨夜的档案馆装卸区，林岚要打开 17 号柜，同时护住一份红色证物夹。钢台紧挨 17 号柜，三镜之间无需补走位；夹克帽子保持放下，让后颈锚点可见。

Character｜林岚：V 形后颈发际；右肩略低于左肩。
Look｜LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN：引用林岚；低束发；墨绿色哑光连帽工作夹克；帽子放下；左袖双排银色按扣。
LOCK｜LOCK-LINLAN-JACKET：“墨绿色哑光连帽工作夹克，帽子放下，左袖双排银色按扣”；SHOT-01 至 SHOT-03 生效。
Prop｜黄铜柜钥匙与红色证物夹分别建资产。三镜中，左臂始终夹住文件夹，左手压住其下缘；只有右手操作钥匙。

SHOT-01｜起点：证物夹在左腋下，钥匙在钢台上，右手空，视线看钥匙。动作：林岚用右手拿起钥匙。终点：证物夹仍在左腋下，钥匙在右手，视线转向 17 号柜。
SHOT-02｜起点：继承上镜终点。动作：她把钥匙插入 17 号柜。终点：证物夹仍在左腋下，钥匙留在锁孔，右手扶住钥匙，视线看锁孔。
SHOT-03｜起点：继承上镜终点。动作：她把钥匙转动一次。终点：证物夹仍在左腋下，钥匙已在锁孔内转过，右手仍扶钥匙，视线移到柜门缝。

挑图练习：以下都是为教程编写的候选图描述，不是本次收到或看过的图片。
A｜拟用的林岚日间正面人像：披发、米白衬衫，后面是书架。若作者确认身份且实际检查相符，它可以提供可见面部特征；不能由文件名推定同一人，也不能证明被头发遮住的 V 形后颈发际。白衬衫、披发、书架和正面机位都不是雨夜场景的新设定。
B｜拟用的雨衣图：人物戴着帽子，左袖只有一道黑色带子。它与已经接受的帽子放下、双排银色按扣冲突。保持原案就换成相容的图；若作者决定改造型，则同步改视觉设定与受影响的 LOCK/镜头，不把改造型说成“只是挂了一张参考”。写负面词不能保证消除已有图像中的冲突。
C｜拟用的装卸区空场全景：白天，钢台紧挨17号柜，固定出入口清楚。它可帮助说明地理关系，不强迫后续每镜都是这个全景，也不把故事的雨夜改成白天。
D｜拟用的第三镜收尾画面：钥匙已经转过，右手仍扶钥匙，视线已到柜门缝。这是原案终点，不是第三镜起点。把它当首帧，会把“转动一次”的结果提前；它也不是从实际视频中取得的尾帧。

本轮可选的导演决定：为 SHOT-03 采用左后侧中景，能看见后颈、夹克左袖、左臂下的文件夹和右手扶着锁孔中的钥匙。钢台与17号柜仍相邻。这是新增机位候选，需作者接受；不改变三镜的动作次序或既定终点。
在这个画框里，不必为了“角色图必须有”就强行挂 A 的正脸；更需要能支持可见后侧锚点与相容造型的依据。B 应先解决造型冲突。C 可按地理用途保留。D 不能替代此镜起始帧。

不要用一个“全参考”掩盖选择
“照B图的人物，照C图的场景，每镜都按D图开始。”会把冲突造型、固定全景和过早的终态一起带入。更清楚的任务是：保留已接受的林岚身份/Look；地点参考仅管钢台与柜子的空间关系；每镜首帧分别服从该镜起点。控制范围说明的是创作意图，不保证模型一定分离得干净。

挂图记录怎样写才不假装有文件？
1. 图片已经由作者提供、项目内可读且内容/用途检查相符：写 REF，定位符是项目相对文件路径。不要求先用本套件重生成，也不为真实图虚构 IMG 条目。
2. 作者明确在自己的画布准备并挂图：写 PLAN，定位符是当前项目已存在的 IMG 或 SHOT 条目，不是“待提供/某图片.png”。它说明挂哪一项、按什么顺序挂，不是“还在等文件上传”的同义词。
3. 还没有对应条目，或没有决定怎样准备必要图片：保留待补。缺图不自动选择文生视频，也不把未完成计划标成可继续的外部挂图方案。

下面仅是两个槽位的语法样例，不是完整的投产输入清单。前提是作者已接受上述机位，当前项目已经存在与之对应的 SHOT-03 冻结起点，以及标题为“林岚雨夜造型”的 IMG-LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN 条目；作者另已确认这套Look在本集全程不变，并明确选择外部挂图。若前提尚未成立，不要照抄为已就绪：
PLAN-START-03（顺序：1）· SHOT-03《17号柜转钥匙起点》（用途：起始帧；控制：已接受的左后侧中景、站位、钥匙已插入但尚未转动的起始状态；不得控制：已经转过的钥匙、柜门打开或新的终点）
PLAN-LINLAN（顺序：2）· IMG-LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN《林岚雨夜造型》（用途：身份；控制：可见后颈发际、肩线及已确认本集固定造型；不得控制：手势、钥匙位置、视线、场景地理、镜头构图）

这个身份槽位能带固定造型，依赖上面额外写明的“整集不变”前提，不是见到一张服装图就能并入身份。若本集会换装或改变湿污/破损状态，给相应状态单独的范围；若同一图片承担另一个不同用途，另列槽位。混用 REF 与 PLAN 时统一顺序，不能把两个不同输入都写成第1张。
语法样例没有列齐地理与道具等可能需要的其他输入；正式记录须按该格实际可见内容补齐依据与真实缺口。这里没有创建项目条目或图片，因此不声称任何镜头已通过就绪或投产检查。

如果以后确实需要第三镜的结束帧，它只能显示原案中“钥匙已转过、手未松开、视线移到门缝”；柜门打开不在这三镜的既定终点内，不能顺手加上。一个结束帧槽位还须有对应起始帧。即使计划首尾帧都写齐，也未得到中间运动，更未得到后续段所需的实际视频/实际尾帧。

可复制的文字交接请求：
在项目 /ABS/my-drama 的 EP001 中，保留林岚上述三镜的已接受身份、Look、LOCK与动作次序。先根据当前冻结帧逐镜说明可见对象和参考需求。
区分本次真正提供且已读取的图片、作者外部出图计划、仍待补的内容；未读取的图不声称已检查。发现造型或起终状态冲突时，列明取舍，不自动改原案。
如果选择外部挂图，PLAN只能引用项目中可解析的IMG或SHOT，并列顺序、用途、控制与不得控制范围；缺条目就报告，不拿未来文件名替代。
只交文本；没有请求视频提示词时不自动扩到该阶段，不生成图片、视频、配音或音乐，不启动本套件生产。

en: `剧集/<EP>/视觉设定.md`: the Character entry, one compatible Look, separate Props, scoped states and only the necessary continuity LOCK.
`剧集/<EP>/图片提示词.md`: copyable `IMG-*` prompt entries carrying the accepted anchors and LOCK text. They are text deliverables, not evidence of generated assets.

`剧集/<EP>/分镜.md`: shot-state chains, frozen frames, frame-specific visual basis and honest REF, PLAN or missing-input status. When requested, video prompts can use a complete accepted external PLAN; that does not supply the actual files short-drama-produce needs.

`剧集/<EP>/图片提示词.md`：携带身份锚点与 LOCK 锁面的可复制 `IMG-*` 提示词；它是文本交付，不证明图片已生成。
`剧集/<EP>/分镜.md`：镜头状态链、冻结帧、逐帧视觉依据与真实的REF、PLAN或待补状态。被请求时，视频提示词可使用完整且已接受的外部PLAN；它不提供short-drama-produce所需的实际文件。

en: Editorially compare all three shots: Character anchors remain the same, the Look is compatible, the exact LOCK surface is carried wherever required, and every hand, prop and gaze at a shot start matches the preceding end.

Before using a reference, distinguish inspected images from described or planned ones and check what the current frame actually needs. REF files must exist and match their declared purpose; PLAN locators must resolve to current entries and remain outside suite production until real files are bound. Text review does not validate generated-media quality or continuity.
zh: 逐镜做编辑核对：Character 锚点不变，Look 内部相容，LOCK 锁面在所需位置原样出现；每镜起点的双手、持物与视线都接得上前镜终点。
使用参考前，分清已检查图片与描述/计划，并核对当前画框真正需要什么。REF文件须真实存在且符合声明用途；PLAN须解析到当前条目，真实文件绑定前仍不能交本套件生产。文本审阅不证明生成媒体质量或连续性。
