title.en: Keep your author voice when AI continues a novel
title.zh: AI 续写怎样保持我的文风，而不是记住另一本书的情节？

answer.en: Describe the dimensions of your voice, give a short sample you own or may use, and separate those choices from the current book’s facts. Oh Story’s documented workflow resolves the current request, book style and relevant active author preferences before generic writing advice; a sample alone does not establish a permanent preference. The useful result is a continuation that fits this narrator and scene—not copied phrases, mandatory short sentences or a claimed voice-similarity score. The original comparison also shows a one-paragraph exception: keep extended observation while dropping the semicolon pattern and comic aside, without rewriting the book’s preferences.
answer.zh: 把文风拆成表达维度，提供自己写的或获准使用的短样本，再与本书事实分开。Oh Story 的文档流程在写作前按当前要求、本书文风和相关 active 作者偏好作裁决，通用写法补缺；仅凭一段样本，不等于确认长期习惯。目标是符合当前叙述者和场景的续写，不是搬原句、强制短句，或追求“文风相似度”分数。 原创对照还示范一种本段例外：保留较长观察，却不用分号结构和调侃收尾，不因此改写全书偏好。

en: Use your own or authorized prose. Choose a representative passage and explain which features you want to carry over; note deliberate exceptions rather than treating every sentence as a rule.
Name the current book, viewpoint, established scene facts and unrevealed information. Keep these distinct from sentence rhythm, diction, punctuation, imagery and narrative distance.

Use a configured Oh Story agent host and the intended writing workspace. Existing author memory is optional; ordinary writing can continue when no memory state exists. For chapter-to-chapter facts, see [long-novel continuity](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity).
zh: 使用自己写的或获准使用的文字。选能代表目标风格的片段，说明想沿用什么；标明有意的例外，不把每一句都当规则。
点明当前书、视角、既定场景事实和暂不揭露的信息。把它们与句子节奏、措辞、标点、意象和叙述距离分开。
在配置好的 Oh Story 宿主及目标写作工作区操作；作者记忆不是写作前提，不存在时可直接继续。跨章事实承接见[长篇连续性指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity)。

en: Ask what makes the sample yours

Name a few useful tendencies: a long observational sentence followed by a brief exchange, understated humor, close third person, or a restrained vocabulary. Explain their function here. Do not require a semicolon, metaphor or catchphrase in every paragraph. The example below distinguishes a reusable expressive purpose from a paragraph mold, then writes a narrower local choice rather than merely naming its features.
Separate three kinds of input

Sample observations are evidence to discuss, not automatically active memory. The current book’s characters, objects, secrets and events belong to its settings and tracking. An explicit enduring preference can be recorded at the narrowest intended scope: book, genre, workflow or global. A request for this passage only should simply be followed.
Resolve conflicts by dimension

Within safety, authorization and delivery constraints, the explicit current request outranks this book’s style, which outranks applicable author-memory preferences and generic references. Resolve viewpoint, rhythm, punctuation and other dimensions separately: keep the sample’s rhythm while using this book’s third person. Lower-priority guidance fills gaps; it does not cancel an intentional long sentence merely because a default prefers short ones. Read the current book’s full 设定/文风.md when present, rather than relying only on an old summary; an absent style file does not require a placeholder.
Carry the same decision through drafting and review

Oh Story’s style_resolution is a working decision for the task, not a new permanent author profile. The documented workflow passes the same decision to downstream drafting, rewriting and review so a later pass does not restore a generic style. Intentional expression still needs readable syntax, supported character knowledge and sound causality. The query script filters stored active preferences; the writing agent applies their meaning and resolves dimensions. It is not a deterministic voice-matching engine.
Treat memory as an explicit scoped action

Repeated corrections or inferred sample patterns remain pending until confirmed; pending items do not constrain writing. An explicit long-term request uses record and returns an Author Memory Receipt. Without that receipt, do not say it has been remembered. A book-specific exception should not erase a global habit, and a one-off request should not silently rewrite either.
Revise the preference when your intention changes

Use an explicit replacement for a changed rule, or ask to forget a preference so it is no longer loaded. Forgetting does not promise deletion of historical evidence. The profile, pending list and change log are derived views of _author-memory-state.json; do not edit their Markdown to simulate a successful memory update.
zh: 先说样本哪里像你
提取少数有用倾向：观察稍长、对话简短、轻微调侃、贴近人物的第三人称，或克制的用词，并说明这次为什么要它。不要要求每段必须有分号、比喻或口头禅。 下方例子会分开表达作用与段落模具，并把更窄的本段选择真正写成文字，不只列出特征。
把三类输入分开
从样本观察到的模式只是待讨论证据，不自动成为 active 记忆。本书人物、道具、秘密与事件归设定和追踪；明确的长期偏好按本书、题材、流程或全局等适用范围记录。“只改这一段”则只执行，不偷偷记成习惯。
按表达维度解决冲突
在安全、授权和交付约束之内，当前明确要求优先于本书文风，再到适用的作者记忆和通用方法。视角、节奏、标点分别裁决：可以借样本的节奏，仍用本书第三人称。低优先级只补缺项，不能因默认偏好短句就剪掉作者有意保留的长句。 本书有设定/文风.md 时读全文，不只用旧摘要；没有文件也不必先建占位文件。
让写作和审稿沿用同一决定
style_resolution 是本次任务的表达裁决，不是新建永久画像。文档要求把同一裁决交给后续正文、改写与审稿，避免下一轮又套回通用风格；但有意的表达仍需语句可读、角色认知有据、因果成立。 query 脚本负责筛选已存的 active 偏好，语义上的维度裁决由写作流程中的 Agent 完成，不是确定性的文风匹配引擎。
记住偏好，要明确范围和回执
重复修改或样本推断先待确认；pending 不参与正文约束。明确的长期声明通过 record 记录，并返回 Author Memory Receipt；没有回执，不能声称已记住。本书例外不应删除全局习惯，一次性要求也不应暗改两者。
意图变了，再替换或停用
长期规则改变时明确替换；不再需要时要求忘掉，使其不再加载。“忘掉”不等于删除历史证据。画像、待确认清单与变更记录是 _author-memory-state.json 的派生视图，不手改 Markdown 冒充记忆更新。

example.en:
Original editorial example — The Last Button (not a recorded Oh Story run)

A short sample written for this guide, from a DIFFERENT story:
“After lunch, Father turned his empty bowl halfway around, as though the other side might still hold some soup; when I offered the kettle, he left it in my hand and asked whether the mint by the window needed watering again.”
Possible observations: an extended sentence, a semicolon turn, concrete observation and mild humor. These are tentative observations, not proof of an enduring preference. Father, soup, the first-person narrator and the mint plant do not belong to the new book.

Facts fixed for The Last Button:
Third person, close to Tang He. Master Zhou puts a matching dark-green button in her palm and says the repair cannot be finished today, but will be ready tomorrow morning. Tang He holds the button against the gap on her coat and checks the color. Do not add a family history, a hidden relationship or another character’s thoughts.

A plain, shorter rendition—not an incorrect draft:
“Master Zhou put the dark-green button in Tang He’s palm. ‘Not today. Come back tomorrow morning.’ She held it against the gap on her coat. The color matched.”

One alternative after the author chooses a longer rhythm and mild humor for THIS BOOK:
“Master Zhou put the dark-green button in Tang He’s palm and said the repair would have to wait until tomorrow morning; she held it against the gap on her coat, where the color matched so exactly that it was a pity buttons could not sew themselves back on.”
Both versions preserve the same actions and deadline. The second changes cadence and commentary, not the plot. It does not transplant the sample’s bowl, mint, father or first-person viewpoint. This is one editorial option, not a measured likeness or a guarantee of consistent model output.

The same voice does not require identical paragraphs
This sample can suggest tentative observations such as an unhurried pace and mild humor. It cannot, by itself, authorize “every paragraph must have one long sentence, a semicolon and an object trying to do something impossible.” That is a paragraph mold, not a confirmed author habit. An author can deliberately choose a recurring form and discuss its purpose; do not pass off your own extraction as that choice.

A more useful choice than copying punctuation is to follow what the viewpoint character can actually see and hear, allowing observation room when it helps. Use humor when it contributes, not to complete a feature checklist. In the button scene, Master Zhou's words supply the repair deadline and Tang He's action checks the color. The sample's sequence of a turned bowl and an offered kettle left in the narrator's hand does not belong here. A new passage need not replay that sequence with different props to carry the selected expressive choices.

An explicit request for this paragraph only:
“Retain the longer observational rhythm here, but omit the humor and do not reuse the semicolon structure. Keep close third person with Tang He and the same facts. Give a text proposal only; do not change the book style or author memory.”

One original candidate for that local request—not a passage following the earlier alternatives:
“Master Zhou put the matching dark-green button in Tang He's palm and said the repair could not be finished today, but the coat would be ready for collection tomorrow morning. Tang He held the button against the gap in her coat, looking from the small patch of green to the surrounding cloth and finding that the colors matched.”

The first full stop comes after the tomorrow-morning deadline, letting Master Zhou's answer settle before the next sentence follows Tang's color comparison. The attention stays between the button and fabric. This expands the existing color check into observation without importing the sample's first person or inventing the master's thoughts. It keeps a more extended sentence rhythm without tying both halves together with a semicolon, and it omits the joke about buttons sewing themselves back on.

Losing that mild comic aside is the cost of this request, not evidence that the result must be more like the author. Choose the earlier version if you want its warmer commentary; discuss this one if the passage should simply settle the color and deadline quietly. Neither version completes the repair early. Judge what the paragraph should do, not how many style keywords it matches.

Omitting humor here does not revoke the earlier book-level choice to allow useful mild humor. The next task follows its own explicit request and the book choices that still apply, rather than inheriting a book-wide ban from this exception. This illustrates decisions by dimension and scope without creating a preference record; the enduring-memory request below remains a separate action to ask for explicitly.

Copyable request for story-long-write in your configured host:
Use the authorized sample only to discuss expression, not to copy sentences or transfer its story facts. Work only on the specified passage of The Last Button; preserve the fixed actions, tomorrow-morning deadline and close-third viewpoint. For this book, I want longer observational sentences and mild humor where they help; do not add them to every paragraph. First state the applicable style decisions, then return one proposed passage without changing project or memory files. Distinguish tentative sample observations from my explicit choices. Carry the same decisions into review; do not mechanically shorten the passage.

Optional SEPARATE enduring request, only if this is really your intention:
“Remember for The Last Button: allow longer observational sentences and mild humor where they help. This is a book-specific preference, not a global rule.”
This is an example request, not a receipt. No preference has been recorded by this guide. A later ‘make this one paragraph brisk and factual’ request governs that paragraph without silently replacing the book preference.
example.zh:
原创编辑示例——《最后一枚纽扣》（不是 Oh Story 运行结果）

为指南写的短样本，来自另一个故事：
“午饭过后，父亲把那只空碗转了半圈，像是换个方向就能找到还没喝完的汤；我把水壶递过去，他没有接，只问窗边那盆薄荷是不是又该浇水了。”
可讨论的观察：句子较长、分号转折、具体观察、轻微调侃。这些只是候选，不证明长期习惯。父亲、汤、第一人称和薄荷都不是新书的设定。

《最后一枚纽扣》的约定事实：
第三人称，贴近唐禾。周师傅把配好的深绿纽扣放到她掌心，说今天来不及，明早可以取。唐禾把纽扣贴在外套衣襟缺口上，核对颜色。不新增身世、隐秘关系或他人的内心。

朴素短句版——不是错稿：
“周师傅把深绿纽扣放到唐禾掌心。‘今天来不及了，明早来取。’唐禾把纽扣贴到衣襟缺口上，颜色一致。”

作者为本书选择较长节奏与轻微调侃后的一种写法：
“周师傅把那枚深绿纽扣放到唐禾掌心，说今天已经赶不及，明早可以取；她低头把纽扣贴在衣襟缺口上，颜色倒是对得一丝不差，只可惜纽扣不会自己长回去。”
两版行动和期限相同，改变的是节奏与叙述语气，不是剧情。没有搬来原样本的碗、薄荷、父亲和第一人称。这只是一种编辑选择，不是相似度成绩或稳定复现的保证。

同一种文风，不必每段都长得一样
从这个样本可以提出“观察展开得较慢”“语气略带调侃”等候选，但仅凭它，不能替作者决定“以后每段都用一个长句、一个分号，再让物件做一件做不到的事”。后者是一套段落模具，不是已经确认的作者习惯。若作者有意选择反复的形式，可以明确讨论其作用；不要把自己的提炼冒充作者的选择。

比模仿标点更有用的选择是：让叙述沿着人物真正看见、听见的事展开，需要时给观察多一点空间；调侃有帮助才用，不为补齐特征硬塞。回到纽扣这段，周师傅的话给出修补期限，唐禾的动作落实颜色核对。父亲转碗、叙述者递水壶而父亲没接的动作顺序，不属于这场戏。新段落不需要照着那套顺序换道具，才算沿用了样本的表达选择。

一个只针对当前段落的明确要求：
“这一段保留较长的观察节奏，但不加调侃，也不要沿用分号结构。仍用贴近唐禾的第三人称，事实不变。只给文字提案，不修改本书文风或作者记忆。”

按这个局部要求的一版原创候选——不是接在前两版之后：
“周师傅把配好的深绿纽扣放到唐禾掌心，说今天已经来不及，要到明早才能取。唐禾把纽扣贴在外套衣襟的缺口上，先看那一小块深绿，再看四周的布料，颜色是合的。”

这里把第一个句号放在明早期限之后，先让周师傅的答复落定；后一句跟着唐禾比色，把注意放在纽扣与布料之间。核对颜色被展开成观察，没有搬来样本的第一人称，也没有编出师傅的想法。它保留了较舒展的句子，却不用分号把两半拴在一起，结尾也没有“纽扣不会自己长回去”的调侃。

失去那句轻微调侃，是这次要求的代价，不是删掉后就一定更像作者。若你想保留前版的亲切语气，可以选择前版；若这一处只想安静地落下颜色与期限，就讨论这版是否合适。两版都没有让修补提前完成。判断依据是本段想完成什么，不是命中了几个文风关键词。

本段不调侃，也不撤销先前“本书在有用时可以轻微调侃”的选择。下个任务按它自己的明确要求与仍适用的本书选择来写，不把本段例外传播成全书禁令。这里示范的是按维度、按范围作取舍，没有创建偏好记录；下面的长期记忆请求仍是另一件需要单独表达的事。

向已配置宿主中的 story-long-write 提交：
样本是我有权使用的，只讨论表达，不复制原句或移植情节。仅处理《最后一枚纽扣》的指定段落，保留上述动作、明早期限与贴近唐禾的第三人称。本书可以用较长观察句和轻微调侃，但有用时才用，不必每段都有。
先说明本次各维度的表达决定，再给一版段落建议；不改项目文件，不写作者记忆。分清样本推测和我的明确选择，审稿沿用同一决定，不机械剪短。

确实希望长期沿用时，再单独提出：
“记住：仅《最后一枚纽扣》这本书，允许有用的较长观察句与轻微调侃，不设为全局规则。”
这是示例请求，不是记忆回执；本指南没有替你记录任何偏好。以后若说“这一段写得短促、客观”，本段按新要求写，不暗改本书长期偏好。

en: A short, task-specific account of style choices and their scope, separating explicit requests from tentative sample observations and protected story facts.
One proposed passage that preserves the specified events while making the selected cadence and narrative tone visible; neither alternative has to be universally better.
Only when explicitly requested: a scoped memory change and its actual tool receipt. Ordinary sample discussion or a one-off revision need not create author memory.
zh: 一份简短的本次表达决定，分清明确要求、样本候选观察与不可改的故事事实，并说明范围。
一版保留指定事件、体现所选节奏和语气的段落建议；不宣称某一种写法普遍更好。
只有明确请求长期记忆时，才交付对应范围的记忆变更与真实工具回执；普通样本讨论或一次改稿不必创建作者记忆。

en: Read for function, not matching words: does the voice fit this narrator and scene, without mechanically repeating a stylistic feature? Check that the sample’s names, objects and private history have not migrated into the book.
Check the scope of each decision. A current-passage exception should not replace a long-term habit; a pending inference should not appear as an active instruction or a claimed successful write.

Review clarity, viewpoint and causality as well as preference. Authorial intent does not remove genuine craft problems. For bounded wording edits, see [prose revision](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose); for missing scene movement, see [outline to chapter](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter).
zh: 看表达有没有服务叙述者和场景，不看偏好词命中率，也不机械重复某种句式。检查样本的人名、物件与隐含身世有没有混入本书。
核对每项决定的范围：本段例外不替换长期习惯，pending 推断不冒充 active 指令或成功写入。
同时看清晰度、视角与因果；作者有意选择某种表达，不意味着真实文笔问题消失。局部措辞修改见[改稿指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose)，缺少场景推进见[从章纲到章节](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter)。

title.en: Turn AI manuscript feedback into a revision plan without rewriting the wrong story
title.zh: AI 审稿意见太多怎么改：分清必改、可选与后续影响

answer.en: Do not turn every review comment into a rewrite instruction. First connect the criticism to a passage and an established story constraint, then decide what to fix, what needs clarification and what is merely an alternative taste. A useful revision brief names the problem, approved action, facts to preserve, exact chapter or scene and possible effects on later chapters. Oh Story separates story-review findings from the chapter-revision workflow. The decision sheet below is an editorial aid, not a new required project file or an automatic acceptance feature. For wording alone, use the separate [prose-revision guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose); for which character or reader knows what, see [long-novel continuity](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity). For interchangeable character speech, use the [dialogue example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-dialogue) before treating it as a whole-book style problem. The revised scene below shows how an accepted agency repair becomes dialogue and action without breaking the seal, revealing the culprit or mistaking an agreement to register for a completed registration.
answer.zh: 不要把每条审稿意见直接变成重写指令。先把批评连回具体段落与已经成立的故事约束，再决定哪些要修、哪些要补问、哪些只是另一种审美选择。一份能执行的改稿任务应说明问题、获准的动作、必须保留的事实、精确章节或场景，以及对后文的影响。Oh Story 把 story-review 的发现与章节修订流程分开。下面的决策单是给作者使用的编辑方法，不是新增的必需项目文件，也不是自动采纳功能。只涉及措辞时看[局部润色指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose)；涉及角色或读者知道什么时看[长篇连续性指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity)。 如果问题是人物说话可互换，先看[对白示例](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-dialogue)，不要直接把整本书的文风换掉。 下面进一步把获准的“增强主动性”写成具体对白与动作：不拆封、不提前揭底，也不把同意登记写成已经登记完成。

en: A manuscript you own or are authorized to edit, its chapter plan and the relevant preceding/following passage. Include the book’s viewpoint, intended reader experience and facts or reveal timing that must stay. Missing context should remain an explicit gap, not an invented explanation.

The original review comments and passages they refer to. Oh Story findings include severity, category, location, evidence, issue and a proposed fix. A harsh verdict without enough evidence does not tell you which sentence or story decision should change.

The commands below assume an existing long-form Oh Story project in Claude Code and the correct writing folder. These chapter-revision commands are not the short-story file workflow or hosted-workbench controls. The editorial decision sheet can still help with a short story, but use its own writing workflow. For a long-form manuscript not yet in a tracked project, follow the [import guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue) before a project-level revision that requires existing tracking state.
zh: 你有权编辑的稿件、本章细纲及相关前后文。带上本书视角、希望交付的阅读感受，以及不能改变的事实或揭示时机。材料缺失应明确列为缺口，不用临时编出的解释补齐。
原始审稿意见及对应段落。Oh Story 的 finding 包括严重度、类别、位置、证据、问题和建议修法。只有严厉结论、没有足够依据，仍然不能说明该改哪句话或哪项故事决定。
下方命令示例假定你已在 Claude Code 中打开正确的 Oh Story 长篇项目。章节修订命令不是短篇单文件流程，也不是托管工作台控件。编辑决策单仍可用于短篇，但实际改稿应沿用短篇自己的写作流程。若长篇稿件尚未建立追踪，应先按[导入指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue)建立项目，再进行需要现有追踪状态的工程级修订。

en: Ask what the criticism actually establishes

For each finding, keep the location and evidence alongside the proposed fix. “The protagonist is passive” needs the decision they fail to make and the resulting effect; “too slow” needs the scene function that is delayed or duplicated. If two comments disagree, preserve the disagreement and ask which better serves this book. The review workflow calls for presenting conflicts, not silently averaging them.
Prioritize damage before stylistic preference

The bundled rubric uses S1 for damage to the main story, motivation, world rules or reader trust; S2 for substantial chapter problems; S3 for local issues; and S4 for optional refinements. These are workflow judgments, not universal literary scores. Resolve a supported contradiction before polishing its sentences. An author preference does not make a factual conflict disappear; an unsupported criticism still needs evidence.
Choose an action, not just a verdict

Use four editorial decisions: accept a specific repair; ask for missing evidence; defer a lower-priority change; or reject a proposed solution that violates the story contract. You can accept the diagnosis and reject its suggested fix. Record why. These decisions supplement the report; they do not rename its severity labels or automatically modify project files.
Separate a repair from a new story decision

If prose contradicts an approved fact, choose the authoritative fact and repair the passage. If the desired change would move a reveal, alter a relationship or replace the chapter outcome, it is a change of direction: settle it with the author and revise the affected plan explicitly before drafting. Do not smuggle it in as “stronger tension.” For a flat but correct blueprint, see [outline to chapter](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter). If a short story has no settled central question or ending yet, first clarify its [premise-to-payoff plan](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/short-story-from-idea); local polishing cannot supply that missing decision.
Bound one revision pass

Name the chapter and the scene or paragraph anchors. Specify the accepted items, immutable facts, allowed changes and stopping point. The documented chapter workflow reads adjacent context, backs up the original and distinguishes local edits from whole-chapter rewrites. If the agreed improvement cannot fit that scope, ask for the conflict and a revised plan rather than permissionless expansion.
Keep later consequences visible

The chapter-revision workflow uses a revision transaction to rebuild the affected chapter record and current continuity views. Removing a clue is not safe when a later chapter still uses it; changing who learned something may affect later dialogue. List those passages for the author instead of silently rewriting them too. A review recommendation or a future plot idea is not already-established tracking fact.
Decide whether the repair worked

Read the changed scene against the accepted problem: does the protagonist now make the intended choice, is the evidence still present, and does the following scene still follow? Ask for changes made, suggestions not applied and unresolved downstream effects. A cleaner report is not itself a better chapter; stop when the selected problem is addressed rather than repeatedly rewriting until every taste-based comment vanishes. Distinguish a changed initiator from a completed task: a request or agreement can repair the interaction while the chapter still owes the actual result, such as registering before a deadline.
zh: 先问批评到底证明了什么
把每条发现的位置、证据和建议修法放在一起。“主角被动”要说清他缺少了哪次决定、造成什么影响；“节奏慢”要指出哪个场景功能被拖延或重复。两条意见相反时，保留分歧，再判断哪条更服务于这本书。审稿流程要求呈现冲突，不是静默折中。
先修有依据的损伤，再谈审美偏好
随包尺度用 S1 表示破坏主线、动机、世界规则或读者信任的问题，S2 表示明显影响章节效果的问题，S3 表示局部问题，S4 表示建议性微调。这是工作流内的判断，不是普适文学分数。先解决有依据的矛盾，再打磨其句子。作者偏好不能抹掉事实冲突；没有证据的批评仍需要补证。
选择修复动作，而不只是接受判决
可以作四种编辑决定：采纳一个具体修复；补问缺失依据；暂缓较低优先级的问题；拒绝违背故事约定的修法。可以接受诊断、拒绝它附带的解决方案，并说明理由。这些决定是对审稿报告的补充，不改名严重度标签，也不自动修改项目文件。
分清修错与改变故事方向

如果正文违反已确认事实，就先裁定权威事实，再修相应段落。如果想把揭示提前、改变关系或替换本章结果，那是改方向：先由作者决定，再明确修订受影响规划，之后才写正文。不要借“加强紧张感”偷渡变化。细纲本身正确、正文却平淡时，可参考[从细纲到场景](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter)。 如果短篇连核心问题和结尾都还没定，先理清[从梗到兑现的规划](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/short-story-from-idea)；局部润色不能替作者作出这项缺失的决定。
把一轮修改圈在具体范围内
写清章节、场景或段落锚点，以及本轮采纳项、不变事实、可改动作与停靠点。章节流程会读前后衔接材料、备份原文，并区分局部修改与整章重写。如果目标无法在约定范围内完成，应先报告冲突并调整计划，不擅自扩大改稿范围。
把后文的连锁影响留在明面上
章节修订流程通过一次修订事务重建受影响章记录与当前连续性视图。删掉一个伏笔，但后章还用它，就不能当作已经处理；改变谁知道一件事，也可能影响后文对白。应列出这些段落供作者决定，而不是顺手重写后章。审稿建议和未来构想不等于已经成立的追踪事实。
判断原问题是否真的修好
拿改后场景对照采纳的问题：主角是否作出了所需选择、证据是否仍在、下一场戏是否接得上？要求说明已改内容、未采纳建议与尚未解决的后续影响。报告更干净不等于章节更好；选定问题得到解决后就停，不为了消灭所有审美分歧反复重写。 分开发起者变了与事情办完了：请求、达成一致可以修好这段互动，全章却可能仍欠实际结果，例如期限前完成登记。

example.en:
ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXAMPLE — invented for this guide, not a recorded review or model run.

Chapter 8: The Transfer Slip
Approved facts and outcome constraints: by the end of this scene, Zhou Lan and workshop keeper Yu Heng must both know that the last two digits on a retired machine's exterior plate differ from its transfer slip. She must register the discrepancy before 17:00. She may inspect the exterior only; the machine stays sealed. Both the chapter plan and the already-written chapter 9 depend on that seal remaining intact. The person who changed the record is not identified until chapter 12.
Current weakness: Yu notices the mismatch, explains everything and offers to register it; Zhou merely agrees.

Four comments and an author's decision sheet:
1. “Zhou has no consequential action.” ACCEPT THE DIAGNOSIS. Approved repair: she compares the two visible numbers, asks to register the mismatch and insists when Yu proposes waiting. Yu still sees the same evidence. Keep the discrepancy, deadline and sealed machine.
2. “Cut the transfer-slip exchange; it slows the scene.” REJECT THE DELETION, ACCEPT COMPRESSION. Its evidence supports the later investigation. Remove repeated explanation, not the comparison or registration decision.
3. “Have Zhou break the seal and find the culprit's signature for a stronger ending.” REJECT THIS SOLUTION. It changes the permitted action, chapter 9's premise and chapter 12's reveal. If the author wants that different plot, plan its consequences separately.
4. “Every line should be shorter and sharper.” ASK FOR A SPECIFIC PROBLEM; DEFER THE BLANKET REWRITE. This book uses an unhurried voice. Identify an actual redundant exchange instead of replacing the voice wholesale.

Put the accepted repair on the page — a bounded trial
The passage below is another original editorial example, not a saved chapter or an observed skill result. It supplies wording and small comparison actions for decisions 1 and 2, keeping the facts above. It ends when they agree what to register; it does not invent a submission channel, a receipt or a completion time.

Zhou Lan held the transfer slip beside the machine’s exterior plate, read the last two digits on the plate, then traced the corresponding line on the slip to its last two digits.
“The last two digits don’t match. Look.”
Yu Heng compared the places she indicated. “They don't. Let's wait until we've cleared it up before registering anything.”
“The reason still needs checking, but the discrepancy has to be registered before five.” Zhou kept the slip raised. “I'm raising it now. Write down what's on the plate and what's on the slip separately. Leave the seal alone; we're not making a claim about what's inside.”
“Just the number mismatch?”
“Yes. We can't put down a cause as though we already know it.”
“Then let's record the two numbers first.”
Zhou turned the slip toward him. “Both of them. Don't choose one as correct yet.”

What the repair changes:
- Zhou does not merely acquire a sharper line after Yu has done everything. She compares the evidence, brings it to his attention, asks to register it now and resists waiting for a cause. Yu still sees the same mismatch; she has no new secret expertise or authority.
- The deadline now supports a decision rather than an explanation repeated for the reader. Keeping the two visible sources separate allows a precise request without treating the mismatch as proof of who changed the record, which number is correct or what is inside the machine.
- Yu's wait proposal creates resistance without turning him into an accomplice. Zhou narrows what she is asking for rather than threatening him or opening the seal. Her longer sentence carries the deadline, request and limit; agency does not require making every line combative.

Compress repetition, not the negotiated distinction:
A second speech explaining again that the last two digits differ could go. “Just the number mismatch?” does different work here: it tests the scope of what they will record, and Zhou's answer excludes an unproven cause. Removing that exchange is an editorial option only if the remaining passage still makes the agreed scope clear; don't cut every question merely because the number mismatch has already been mentioned.

Where the trial stops:
Yu has agreed to record the numbers; the excerpt does not show a completed registration. The chapter still owes the before-17:00 requirement. Read the surrounding unchanged passage for its actual completion, or identify the missing beat and choose an additional revision scope. Don't tick the deadline off because someone said “now”. This bounded repair addresses the accepted agency problem; it is not a verdict that all of chapter 8 is finished.

One concrete later-chapter check, without inventing later prose:
A hypothetical factual narration saying “Yu was the first to notice the mismatch” could conflict with this change of initiator. Flag it and read its context; a character's deliberate false claim would be a different case, not an automatic search-and-replace. A later statement that both characters saw the mismatching numbers and the seal stayed intact still fits the approved facts. These are invented check sentences, not quotations from the existing chapter 9. Keep chapter 12's identity reveal where it belongs. A tracking transaction can reflect a saved revision, but cannot silently repair an untouched later sentence.

If you want to try the wording before a file revision, use an explicitly separate chat request:
Using the pasted facts and accepted decisions, draft only the transfer-slip exchange and its comparison actions in this reply. Keep the unhurried voice and both characters' shared evidence. Stop at the agreement about what to register; explain the unresolved deadline obligation. No seal opening, identified culprit, new submission process or claim of completed registration. Do not edit manuscript, outline, tracking or other project files, and do not save this trial as an author preference.
[Paste the actual passage, facts and accepted decisions; replace this exercise's names and circumstances with your own.]
This trial is not the file-revision command below. Apply selected wording to a chapter only with the explicit scope and backup handoff.

Suggested first request for an installed Claude Code workflow:
/story-review solo
Review only chapter 8. Read the named chapter plan and relevant passages from chapters 7 and 9 as supporting context, not additional review batches. Identify evidence-backed problems and distinguish a diagnosis from one possible fix. Show missing evidence and disagreements. Deliver the report in this reply; do not edit manuscript, settings, outline, tracking or other project files. Do not infer persistent author preferences from this one request.
[Supply the real paths, approved facts and original feedback.]

After choosing the repair:
/story-long-write 修改第8章
Only revise the transfer-slip conversation and its local number-comparison actions. Apply decisions 1 and 2 above; do not apply 3 or the blanket rewrite in 4. Preserve the deadline, sealed machine, reveal timing and everything outside this scene. Confirm that scope, back up the original and follow the bundled revision workflow. If a plan conflict prevents the local repair, report it before writing. Report the actual changes and any consequences for chapters 9 onward; do not edit those chapters or start a new one this turn.
example.zh:
原创编辑示例——为本指南虚构，不是审稿记录或模型运行结果。

第 8 章：移交单
已确认事实与结果约束：本场结束时，周岚与车间保管员于衡都应知道，退役机床外部铭牌与移交单的倒数两位编号不符。她必须在 17:00 前登记异议。她只能查看外部，封条不能拆；本章细纲与已经写好的第 9 章都以封条完整为前提。改动记录的人到第 12 章才会被认出。
当前薄弱处：于衡发现差异、解释来龙去脉、主动提出登记，周岚只说同意。

四条意见与作者决策单：
1. “周岚没有带来后果的行动。”采纳诊断。获准修法：由她核对两处可见编号、要求登记差异，并在于衡建议等一等时坚持推进。于衡仍看到同样证据；差异、期限和未拆封机床不变。
2. “删掉移交单对话，这里太慢。”拒绝删除，接受压缩。后续调查需要这项依据；删重复解释，不删编号核对与登记决定。
3. “让周岚拆封，发现篡改者签名，章尾才够强。”拒绝这个修法。它同时改变允许的行动、第 9 章前提和第 12 章揭示。如果作者确实想走另一条剧情，应另行规划连锁影响。
4. “所有对白都改短、改锋利。”先补问具体问题，暂缓一刀切重写。本书保留不疾不徐的语气；请指出真正重复的一轮对白，不要整套替换文风。

把采纳项写进正文——一次有停靠点的试改
下面仍是原创编辑示例，不是已经保存的章节或技能产出。它为第 1、2 项决定补上措辞与核对动作，保留上面的事实。片段停在谈妥登记什么，不新增提交渠道、回执或完成时刻。

周岚把移交单举到机床外部的铭牌旁，先读铭牌编号的最后两位，再沿移交单对应的一行看到末两位。
“最后两位不一样。你看。”
于衡对照她指的两处：“是对不上。再等等，核清了再登记。”
“原因还要核，异议得在五点前登记。”周岚仍举着移交单，“我现在就提，铭牌上和单上的分别写清楚。封条不动，里面的情况不在这里下结论。”
“只登记编号不一致？”
“对，不能把原因也填成我们已经知道了。”
“那就先记两处编号。”
周岚把移交单转向他：“两个都记，别先挑一个当作对的。”

这次修的是什么：
- 不等于让于衡做完所有事，再给周岚加一句狠话。核对证据、让对方看到、现在提出登记、抵抗等原因查清再说，都是她带来的动作；于衡仍看到同样差异，她没有新增秘密知识或职权。
- 期限用来支撑眼前决定，不再只是重复讲给读者听的说明。把两处可见来源分开，要求就能具体，却不把编号不符写成谁改了记录、哪个编号正确或机床内部情况的证明。
- 于衡提出等待，足以形成阻力，不必因此变成同谋。周岚缩小要登记的事项，而不是威胁他或拆封。她较长的一句同时带着期限、请求与边界；主动性不靠句句针锋相对。

压缩重复，不压掉谈妥的区别：
再讲一遍“倒数两位不同”的长解释可以删。“只登记编号不一致？”在这里却是确认登记范围，回答进一步排除了未知原因。若要去掉这一问一答，余下正文仍得交代清楚双方同意记什么；不能因为前面提过编号不符，就把后面的问句一律当成重复。

试改停在哪里：
于衡已经同意记录两处编号，但片段没有写登记完成。全章仍欠着 17:00 前登记这项要求：应去相邻的未改正文里看实际完成过程，或指出缺失的一拍，另定补写范围。不能因为有人说了“现在”，就把期限勾成完成。这段只处理已采纳的主动性问题，不是第 8 章所有问题都已解决的结论。

把后文影响说具体，但不编造后章正文：
假设后文的事实叙述写着“最先发现编号不符的是于衡”，就可能与本次改变的发起者冲突。应先标出并读语境；若那是人物有意说谎，就不能自动查找替换。后文若只是说两人都见过编号差异、封条仍完整，则仍符合既定事实。这些是虚构的检查句，不是已经写好的第 9 章原文；第 12 章的身份揭示仍留在那里。追踪事务能反映已保存修订，不能悄悄修好尚未改过的后文句子。

想先试措辞，再决定是否改文件，可以另发一条明确的聊天请求：
根据粘贴的事实与已采纳决定，只在本次回复里试写移交单对白及其中的核对动作。保留不疾不徐的声音，以及双方看到同样证据的边界。停在谈妥登记什么，说明尚未完成的期限要求。不拆封、不点明篡改者、不新增提交手续，不声称登记已经完成。不修改正文、大纲、追踪或其他项目文件，也不把本次试写保存为作者偏好。
[粘贴实际原文、事实与已采纳决定；换成自己的名字和情境，不套用本练习。]
这次试写不等于下面的文件修订命令。只有明确范围并完成备份交接后，才把选定写法用于章节。

在已安装的 Claude Code 工作流里，可先这样请求：
/story-review solo
只审第 8 章。读取我点名的本章细纲与第 7、9 章相关段落作为衔接依据，不将它们另立审查批次。列出有原文证据的问题，分开诊断与一种可能的修法，呈现证据缺失与意见分歧。报告在本次回复里交付，不修改正文、设定、大纲、追踪或其他项目文件。不要从这次一次性要求推断长期作者偏好。
[填写真实路径、已确认事实与原始意见。]

选定修法后：
/story-long-write 修改第8章
只改移交单对话及其中核对编号的动作。执行上面第 1、2 项决定，不执行第 3 项和第 4 项的一刀切重写。保留期限、未拆封机床、揭示时机及本场以外所有内容。确认范围、备份原稿，再按随包修订流程处理；若细纲冲突使局部修复无法完成，先报告再写。说明实际修改及对第 9 章以后的影响，本轮不改后章、不新写章节。

en: A review report with located evidence, severity, actual review mode, missing context and disagreements. The author’s decision sheet identifies accepted fixes and protected facts; the example does not claim the tool creates that sheet automatically.

After an explicit revision, the selected chapter changes within the agreed scope, with an original-copy backup and a report of later impacts. The documented workflow updates tracking through its transaction; a chat claim alone is not evidence that the manuscript or state was saved.

Review modes have different write boundaries. Solo does not modify story tracking; batch review can save unresolved findings in .story-review/state.md. Full/lean may maintain tracking through the prescribed transaction when existing prose proves a recorded fact is wrong or missing. This is why the example requests a single-chapter solo report and explicitly excludes file edits, rather than calling all review read-only.

A chat-only trial, if that is what you requested, remains a proposal in the reply. State its stopping point and unresolved obligations; it neither saves a chapter nor completes the corresponding tracking transaction.
zh: 一份带位置、证据、严重度、实际审查模式、缺失材料与分歧的报告。作者决策单另列采纳修法与受保护事实；示例不声称工具会自动生成这张单。
明确请求修订后，目标章按约定范围修改，保留原稿备份，并报告后续影响。文档流程经事务更新追踪；聊天里说完成，不足以证明正文或状态已保存。
审稿模式的写入边界不同。solo 不修改故事追踪；分批审稿可以把未解决发现保存在 .story-review/state.md。full/lean 在现有正文证明追踪事实错误或缺失时，可经规定事务维护追踪。因此示例选择单章 solo、明确不改文件，而不是把所有审稿称作只读。
明确只要聊天试稿时，得到的仍是回复中的方案。说明停靠点和尚未履行的要求，不把它当成已保存章节或已完成的追踪事务。

en: Check the accepted decisions against the actual changed passage, including material that must remain. Do not count an unrequested plot change as a fix simply because the scene sounds more dramatic.

Read each specifically affected later passage. If its premise no longer holds, leave the conflict visible and decide the next revision scope; a consistent tracking view does not repair unchanged prose by itself.
Keep review severity separate from sales, platform acceptance or publishability. Neither a positive verdict nor local structural checks establish those outcomes.
zh: 把采纳决定与实际改后段落对照，同时检查应保留的内容。场面更激烈，不代表未经要求的剧情改变就算修复。
读被点名影响的后续段落。若其前提不再成立，应明确保留冲突并决定下一轮范围；追踪视图一致不会自行修好尚未修改的正文。
把审稿严重度与销量、平台接纳或可发表性分开。通过式结论与本地结构检查都不能证明这些结果。

title.en: From one premise to a complete short story: promise, pressure, choice and payoff
title.zh: 只有一个梗，怎样写成完整短篇：开篇承诺、递进与结尾兑现

answer.en: A premise gives a short story a starting pressure, not a complete plot. Decide what the reader should want answered, what prevents an easy answer, what the protagonist must choose and what observable change will settle that question. Then build only the scenes needed to earn that ending. A twist is one option, not a requirement. Oh Story’s short-writing workflow separates design from drafting and uses a lightweight section plan rather than a long-novel chapter blueprint. The four-part framing here is an editorial aid, not a new mandatory schema. The original repair-shop example closes a relationship decision without pretending that one conversation solves a family’s entire history. The opening, negotiation and ending excerpts below show that choice on the page: a failed hint becomes stated terms, a deposit and a departure, not proof that the repair is finished or every family hurt is healed.
answer.zh: 一个梗给了短篇起始压力，却还不是完整情节。先决定读者想得到什么回答、什么阻力让答案不能轻易出现、主角必须作什么选择，以及哪种可见变化能兑现这个问题，再留下通向结尾所必需的场景。反转是一种办法，不是每篇必需。Oh Story 的短篇流程把设计与正文分开，使用轻量小节大纲，而不是长篇的完整章节蓝图。这里的四步框架是编辑建议，不是新增强制字段。原创修补店示例会收束一次关系中的选择，但不假装一场谈话就能解决一家人的全部历史。 下方的开头、协商与结尾节选把这项选择写出来：暗示没有奏效，随后条件被说清、定金付下、人离开；这不等于衣服已经修好，也不等于一家人的旧伤全好了。

en: A premise and material you own or are authorized to use. State the intended emotional experience, viewpoint, length range and what the story must not do. “Relief mixed with lingering discomfort after setting a boundary” is more useful than “make it moving.”

Separate approved facts from open design choices. A new character, hidden motive or unusual rule is a choice to approve, not evidence recovered from a one-sentence idea. If this continues an existing story, bring its relevant facts instead of treating it as an empty project.

For the example command, install Oh Story in a supported agent host and open the intended writing folder. The example uses Claude Code slash syntax. It is not a hosted ZenStory feature or a DSH installation instruction; see [agent skills for writers](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers) if you need that distinction.
zh: 一个梗，以及你有权使用的材料。写清希望交付的情绪、视角、篇幅范围和不能发生的事。“说清边界后松了一口气，却仍有一点不自在”比“写得感人”更能指导取舍。
分开已确认事实与尚待选择的设计。新人物、隐藏动机或特殊规则是需要决定的内容，不是从一句梗概中还原出的证据。如果接续已有故事，应带上相关事实，而不是按空白项目另起炉灶。
使用示例命令时，需要在受支持的 Agent 宿主中安装 Oh Story，并打开目标写作目录。示例采用 Claude Code slash 语法，不是 ZenStory 托管版功能或 DSH 安装步骤；不清楚这些层次时可先看[写作者的 Agent Skills 指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)。

en: Turn the premise into a question the ending can answer

Name the protagonist’s immediate want and why getting it matters now. In the example, the issue is not whether a sleeve can be repaired, but whether Xu He can refuse another unspoken promise of free, urgent labor before leaving town. This gives the ending a specific job. A premise that opens five unrelated mysteries will require a different scope.
Choose one central pressure and its limit

Keep the cast, place and time window small enough for the intended story. Ask what gets harder when the protagonist tries their usual response. Pressure can come from competing obligations or a strained relationship, not only a villain, catastrophe or new secret. The bundled method emphasizes a single core fulcrum; the particular limits in the example are author choices.
Make each section change the situation

For each proposed section, ask: what causes the action, what does someone actually do, and what result changes the next choice? A repeated request is not escalation unless it exposes a different cost or closes an option. The workflow’s section plan records concrete actions and causal links; it does not require a minimum number of plot points per section or extra obstacles just to fill space. When the scene turns on a conversation, the [character-dialogue guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-dialogue) shows how different requests, protected concerns and concessions create that change.
Test the ending before expanding the middle

Describe what the reader will be able to observe at the end. A decision, paid cost, changed relationship or fulfilled consequence can provide closure. If you use a twist, plant the basis for the mistaken interpretation and leave room for action after the reveal; do not end with an explanation that does all the work. Without a twist, make the promised change substantial enough to carry the ending.
Cut branches that belong to another story

An elaborate childhood account, a second romantic plot or a secret behind every prop may each be interesting but compete with the chosen question. Keep an element when it changes an action, a cost or the reader’s interpretation of the ending. If the essential chain will not fit the requested length, propose a tradeoff; do not quietly inflate a short story into the opening of a serial.
Agree on the design, then draft

The design stage produces 设定.md and 小节大纲.md; 正文.md belongs to drafting. A request for conception only can stop before prose. State the intended viewpoint, length range and section count instead of accepting defaults accidentally. The documented 8,000–20,000 range is a Chinese web-fiction workflow default, not a definition of all short stories; first person is also a default that an explicit viewpoint can override.
Read the opening and ending together

Check whether the ending answers the question the opening made important, and whether the middle earned that answer. Do not confuse an unresolved life with an unresolved central story: the jacket may still need sewing, but the agreed deadline, price and right to refuse are no longer unspoken. If feedback proposes a different story, use the [review-to-revision decision guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/review-and-revise) before rewriting everything.
zh: 把梗改成结尾能够回答的问题
明确主角眼下想要什么、为什么偏偏现在重要。示例的问题不是袖口能不能补，而是许禾能否在离开前，拒绝又一次没有说出口的免费加急承诺。结尾因此有了具体任务。若梗概同时打开五个互不相关的谜，就需要另定篇幅与范围。
只选一个核心压力，并限定它的范围
让人物、地点和时间窗口适合这篇的体量。问主角沿用惯常办法后，什么会变得更难。压力可以来自互相竞争的责任或紧张关系，不必总靠反派、灾难或新秘密。随包方法强调单一核心支点；示例中具体的人数与时限是作者选择。
让每一节改变处境

对每个小节追问：什么导致行动、谁实际做了什么、结果怎样改变下一步选择？请求重复一次，并不自动构成升级，除非暴露新的代价或关掉一个选项。流程的小节大纲记录具体行动与因果，不要求每节最低几个情节点，也不支持为凑长度硬加阻碍。 如果场景主要靠谈话推进，[人物对白指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-dialogue)展示不同请求、想保护的东西与让步如何带来变化。
先试结尾，再扩写中段
先说结尾能让读者看到什么。一次决定、付出的代价、改变的关系或得到兑现的后果，都可能形成收束。若使用反转，应为误判提供依据，并在揭示后留出行动空间，不把全部工作丢给一段解释。不用反转时，也要让承诺的变化足够实在，撑得起结尾。
删掉属于另一篇故事的支线
详细童年史、第二条恋爱线、每件道具背后的秘密都可能有趣，却也会争夺同一个核心问题的篇幅。保留能改变行动、代价或结尾理解的内容。如果必需因果链放不进指定长度，先给取舍建议，不悄悄把短篇扩成连载开头。
先确认设计，再生成正文
设计阶段产出 设定.md 与 小节大纲.md；正文.md 属于后续写作。明确只做构思时，可以停在正文前。把视角、篇幅范围与节数写出来，不无意中接受默认值。文档的 8000–20000 字是中文网文工作流默认范围，不是所有短篇的定义；第一人称也只是可被明确视角要求覆盖的默认。
把开头和结尾放在一起读
看结尾是否回答了开头强调的问题，中段是否让这个答案来得有依据。人物的一生尚未解决，不等于核心故事没有收束：衣服可以还没补完，但交付时间、价格和拒绝权已不再含糊。如果审稿意见实际上要求换一篇故事，先按[审稿到改稿决策指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/review-and-revise)作取舍，再决定怎么改。

example.en:
ORIGINAL PLANNING EXAMPLE — written for this guide, not an observed skill run or a complete manuscript.

Working title: The Last Repair Ticket
Premise: On the day she closes her repair shop and moves away, Xu He must quote her mother a real price and deadline instead of accepting another free rush job.
Reader promise: relief mixed with lingering discomfort when a familiar obligation becomes a choice both people can see.
Approved facts: the moving van arrives at 17:00; the sewing machine is already packed; her mother's work jacket needs a cuff alteration. The machine is moving with her, and she can finish this one repair at her new home in time to dispatch it on Wednesday. Xu He has previously repaired family clothes without charging but never clearly distinguished a gift from an obligation. Her mother is alive, is not hiding a dramatic secret, and is allowed to decline the offer. Do not make either woman a caricature.
Central question: can Xu He turn an assumed free rush job into a paid repair with a deadline she can keep, then leave?

Six-section plan — actions and changed conditions, not a universal six-beat formula:
1. Her mother lays the jacket over the price list and asks for “just two stitches before you go.” Xu He now has to answer a request she usually accepts without discussion.
2. Xu He says she is leaving soon. Her mother puts down the lunch she brought and waits, hearing a delay rather than a refusal. Hinting has not changed the assumed agreement.
3. Xu He notices an old family repair ticket with the price left blank. She recognizes that she has helped keep the terms invisible; a list of past grievances would not fix today's agreement.
4. She writes a price and a Wednesday dispatch date on a new ticket. She will take the jacket only on those terms, not finish it before the van arrives. Her mother may take it elsewhere. The cost is the uncomfortable possibility of refusal, not a manufactured emergency.
5. Her mother asks whether she really needs a ticket too. Xu He keeps the offer and the right to refuse intact. After a pause, her mother pays the agreed deposit. Neither makes a speech claiming that all past hurt is healed.
6. Her mother puts the receipt in her wallet and asks, “Wednesday?” Xu He confirms and carries the packed machine to the van. She does not add a promise to finish that night. The repair is still pending; the central agreement is settled.

What we leave out: a terminal-illness reveal, a hostile neighbor, a surprise inheritance and a second romance. None is needed to make this decision costly or visible.

From the plan to prose: three separate editorial excerpts
These are original first-person samples from Xu He's viewpoint, not consecutive full sections, a complete story or a skill output. They illustrate selected moments from sections 1–2, 3–5 and 6. The intervening development still needs writing; joining these samples does not fulfill the six-section, 3,500–5,000-character Chinese draft request.

Opening sample — the hint does not settle the terms:
Mother laid her work jacket over the price list. “Just two stitches before you go.”
“The moving van comes at five,” I said. “The machine's already packed.”
She set down the lunch she had brought and pulled up a chair. “Have something to eat first. Then do it.”
The price list was still under the jacket. I did not reach for the jacket.

Negotiation sample — a visible offer, then an actual choice:
The price space on the old family repair ticket was still empty. I turned to a new ticket, filled in the price, then wrote “Dispatch Wednesday” and set it beside the jacket.
“I need a ticket too?” Mother asked.
“I'll do this one after I move. I'll send it on Wednesday.” I pointed to the price. “If you don't want it on those terms, you can take it somewhere else.”
Mother said nothing. I left the price on the ticket; the jacket stayed on the table. After a while she paid the agreed deposit.

Ending sample — keep the agreement when leaving:
Mother put the receipt into her wallet. Before closing it, she asked, “Wednesday?”
“I’ll send it Wednesday.”
She closed the wallet. I took the work jacket and the packed machine with me and got into the van.

What earns the quiet ending:
- In the opening, “I'm leaving” meets “eat first, then do it”: the old assumption survives the hint. The clothes cover the price list, but an uncovered price list alone would not make a mutual agreement. Xu He must say what she is offering.
- The blank price on the old ticket matters between opening and negotiation. It connects today's discomfort to terms Xu He has also left unstated, rather than supplying a new secret or assigning her mother a hidden motive. Don't skip that bridge and expect a receipt to carry the whole emotional change.
- The negotiation keeps price, Wednesday dispatch and refusal available at the same time. The mother's silence is not consent; payment is the approved acceptance here. It does not establish why she accepts, that she is pleased or that the relationship has been permanently repaired.
- The ending repeats the date with a changed function: it is now the agreed commitment, not another hint to be interpreted. Wednesday is dispatch, not a guaranteed arrival day. The clothes and machine leave with Xu He; the alteration remains work she will do after unpacking at her new home.

A warmer-sounding line can undo this chosen ending:
Adding “Never mind, I'll do it free tonight” would restore the very rush-and-price assumption this plan chose to change. That does not make gifts to family wrong, or charging the only valid ending. It means a different choice needs a different approved payoff, not a sweet extra line smuggled into this one. Likewise, if the author chooses refusal instead of the approved deposit, plan that consequence rather than keeping the payment as though both outcomes happened.

These are selected prose examples, not the complete middle:
The final draft still has to connect the old ticket, the explicit offer, the possibility of refusal and acceptance at this book's chosen pace. Do not pad each section to an equal size or add a crisis to make the mother pay. Retain the six approved section responsibilities; if the plan itself needs fewer sections, change it before drafting rather than silently collapsing it. A quiet ending is earned by the preceding choices, not by making every earlier scene quiet.

Suggested request in an installed Claude Code workflow:
/story-short-write
Plan this original family slice-of-life short story in first person, from Xu He's viewpoint. Intended Chinese prose length: 3,500–5,000 characters, across six sections. Those numbers are choices for this project, not genre rules. Use the approved facts, central question and ending above; mark any further invention as a proposed choice. Preserve an unhurried voice, uneasy warmth and the mother's right to refuse. Do not add a hidden illness, a villain or a final shock twist.
This turn is conception only. In [the selected story directory], create only 设定.md and 小节大纲.md following the bundled design format. Do not create 正文.md or edit another story. Identify any scope or causal gap instead of padding the outline. Stop after the design and list the files created.

After deciding any open choices and reading the design, explicitly request drafting from the approved plan. Design files alone are not a finished short story.

Once those two design files are approved, make the full-draft handoff explicit:
/story-short-write
The design in [the approved story directory] is approved. Draft the complete Chinese story into 正文.md, in Xu He's first person, keeping the agreed 3,500–5,000-character range and all six planned sections. Follow the workflow's section batches; do not return only opening/ending excerpts or treat them as the whole manuscript. Keep the price offer, the right to refuse, the agreed deposit, Wednesday dispatch and departure with the packed machine. The repair itself remains unfinished at the ending. Preserve the unhurried voice and uneasy warmth without adding an illness, villain or shock reveal. Do not silently change the approved design to meet length. If the constraints conflict, report the specific conflict before changing them. If 正文.md already exists, report that before overwriting it. Stop after the requested story and report the written file and any unresolved gaps; do not start another story.
[Replace the directory, facts, voice and length with your own approved design.]

The samples on this page are editorial illustrations, not a new preview mode. The documented writing phase delivers a file and all planned sections; a partial excerpt or a chat claim of completion does not satisfy that contract.
example.zh:
原创规划示例——为本指南撰写，不是技能运行记录，也不是完整正文。

暂定篇名：最后一张修补单
核心梗：修补店闭店搬走当天，许禾必须向母亲说出真实价格与交付时间，而不是再次答应免费加急。
读者承诺：熟悉的义务变成双方看得见的选择后，松了一口气，却仍有一点不自在。
已确认事实：搬家车 17:00 到；缝纫机已经打包；母亲的工服需要改袖口。机子会随她搬走，她能在新住处拆箱后完成这一单，赶上约定的周三寄出。许禾过去给家人修衣不收费，却从没说清那是赠送还是义务。母亲在世，没有隐藏的重大秘密，也有权拒绝这次报价。不要把任何一人写成脸谱。
核心问题：许禾能否把默认的免费加急改成一份有价格、能按承诺交付的修补约定，然后离开？

六节规划——动作与处境变化，不是通用六节公式：
1. 母亲把工服压在价目表上，说“你走前，就缝两针”。许禾必须回应一个过去总会直接接受的请求。
2. 许禾说自己马上要走。母亲放下带来的午饭，坐着等，把这句话听成推迟而不是拒绝。暗示没能改变默认约定。
3. 许禾看到一张没写价格的旧家人修补单，意识到自己也一直让条件隐形。罗列旧委屈解决不了今天的约定。
4. 她在新单上写下价格与周三寄出时间。只有按这些条件才接，不在搬家车来前做完；母亲可以拿去别处修。代价是对方可能拒绝时的难堪，不是临时制造一场大事故。
5. 母亲问“给我也要写单？”许禾保留报价，也保留她不修的选择。沉默后，母亲支付约定定金。没有人发表一段“一切旧伤都已治愈”的宣言。
6. 母亲把回执收进钱包，问“周三？”许禾确认后，抱着打包好的机子上车，没有补一句今晚就能修好。修补还没完成，但核心约定已经落定。

本篇不加入：绝症揭露、恶邻、意外遗产或第二条恋爱线。没有这些支线，这次决定仍然有代价，也有可见变化。

从规划到正文：三处互相分开的编辑节选
以下是以许禾第一人称写的原创示范，不是连续的完整小节、整篇短篇或技能产出。它们分别取第 1–2 节、第 3–5 节和第 6 节的部分时刻；中间仍需展开，拼在一起不等于交付了六节、3500–5000 字的中文正文。

开头节选——暗示没有说定条件：
母亲把工服压在价目表上：“你走前，就缝两针。”
“搬家车五点来。”我说，“机子已经打包了。”
她放下带来的午饭，拉过椅子坐好：“先吃点，吃完再弄。”
价目表还压在衣服下面，我没有伸手去拿工服。

协商节选——看得见的报价，以及真正作出的选择：
旧的家人修补单上，价格那一栏还空着。我翻到一张新单，先填价格，再写“周三寄出”，把单子放在工服旁边。
“给我也要写单？”母亲问。
“这单我搬过去再做，周三寄。”我把价钱指给她看，“你要是不愿意，也可以拿去别处修。”
母亲没有说话。我没去划掉单上的价钱，工服还在桌上。过了一会儿，她付了约定的定金。

结尾节选——离开时仍照已经谈妥的条件：
母亲把回执收进钱包，合上前问：“周三？”
“周三寄出。”
她合上钱包。我带上工服和打包好的机子，上了车。

安静的结尾靠什么成立：
- 开头的“我要走”接上“先吃，再弄”，旧的默认仍在，暗示没有解除它。工服压着价目表，但只把表露出来也不等于双方达成约定，许禾得把自己愿意接下的条件说出来。
- 旧单上的空白价格，是开头到协商之间的重要一环：今天的不自在，也连着许禾一直没有说清的条件，不靠新秘密解释，更不替母亲判定一个隐藏动机。不能跳过这层变化，只让结尾的回执包办全部情绪。
- 协商让价格、周三寄出与不修的选择同时成立。母亲的沉默不是同意；在获准版本里，支付定金才落实接受。这仍不证明她为什么接受、是否高兴，更不证明关系已经永久修复。
- 结尾再次确认日期，功能已经变了：它是谈妥的承诺，不是又一句等待猜测的暗示。周三是寄出，不是保证送达。工服与机子随许禾离开，改袖口仍是到新住处拆箱后要做的事。

一句更温情的话，也可能撤销这个结尾：
若再加“算了，今晚免费给你弄好”，就恢复了这份规划本来要改变的免费加急默认。这不等于送家人礼物有错，也不等于收费才是唯一好结局；只是另一种选择需要另定兑现，不能靠一句甜话偷偷替换本篇结尾。同样，若作者改选母亲拒绝而不是支付定金，也要规划相应后果，不能仍保留付款，仿佛两种结果同时发生。

节选不是已经写完的中段：
完整稿仍须按本篇节奏接起旧单、说清条件、可能被拒绝与实际接受。不要把每节补成同样长，也不用事故逼母亲付款。保留六节获准职责；若规划本身需要减节，应先改规划，不在写正文时悄悄合并。结尾安静，要靠前面的选择挣出来，不要求前面每场都安静。

在已安装的 Claude Code 工作流中，可以这样请求：
/story-short-write
规划这篇原创亲情日常短篇，采用许禾第一人称。中文正文目标 3500–5000 字，共六节；这些数字是本篇选择，不是题材规则。采用上面的已确认事实、核心问题和结尾；进一步新增的内容标为待选设计。保留不疾不徐的语气、带着不自在的温情，以及母亲拒绝报价的权利。不添加隐藏疾病、反派或终局震惊反转。
本轮只做构思。在 [选定的短篇目录] 中，按随包设计格式只创建 设定.md 与 小节大纲.md；不创建 正文.md，不改其他故事。范围或因果有缺口就指出，不靠填充情节凑大纲。设计完成后停止，列出创建的文件。

决定开放选项并读完设计后，再明确请求按确认的蓝图写正文。只有设计文件，还不算完成一篇短篇。

两份设计文件确认后，再明确交接完整正文：
/story-short-write
[已确认短篇目录] 中的设计已经批准。以许禾第一人称，把完整中文短篇写入 正文.md，保留已定的 3500–5000 字范围和六个规划小节。按流程分批写作，不只返回头尾节选，也不把节选当成全文。保留报价、拒绝权、约定定金、周三寄出与带着打包机子离开；结尾时修补本身仍未完成。保留不疾不徐的声音与带着不自在的温情，不加疾病、反派或震惊揭示。不为凑篇幅悄悄改变已确认设计；约束冲突时，先指出具体冲突再调整。如果 正文.md 已存在，覆盖前先报告。写完本篇即停，说明写入文件与尚未解决的缺口，不另开下一篇。
[换成自己的目录、事实、声音和已定篇幅。]

本页节选是编辑示范，不是新增预览模式。文档中的正文阶段要交付文件并覆盖全部规划小节，只有片段或在聊天里说完成，都不满足这项交付。

en: After a conception-only pass: 设定.md and 小节大纲.md with an agreed central pressure, planned changes and ending. The bundled outline has its own fields; the six summaries above illustrate creative decisions rather than replacing that format.

After a separately requested drafting pass: story prose in 正文.md, following the approved sections and delivery parameters. The guide does not claim a manuscript was generated or that a chosen length guarantees pacing. The opening/negotiation/ending samples on this page are not that complete file; the written draft must still cover the intervening approved development.

An explicit list of unresolved design choices or necessary tradeoffs. A quieter ending is not automatically weak, and a twist is not automatically earned; both depend on what this story promised and showed.
zh: 只做构思后：设定.md 与 小节大纲.md，其中有确认的核心压力、计划中的变化与结尾。随包小节大纲有自己的字段；上面的六条摘要示范创作决定，不替换该格式。
另行明确请求写作后：正文保存在 正文.md，遵循已确认节数与交付参数。本指南不声称已经生成稿件，也不声称选对字数就能保证节奏。 本页开头、协商与结尾的节选不等于这份完整文件；实际稿件仍须覆盖其间获准的展开。
尚未决定的设计或必须作出的取舍清单。安静的结尾不自动等于薄弱，有反转也不自动等于有依据；都要回到本篇承诺了什么、实际展示了什么。

en: Can you state the opening question and point to the final action that answers it? If the ending only introduces the next mystery, decide whether you are actually planning a serial opening.

Does each middle section change information, an available choice, a relationship or a cost? Remove repetitions that change none of these, but do not reduce necessary emotional development to a plot checklist.

Keep approved viewpoint, length and scope separate from the tool’s defaults. A completed design or clean structural check is not proof of literary quality, acceptance by a platform or commercial success.
zh: 能否说清开头的问题，并指出结尾回答它的具体行动？如果收尾只抛出下一个谜，要重新决定自己是否其实在规划连载开头。
每个中段小节是否改变了信息、可选行动、关系或代价？没有变化的重复可以删，但不要把必要的情绪发展压成纯情节点清单。
把确认的视角、篇幅与范围和工具默认值分开。设计完成或结构检查通过，不证明文学质量、平台接纳或商业结果。

title.en: Write distinct character dialogue through goals, knowledge and relationships
title.zh: 人物对白总是千人一面？先分目标、信息与关系，再改说话方式

answer.en: Distinct dialogue starts with what each speaker is trying to do to the conversation: obtain permission, protect something, avoid an admission, test a claim or offer a concession. Give each character a different selection of relevant information and a relationship to the listener, then choose wording and rhythm that fit this moment. Catchphrases alone do not provide that structure. Oh Story’s dialogue references connect voice to agenda, relationship, setting and purpose; they are not a rule that one character must always speak briefly or another must always explain. The original rehearsal example below preserves the same decision while separating three voices and keeping a private fact out of characters’ mouths. A second version lets a direct answer resolve a misunderstanding while leaving a private fact undisclosed; it compares that extra friction with the earlier, quicker exchange.
answer.zh: 有区分度的对白，先来自各人正在对这场谈话做什么：争取许可、保护某样东西、回避承认、试探依据，或作出让步。再分清各人掌握的信息及与听者的关系，最后才选适合当下的措辞与节奏。只添口头禅，补不出这层结构。Oh Story 的对白参考把声音与议程、关系、场合、目的联系起来，不意味着某个人必须永远短句、另一个必须永远解释。下面的原创排练室示例保留同一个决定，同时分开三人的声音，不把私人事实塞进其他角色嘴里。 另一个版本让直接回答纠正误解，同时仍不公开离开的私事，并比较这点关系摩擦与前版更快推进的取舍。

en: A scene you own or are authorized to revise, its participants, viewpoint and intended outcome. Identify exactly what may change: dialogue only, speaker tags, or specified transitions as well. A stronger exchange is not permission to change the plot.

For each participant, note the immediate request, what they want to protect, what they know and what the listener knows. Separate private author knowledge from information established for this viewpoint; consult the [continuity guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity) for longer projects.

Bring any established character speech patterns and this book’s overall prose style. Character voice is not the same thing as the author’s narration: see [preserving author voice](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/preserve-author-voice). The command example assumes an existing Oh Story writing project in Claude Code, not the hosted workbench or a newly imported manuscript.
zh: 你有权修改的场景、在场人物、视角与既定结果。说清能改什么：只改台词、能改说话人标记，还是也允许修改点名的衔接段。对话更有张力，不等于获准改变情节。
为每位在场者记下眼前请求、想保护的东西、本人所知与听者所知。把作者私下的事实与当前视角已经成立的信息分开；长篇可参考[连续性指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity)。
带上已经形成的人物说话习惯与本书整体文风。人物声音不等于作者旁白声音，可对照[保留作者文风](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/preserve-author-voice)。命令示例假定你已在 Claude Code 中打开 Oh Story 写作项目，不是托管工作台，也不是刚给出一份散稿就自动完成导入。

en: Give speakers different conversational jobs

Replace a label such as “cold personality” with an action: refuse the new demand without explaining a private reason, or make the other person choose between two feasible options. People can want the same broad outcome yet disagree over what must survive it. The singer wants a better opening; the drummer wants one shared moment preserved; the recorder needs a decision within the remaining time. If you cannot yet say why either person wants the outcome, start with [character motivation](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-motivation); phrasing alone cannot supply an absent reason to act.
Make information enter for a reason

A character should reveal a fact because it helps, obstructs or changes the current exchange, not because the reader needs a briefing. In the example, only A Ke initially knows the remaining studio time; the others cannot cite six minutes before she says it. Qiu Ran’s departure is private author knowledge and cannot become the singer’s explanation for his request.
Differentiate what speakers attend to before adding verbal habits

Choose a few useful differences: concrete detail versus summary, questions versus proposals, direct naming versus evasion, formal address versus familiarity, or what a speaker notices first. Do not derive a whole voice from age, occupation or a repeated catchphrase. The bundled reference offers several voice dimensions; treat them as choices, not a checklist to maximize in every line.
Let a reply respond to the previous move

A line can accept, resist, narrow, redirect or test the preceding request. Subtext does not require obscure language: the drummer asks whether the laugh must be rerecorded rather than announcing all of his private feelings. If dialogue becomes an explanation of feelings everyone already understands, remove the duplicate commentary. Add an action only when it contributes information or changes what can happen. The alternative below makes “No” a useful correction rather than a failure of subtext. A misunderstanding is a chosen beat, not a required obstacle in every conversation.
Allow the same person to sound different with different listeners

A request to the person managing the session may be practical; a concession to a bandmate may focus on the moment they value. Stress and relationship changes can alter rhythm without erasing character. The handbook’s power-contest patterns are specific techniques, not proof that short lines always belong to the powerful or that long lines always signal weakness.
Revise within the approved scene outcome

Keep the existing decision and reveal boundary visible while testing the new exchange. Ask what each line does and whether the next reply still follows. A name-swapping exercise can expose interchangeable lines, but it is a heuristic, not a requirement that every sentence identify its speaker in isolation. If fixing the scene needs a different decision, separate that proposal using the [revision-decision guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/review-and-revise). If you are still designing a short story rather than repairing an established scene, settle the [central question and payoff](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/short-story-from-idea) first; sharper lines cannot choose its ending for you.
zh: 给每个人不同的对话任务

把“性格冷淡”换成动作：不解释私人理由但拒绝新增要求，或让对方在两个可行选项中作决定。人们可以想要同一个大结果，却在必须保留什么上冲突。示例里，歌手要更好的开头，鼓手要留住一个共同瞬间，录音者需要在剩余时间内作出决定。 如果还说不清人物为什么要这个结果，先看[人物动机指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-motivation)；措辞本身补不出行动理由。
让信息有理由地进入对话
人物说出事实，应因为它帮助、阻碍或改变眼前谈话，而不是读者需要听一段介绍。示例起初只有阿珂知道录音时间还剩多久；其他人在她说出之前不能引用“六分钟”。邱冉离开的计划是作者私下的事实，不能变成歌手解释其请求的理由。
先分注意什么，再添说话习惯
挑少量有用差异：具体细节还是概括，问句还是提案，直呼还是回避，客气称呼还是熟悉语气，最先注意哪件事。不要由年龄、职业或一个反复出现的口头禅包办整个人物声音。随包参考提供多个声音维度，它们是可选工具，不是每句都要最大化命中的清单。
让回答回应上一句的动作
一句话可以接受、抵抗、缩小、转移或试探刚才的请求。潜台词不等于故意晦涩：鼓手问那次笑声是否也要重录，而不是把自己的全部私情宣告出来。对白若已经让人听懂，就不要再重复解释相同情绪；只有能提供信息或改变局面的动作才值得补入。 下方备选让“不是”成为有用的纠正，而不是潜台词失败的标志。误解是一种可选节拍，不是每场谈话必须添加的障碍。
允许同一人对不同对象说得不同
面对管理录音的人，请求可以更具体；面对队友，让步可以落在对方珍惜的瞬间。压力与关系变化会改变节奏，不等于人设消失。手册里的权力交锋模式是特定技法，不证明短句永远属于强者、长句永远代表弱者。
在批准的场景结果内试改

始终保留既定决定与揭示边界，再看新对白每句做了什么、下一句是否接得上。交换姓名的练习可以暴露可互换台词，但只是启发，不要求每个孤立句子都能识别是谁说的。如果修好场景需要换一个决定，应按[改稿决策指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/review-and-revise)单独提出，不借对白修订偷渡。 如果你仍在设计短篇，而不是修一场已定的戏，先确定[核心问题与结尾兑现](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/short-story-from-idea)；更锋利的台词不能替你选定结尾。

example.en:
ORIGINAL DIALOGUE EXAMPLE — an editorial alternative, not recorded model output.

Scene: the band is deciding whether to record one more take. Keep the viewpoint close to singer Qi Ran; do not narrate another person's private thoughts.
Approved facts: Qi thinks she rushed the first line and asks for a full retake. The existing take contains a spontaneous laugh that both she and drummer Qiu Ran heard. Initially, only recorder A Ke knows six minutes remain. Qiu will soon leave the city, but neither of the others knows that, and he does not announce it here.
Approved outcome: preserve the existing recording and record only another opening, keeping the laugh. This scene decides what to record; it does not claim a finished audio edit.

Interchangeable version:
Qi Ran: “I would like to record the whole song again because I think the opening could be better.”
Qiu Ran: “I would like to keep this take because I think the laugh later on is good.”
A Ke: “I would like us to decide within six minutes because we cannot extend the session.”
Qi Ran: “I agree to record only the opening and preserve the old take.”
Qiu Ran: “I agree to keep the laugh.”

One possible revision:
Qi Ran: “I rushed the first line. Can we start again?”
Qiu Ran: “Your laugh later in the take. Are we doing that again too?”
A Ke: “Six minutes left. I'll keep this take. Is it the opening you want, or another whole song?”
Qi Ran: “The opening.”
Qiu Ran: “Don't cut the laugh.”
A Ke: “Then we record just the opening. The old take stays.”
Qi Ran: “All right. Nothing after that changes.”

Why the voices differ:
- Qi begins with a performance problem and narrows her request after hearing the constraint.
- Qiu points to a particular shared moment; he does not borrow a speech about his still-private departure.
- A Ke introduces information she owns and turns competing requests into an explicit decision.
- Their speech acts and attention differ without a catchphrase, accent stereotype or gesture after every line.

Subtext is not a riddle: answer a misunderstanding
This is another original dialogue version of the same conversation, not an exchange that follows the earlier version or an accepted replacement. Keep the same facts and outcome, but make room for one mistaken reading and a response.

Qi Ran: “I rushed the first line. Let's record the whole song again.”
Qiu Ran: “Don't replace this take yet. That laugh later on—we might not get it again.”
Qi Ran: “You think the opening doesn't need fixing?”
Qiu Ran: “No. I mean, fix the opening without throwing away what comes after it.”
A Ke: “Six minutes left. We'll keep this take for now. Just the opening, or the whole song again?”
Qi Ran: “Just the opening. Leave the rest.”
Qiu Ran: “Keep the laugh too.”
A Ke: “All right. We keep the old take and record only the opening.”

What happens here is not Qiu finally disclosing his secret. Qi first hears “don't replace this take” as “the opening doesn't need fixing,” so she asks about the judgment of her performance. Qiu's direct “No” corrects that reading, then separates the opening that can be replaced from the later passage he wants retained. His reply answers what she has just understood rather than merely repeating his position when his turn arrives. Only afterward does A Ke supply the six minutes she knows about, leading Qi to narrow her request. Neither of the others knows the time early.

Qiu can openly ask to keep the laugh without explaining all its personal weight. The author knowing he will soon leave does not give Qi that knowledge, nor require him to invent a false reason for an honest request. Even without the author's private note, a reader can understand the immediate concern that a spontaneous sound may not happen again. These lines alone do not establish that the reader has guessed his departure. The subtext remains in the request's unspoken personal significance, not in removing every intelligible piece of information.

Do not add narration that reads his mind for her: “She finally understood that he could not bear to lose their last session together.” This example gives her no knowledge of his departure and does not establish this recording as their last. What she accepts is a concrete arrangement—another opening, with the later laugh retained—not an understanding and resolution of all his feelings. The last line still makes a recording decision; no splice, retake or technical result has happened on the page.

Which version serves the scene? The earlier exchange moves faster: after one question about the laugh, A Ke narrows the choice. This version spends a little longer on being misunderstood and answering it, useful if that moment of friction belongs in this conversation. If you do not want Qi to misread him here, retain the earlier version instead of manufacturing a misunderstanding to create “subtext.” Nor must “No” be polished into another question. Necessary clarification can coexist with private feelings that are not yet spoken.

For a text proposal only:
In this reply, try one dialogue version with the original character facts, order of time disclosure and outcome: keep the old take, record only another opening and retain the laugh. Make a reply answer the specific reading in the previous line; if using the misunderstanding above, include a direct correction rather than another riddle. Do not disclose Qiu's departure or add actions, private thoughts, completed recording or a different ending. Explain what the version adds and what it costs in pace so I can choose one; do not splice the alternatives together. No skill invocation, project-file edits or persistent preference recording for this request.

Same speaker, different listener — optional alternatives after the time limit is known, not extra required lines:
Qi to A Ke: “Just the first line, then. Do we have time?”
Qi to Qiu: “The laugh stays. I only want the opening.”
The first asks for feasibility; the second reassures a teammate about what will be protected.

Suggested request in an existing Claude Code writing project:
/story-long-write 修改第6章
Revise only the named rehearsal dialogue and speaker tags, not the surrounding scene. Use the approved facts, knowledge boundaries and outcome above. Distinguish each character's immediate aim and relationship to the listener before choosing wording. Preserve the book's existing narrative voice. Do not add new actions, a new decision, a departure announcement or private thoughts outside Qi's viewpoint. This is a one-scene choice, not a persistent author preference.
Confirm the local scope, back up the original and follow the bundled revision workflow. If the established chapter plan conflicts with these requested facts, report that before editing. Stop after this chapter's scoped revision and report changed passages and downstream conflicts; do not rewrite later chapters.
[Replace chapter number, paths and scene facts with your own.]
example.zh:
原创对白示例——一种编辑方案，不是模型运行记录。

场景：乐队决定是否再录一遍。视角贴近歌手戚然，不叙述他人私下的想法。
已确认事实：戚然觉得自己第一句抢了，要求整首重录。原录音中有一次她和鼓手邱冉都听见的自然笑声。起初只有录音者阿珂知道还剩六分钟。邱冉很快将离开这座城，但另外两人不知道，他也不在本场宣布。
既定结果：保留原录音，只另录开头，并保留笑声。本场决定录什么，不声称已经完成音频剪辑。

声音可互换的版本：
戚然：“我希望再完整录一遍，因为我觉得开头还不够好。”
邱冉：“我希望保留这一遍，因为我觉得你后来的笑声很好。”
阿珂：“我希望在剩下六分钟内决定，因为我们不能加时。”
戚然：“我同意只补录开头，保留原来的录音。”
邱冉：“我同意保留那段笑声。”

一种改法：
戚然：“第一句我抢了。再从头来一次？”
邱冉：“后面你笑的那一下，也重来？”
阿珂：“还有六分钟。旧的先留着。你们要的是开头，还是再唱一整遍？”
戚然：“开头。”
邱冉：“别把笑声剪没了。”
阿珂：“那只补开头。原来这遍不删。”
戚然：“好，后面不动。”

声音为什么有区别：
- 戚然先盯演唱问题，得知时间约束后缩小请求。
- 邱冉盯住共同经历中的一个具体瞬间，不借机发表尚未公开的离别宣言。
- 阿珂提供她掌握的信息，把不同请求变成一个明确决定。
- 不靠口头禅、刻板口音或每句后的动作尾巴，也能分开注意点与说话动作。

潜台词不是猜谜：先接住一次误解
下面是同一场谈话的另一版原创对白，不是接在前版之后的新一轮，也不是已接受的替换稿。沿用同样的事实与结果，只多给一次误读和回应留位置。

戚然：“第一句我抢了。整首再录一遍吧。”
邱冉：“先别换掉这遍。后面那声笑，再录不一定有。”
戚然：“你觉得开头不用改？”
邱冉：“不是。我是说，改开头，别把后面那段也丢了。”
阿珂：“还有六分钟。原来这遍先留着。只补开头，还是整首重来？”
戚然：“只补开头。后面不动。”
邱冉：“那声笑也留着。”
阿珂：“好，原来的不删，我们只补开头。”

这里发生的不是“邱冉终于把秘密说出来”。戚然先把“别换掉这遍”听成了“不用改开头”，所以问的是对自己演唱问题的判断。邱冉用一个直接的“不是”纠正她，再把可以补的开头和想保留的后段分开。这个回答承接了她刚才的理解，不只是轮到他再宣读一遍立场。阿珂随后才给出她掌握的六分钟，让戚然缩小请求；前面的两个人没有提前知道时间。

邱冉想留住笑声，这件事可以明说；他为什么格外看重它，仍未说尽。作者知道他快离开，不等于戚然也知道，更不必让他编一个假理由来掩盖真实的保留请求。即使读者没有那条作者笔记，也能理解“某次自然发生的声音未必能再录一次”这个眼前顾虑；不能仅凭这几句，就断言读者已经猜到了离别。潜台词保留在请求背后的个人分量里，不靠藏掉所有可理解的信息。

不要再补一句旁白替她读心：“她终于明白，他只是舍不得最后一次合奏。”本例既没有让她得知离开，也没有把这遍录音定成最后一次。她现在接受的是“开头能补，后面的笑声可以留”这项具体安排，不是已经理解并治好了他的全部心事。末句仍是录制决定，没有发生剪接、重录或技术效果的证明。

选哪一版？前版更快：一句关于笑声的反问后，阿珂就收束选择。这版更慢一点，把被误会、再说清的过程留在场内，适合这次谈话需要那一点关系摩擦时使用。若你不想让戚然在此处误读，就保留前版，不为了“有潜台词”制造误会。也不必把“不是”润成一个新的反问：需要讲清的事讲清，未准备说出的私情仍可留住。

只看文字提案时，可以这样请求：
只在回复中为这段谈话试一版对白：保留原来的人物事实、时间信息进入顺序和“留原录音，只补开头，保留笑声”的结果。让一个回答回应上一句的具体理解；若采用上面的误读，写出直接纠正，而不是继续打哑谜。不得披露邱冉离开的事，不新增动作、内心、已完成录制或新的结局。解释相对前版多了什么、节奏损失在哪里，让我选一版，不把两版拼接。本次不调用技能、不修改项目文件，也不写入长期偏好。

同一人面对不同听者——时间已知后的可选措辞，不是额外必须塞入的两句：
戚然对阿珂：“那只补第一句，来得及吗？”
戚然对邱冉：“笑声留着。我只要开头。”
前一句问可行性，后一句向队友说明什么会被保护。

在已有 Claude Code 写作项目里，可以这样请求：
/story-long-write 修改第6章
只改点名的排练对白与说话人标记，不改周围场景。采用上面的既定事实、信息边界和结果。先分每个人的眼前目标及与听者的关系，再选择措辞；保留本书已有叙述声音。不新增动作、另一个决定、离队宣告或越出戚然视角的私密心理。这只是本场选择，不记录为长期作者偏好。
确认局部范围、备份原稿，再按随包修订流程处理。若已有细纲与这些请求事实冲突，编辑前先报告。完成本章范围内修订后停止，说明改动段落与后续冲突，不重写后章。
[替换为自己的章节号、路径与场景事实。]

en: A scene-specific account of each speaker’s agenda, known information, protected concern and way of addressing the listener. This is a planning aid, not a required new character-file schema or a set of automatic personality labels.

A revised passage within the requested scope, with its original outcome and information boundary intact. For the project command, the documented workflow backs up the chapter and handles continuity through its revision process; a prose example on this page is not an executed file edit.

An explanation of what each changed exchange now does, plus any unresolved conflict with the chapter plan. If only generic filler wording is at issue, the [prose-revision guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose) may be the smaller task.
zh: 一份针对本场的说明：各人议程、已知信息、想保护的东西及面对听者的表达方式。这是规划辅助，不是新增的人设文件格式，也不是自动性格标签。
一段在指定范围内修过的文字，保留原结果与信息边界。对工程命令，文档流程会备份章节并通过修订过程处理连续性；本页对白示例不是已经执行的文件修改。
说明每处改后的对话正在做什么，以及与细纲仍未解决的冲突。若问题只是套话，按[局部润色指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose)处理可能已经够用。

en: Check every fact spoken against what that speaker can know at that point, not only what appears in the author’s notes. Do not turn subtext into unexplained mind-reading.

Read the replies in sequence. Do the request, resistance, new information and concession still lead to the approved outcome? Quiet courtesy or hesitation can serve the scene; not every line needs a confrontation.
Judge the exchange in this book’s style and context. Neither counting words nor hiding the speaker names proves voice quality, and a more distinctive line does not justify changing the story.
zh: 逐条核对人物说出的事实是否在当时可知，不只看它是否出现在作者笔记里。不要把潜台词变成无缘由的读心。
顺着回答读下去：请求、抵抗、新信息与让步是否仍通向既定结果？客气或犹豫也可以服务场景，不必每句都交锋。
结合本书文风与上下文判断。数字数或遮住姓名都不能证明声音质量；一句更有个性的台词，也不能自行取得改变故事的权限。
